papers.title: DecisionReplay: A Corpus and Offline Simulator for Ensembling Decision Models

summary.en: Comparing ensembles, routers and cascades over decision models needs every model's output on every item, plus its cost - and routing-oriented collections store no per-option probabilities. DecisionReplay (Ben-Gurion University of the Negev) releases the probability vectors of 17 commercial decision models - the pool includes hosted typesafe/jev-1.13 and typesafe/jev-1.14 alongside Microsoft, Liquid, Cloudflare, Perplexity and Nace entries - on 35 benchmarks: 267,716 questions asked in 106,845 requests, with token counts, billed cost and measured latency for every call. A deterministic simulator replays any select/combine/cascade policy offline, free of new API calls. Findings: one well-chosen model per benchmark is hard to beat (pooling all models loses 2.7 accuracy points to it; stacking gains 1.0 at 3.4x its cost), wrong models err together (two wrong models pick the same wrong option in 72% of cases), the best router matches the per-benchmark model at 64% of its cost, and certified early exit cuts stacked-ensemble cost by 43% without changing an answer. Corpus and code are released on GitHub and the Hugging Face Hub.
summary.zh: 比较决策模型上的集成、路由与级联策略,需要每个模型在每个条目上的输出及其成本——而为路由构建的存储库不保存逐选项概率。DecisionReplay(内盖夫本-古里安大学)发布 17 个商用决策模型的概率向量——模型池包含托管的 typesafe/jev-1.13 与 typesafe/jev-1.14,另有 Microsoft、Liquid、Cloudflare、Perplexity、Nace 等——覆盖 35 个基准:267,716 道问题、106,845 次请求,每次调用的 token 数、计费成本与实测延迟俱全;确定性模拟器离线重放任意「选择/合并/级联」策略,不再调用 API。结论:每个基准上一个选对的单模型很难被超越(全模型池化反而丢 2.7 个准确率点;stacking 以 3.4 倍成本换 1.0 点);模型们「一起错」——两个同时错的模型 72% 的情况选同一个错项;最优路由以 64% 的成本追平该模型;认证早退把 stacked 集成成本砍 43% 而不改任何一答。语料与代码在 GitHub 与 Hugging Face Hub 发布。

problem.en: How can ensemble, routing and cascade policies over commercial decision models be compared without paying for every model on every item?
problem.zh: 不为「每个模型×每个条目」付 API 成本,如何比较商用决策模型上的集成、路由与级联策略?

papers.title: Procedure Inference as Memory: Learning Recruiter Decision Procedures from OKF-Structured Episodes in Multi-Session Hiring Assistants

summary.en: Multi-session hiring assistants must infer recruiter preferences that shift across projects and time. This paper organizes interaction history as Open Knowledge Format (OKF)-indexed episodic memory - lineage-linked episodes retrievable through their derivation chain - and adds Procedure Memory, which distills reusable recruiter decision procedures from those episodes via prompted reflection or reinforcement learning. For cheap index navigation it evaluates a Jev-class decision model (open-weight H2O-Lightning-4B, cited at 29 ms median per decision on JevBench) in place of a generative LLM selector, with GPT-5.6 Luna as a lower-cost alternative to GPT-5.4. OKF retrieval reaches 0.93-0.95 low-priority preference F1 while using 69% fewer context tokens than full history; Procedure Memory cuts conversational turns by up to 39%; on PersonaMem-v2 it scores 50.2% versus 48.6% for full history and 29.0% for no memory, at 90.5% fewer reader input tokens. Jev-class navigation improves conversational efficiency but more often misses temporally relevant evidence. Hosted Jev itself is not among the evaluated models.
summary.zh: 多轮招聘助手要推断跨项目、随时间演化的招聘方偏好。本文把交互历史组织成 Open Knowledge Format(OKF)索引的情景记忆——靠 lineage 链接的情节可沿派生关系检索——并提出程序记忆(Procedure Memory):用提示反思或强化学习从这些情节里蒸馏可复用的招聘决策程序。为降低索引导航成本,评测了一个「Jev-class」决策模型(开放权重 H2O-Lightning-4B,文中引其在 JevBench 上中位 29 毫秒)替代生成式 LLM 选择器,并以 GPT-5.6 Luna 作 GPT-5.4 的低价替代。OKF 检索把低优先偏好 F1 做到 0.93–0.95、上下文 token 比全历史省 69%;程序记忆最多减 39% 对话轮次;PersonaMem-v2 上 50.2%(全历史 48.6%、无记忆 29.0%),读取端输入 token 省 90.5%。Jev-class 导航提升对话效率,但更常漏掉时间相关证据。托管 Jev 本体不在受测之列。

problem.en: Can multi-session hiring assistants learn reusable recruiter decision procedures instead of carrying full histories?
problem.zh: 多轮招聘助手能否不背全量历史,而是学出可复用的招聘方决策程序?

papers.title: Searching Ultra-Long Videos with Decision Models
affiliations: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

summary.en: Understanding ultra-long videos means retrieving sparse, query-relevant evidence from extensive histories: similarity-based retrieval encodes question and content independently and misses evidence whose relevance needs joint reasoning, while generative LLMs can reason but generate text over multiple slow, costly search rounds. DeLoVi (Decision Models for Long Video; UNC Chapel Hill) leverages pretrained decision models to retrieve evidence instead: like an LLM it reads the question together with the candidate evidence, but it directly outputs a relevance score without generating text. DeLoVi-S captions short clips and scores them with the decision model; DeLoVi-E adds agentic exploration with an evolved policy. By default the scorer is hosted Jev, with GPT-6 Luna as the LLM; the decision-model ablation swaps Jev for Decider, Drex Max and OpenJev (57.4 / 57.5 / 57.6 / 51.4 average accuracy over five benchmarks). Code is available at github.com/CeeZh/DeLoVi.
summary.zh: 理解超长视频要从浩瀚的历史帧里检索稀疏的、与查询相关的证据:相似度检索把问题与内容独立编码,会漏掉那些相关性需要联合推理的证据;生成式 LLM 能推理,却要多轮生成文本,又慢又贵。DeLoVi(UNC 教堂山分校)改用预训练决策模型检索证据:像 LLM 一样把问题与候选证据一起读入,但直接输出相关性分数、零文本生成。DeLoVi-S 为短片生成字幕并用决策模型打分;DeLoVi-E 加上按进化策略探索的智能体式检索。默认打分器是托管 Jev,LLM 用 GPT-6 Luna;决策模型消融把 Jev 换成 Decider、Drex Max、OpenJev(五个基准平均准确率 57.4 / 57.5 / 57.6 / 51.4)。代码见 github.com/CeeZh/DeLoVi。

problem.zh: 决策模型能否不经生成式多轮搜索,就从超长视频中检索出与查询相关的证据?

papers.title: Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models

summary.en: Decision models are fine-tuned language models that return a probability for each option of a typed query, and routers and guardrails threshold those probabilities directly - yet they are built on multilingual bases and ranked almost entirely in English. This NTU/NUS/VinUniversity benchmark evaluates 25 top-ranked open-weight decision models (OneJev, GLiDE, Turion-JEV, Sieve and others) on 17 tasks in 14 languages, comparing each language with English on parallel items. Every model loses accuracy in every language - about 2 points in high-resource languages, 8 in Tamil - while confidence falls only half as much: a threshold set for 95% English accuracy yields 90% in Tamil. The loss is set by language and base model rather than leaderboard rank. In 81 controlled fine-tuning runs, English-learned task skill transfers and a few thousand target-language items narrow large losses, but neither more data nor full-parameter tuning closes them. All evaluated models are open-weight; hosted Jev is not among them.
summary.zh: 决策模型是为类型化查询每个选项返回概率的微调语言模型,路由器与护栏直接对这些概率设阈值——但它们构建在多语底座上,排名却几乎只在英语上做。这项 NTU/新加坡国立/VinUniversity 的基准在 14 种语言、17 个任务上评估 25 个排名靠前的开放权重决策模型(OneJev、GLiDE、Turion-JEV、Sieve 等),用平行条目逐语言与英语对比。所有模型在所有语言上都掉点——高资源语言约 2 个点,泰米尔语 8 个点——而置信度只掉一半:为英语 95% 准确率设的阈值,在泰米尔语上只剩 90%。损失大小由语言与底座决定,与榜单排名无关。81 组受控微调显示,英语学到的任务技能可迁移,几千条目标语言条目能收窄大损失,但加数据与全参微调都关不上缺口。受测模型全部为开放权重;不含托管 Jev。

problem.en: How much accuracy and calibration do decision models lose outside English, and can fine-tuning close the gap?
problem.zh: 决策模型在英语之外损失多少准确率与校准,微调能否补上?

papers.title: SOARS: System One Assisted Reranking for Agentic Search

summary.en: In deep search agents, existing rerankers improve retrieval but add latency and cost at every step of the trajectory. SOARS (Waterloo, Thomson Reuters Labs, Guelph) is a training-free framework that leverages hosted Jev (TypeSafe AI) for fast, calibrated relevance estimation: at each search step it selects query-relevant passages from long documents and reranks candidates in a single call, jointly considering the original question and the agent-generated sub-query. Across six LLM backbones on BrowseComp-Plus and WebShaper, SOARS consistently improves answer accuracy and evidence recall while reducing search calls, end-to-end latency and inference cost; on BrowseComp-Plus it lifts GPT-5.4 Mini's accuracy from 73.9% to 84.7%. At $0.042 per million input tokens with free output, per-step reranking by a decision model becomes cheaper than the retrieval it improves.
summary.zh: 深度搜索智能体里,现有重排器能提升检索质量,却给轨迹每一步都加延迟与成本。SOARS(滑铁卢大学、汤森路透实验室、圭尔夫大学)是免训练框架,用托管 Jev(TypeSafe AI)做快速校准的相关性估计:每步搜索从长文档中选出与查询相关的段落并在一次调用中重排候选,同时考虑原始问题与智能体生成的子查询。在 BrowseComp-Plus 与 WebShaper 上、六种 LLM 底座下,SOARS 持续提升答案准确率与证据召回,同时减少搜索调用、端到端延迟与推理成本;BrowseComp-Plus 上把 GPT-5.4 Mini 的准确率从 73.9% 提到 84.7%。按每百万输入 token 0.042 美元、输出免费计,决策模型逐步重排比它所改进的检索还便宜。

problem.en: Can a System One model rerank at every search-agent step without blowing the latency budget?
problem.zh: System One 模型能否在搜索智能体的每一步都做重排而不撑爆延迟预算?

papers.title: Decision Models: An Introduction and Capability Evaluation

summary.en: Ticket routing and incident triage need decisions software can act on, but teams lack a compact map of what typed decision services actually deliver. This Beihang introduction evaluates eleven configurations - including hosted JEV (jev-1.14.0 via the TypeSafe decision interface), StartLux Instant and other open and closed services - on 1,000 English and Chinese cases across nine task suites, measuring accuracy, output validity and request latency. StartLux Instant tops the reported headline with 95.3% overall accuracy, valid outputs on all 1,000 cases and 0.084 s median latency, reaching 99.4% on classification and routing and a perfect 100/100 on tool selection; the best overall accuracy among the evaluated configurations is 97.1%. The authors frame the results as a guide for when a typed decision service can support fast programmatic decisions and when task-specific errors and latency budgets rule it out.
summary.zh: 工单路由与事件分诊需要软件可直接执行的决策,但业界一直缺一张类型化决策服务实际能力的紧凑地图。这篇北航的入门评测评估了十一种配置——包括托管 JEV(jev-1.14.0,经 TypeSafe 决策接口)、StartLux Instant 等开放与闭源服务——在九个任务套件、1,000 条中英文案例上测准确率、输出有效性与请求延迟。StartLux Instant 以 95.3% 总体准确率、全部 1,000 条输出有效与 0.084 秒中位延迟领跑,分类与路由达 99.4%,工具选择 100/100 全对;受测配置中的最高总体准确率为 97.1%。作者把结果定位为一份「何时该用类型化决策服务支撑快速程序化决策、何时因任务误差与延迟预算而不适用」的指南。

problem.en: What accuracy, validity and latency do typed decision services actually deliver on programmatic decision workloads?
problem.zh: 类型化决策服务在程序化决策负载上实际交付怎样的准确率、有效性与延迟?

papers.title: The Control-Flow Tax: Specialized Decision Routing for LLM Agent Workflows

summary.en: An agent can spend almost as much deciding what to do as doing it: in the authors' documentation workflow, control-flow routing accounts for 42.5% of baseline reference cost. This Talkdesk study evaluates a heterogeneous architecture in which hosted Jev, a specialized System 1 decision model, controls finite actions while Sol generates documents. Across four software tasks and 480 valid runs, Jev full routing achieves the lowest mean cost and elapsed time on every task, completing all 40 specialist-controlled runs along the shortest trajectory; on the initial task, mean cost falls 49.6% (95% paired-bootstrap interval 42.9-56.3%) and elapsed time 33.2% (19.6-46.7%). Cheap general-purpose routers can trigger extra calls to the expensive generator, so specialization - not just price - is what removes the control-flow tax. The stated code repository (Czk0712/Workflow_routing) is deferred until publication and 404s at review time.
summary.zh: 智能体「决定做什么」的开销可能不亚于「做」本身:在作者的文档工作流里,控制流路由占基线参照成本的 42.5%。这项 Talkdesk 研究评估了异构架构:托管 Jev——专用 System 1 决策模型——控制有限动作,Sol 负责生成文档。在四个软件任务、480 次有效运行中,Jev 全量路由在每个任务上都取得最低平均成本与耗时,40 次专家对照运行全部沿最短轨迹完成;在初始任务上平均成本下降 49.6%(95% 配对 bootstrap 区间 42.9-56.3%),耗时下降 33.2%(19.6-46.7%)。廉价通用路由器可能触发对昂贵生成器的额外调用,所以真正消除控制流税的是专业化,而不只是价格。论文声称的代码仓库(Czk0712/Workflow_routing)推迟至发表公开,审阅时 404。

problem.en: How much of an agent's cost is deciding what to do, and can a specialized router remove it?
problem.zh: 智能体成本里有多少花在「决定做什么」上,专用路由器能否消除它?

papers.title: EEGJev: A System One Decision Model and Benchmark for Multi-Task EEG Question Answering

summary.en: A single EEG recording can support many decoding tasks, but fixed-label tests cannot show how EEG foundation models handle changing questions or options. This Tohoku pair introduces EEGJev, a fast decision model that scores candidate answers in one pass, and EEGJev-Bench, covering six question types across 19 public EEG sources. Holding the recording and options fixed while switching between questions about attributes paired during training (such as facial expression and the hand participants were asked to use), EEGJev selected a label for the requested attribute with 99.70% accuracy (49.20% under uniform choice) across 13 test sources, with 62.04% balanced accuracy for the specific answer; its 95th-percentile response time beat NeuroLM's on matched validation questions. Users switch decoding targets simply by changing the question. The project repository (training settings, data quality checks, per-seed results) is at github.com/dengzhe-hou/EEGJev.
summary.zh: 一段脑电记录本可支撑多种解码任务,但固定标签的测试无法展示 EEG 基础模型如何应对变化的问题与选项。这对东北大学(日本)作者提出 EEGJev——一次前向即为候选答案打分的快速决策模型——以及覆盖 19 个公开 EEG 源、六种问题类型的 EEGJev-Bench。固定记录与选项、只在训练时配对的属性问题之间切换(如面部表情与被试被要求使用的手),EEGJev 在 13 个测试源上以 99.70% 准确率选中请求属性的标签(均匀选择为 49.20%),具体答案的平衡准确率 62.04%;在匹配的验证问题上其 95 分位响应时间快于 NeuroLM。换解码目标只需换问题。项目仓库(训练设置、数据质量检查、逐种子结果)在 github.com/dengzhe-hou/EEGJev。

problem.zh: 脑电模型能否在提问时切换解码任务,而不必每个标签集重训一次?

papers.title: Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China

summary.en: Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions and judging passage widths, but existing benchmarks barely cover these abilities. Clinical3D-Bench (USTC, A*STAR, Wenzhou Medical University) is a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts built to design guidelines, with answers computed from the 3D scenes, paired scene states testing whether models change answers when relevant evidence changes, photorealistic videos, and ten physicians screening the layouts. Among 35 multimodal LLMs, the best open and proprietary models reach only 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy versus 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians; fine-tuning the open VideoJev-4B decision model on the released Clinical3D-45K raises its macro accuracy from 45.5% to 73.9%. The fine-tuned model (and the authors' GeoJeV variant with tool calls) is the open VideoJev stack; hosted Jev is not used.
summary.zh: 医院里的空间推理要求辨认相似设备、理解以患者为参照的方向、判断通道宽度,既有基准几乎不覆盖这些能力。Clinical3D-Bench(中科大、A*STAR、温州医科大学)是模拟基准:按设计规范构建 373 间病房的 ego 视角漫游视频,出 3,368 道八类问题,答案由 3D 场景直接计算,配对场景状态检验相关证据变化时模型是否改答,十位医师审核布局。在 35 个多模态大模型中,最佳开源与闭源模型宏准确率仅 45.7% 与 53.6%,而答案先验为 40.8%、医师为 79.0%;在发布的 Clinical3D-45K 上微调开放的 VideoJev-4B 决策模型,可把宏准确率从 45.5% 提到 73.9%。微调对象(及作者带工具调用的 GeoJeV 变体)是开放的 VideoJev 技术栈;未使用托管 Jev。

problem.en: Can MLLMs reason about hospital spaces, and can a decision model be taught to?
problem.zh: 多模态大模型能否对医院空间做推理,决策模型又能否被教会?

papers.title: EEG-Jev: A Unified Single-Pass Decision Model for EEG
affiliations: Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, CAS
National Innovation Center for Advanced Medical Devices

summary.en: EEG analysis spans choosing alternatives, judging statements and rating ordered attributes, and these decisions are today served one task at a time. EEG-Jev (SIAT CAS and partners) is a unified single-pass decision model for EEG: given an EEG window, a question and an answer specification, one forward pass returns a typed readout - CHOICE gives a candidate distribution, NOUL a proposition probability, and SCORE an ordered-level distribution with expectation. One checkpoint is trained jointly and evaluated on held-out splits of 35 public sources: raw outputs reach 54.08% balanced accuracy on Stieger2021 motor imagery, 70.45% on Sleep-EDF-SC staging, 72.11% per window at threshold 0.5 on CHB-MIT seizure detection (0.825 AUROC), and 1.700 MAE on 0-10 pain ratings; prior correction and temperature scaling lower Sleep-EDF-SC NLL from 0.766 to 0.606. A frozen REVE-L encoder feeds Qwen3.5-2B with LoRA. An interactive demonstration is hosted at neuroimglab.github.io/EEG-Jev/ (repo github.com/NeuroImgLab/EEG-Jev).
summary.zh: 脑电分析涵盖选择备选、判断陈述与为有序属性打分,而这些决策今天仍是一个任务一个模型。EEG-Jev(中科院深圳先进院等)是统一的脑电单次前向决策模型:给定脑电窗、一个问题与答案规范,一次前向返回类型化读出——CHOICE 给候选分布、NOUL 给命题概率、SCORE 给有序等级分布及其期望。一个检查点联合训练并在 35 个公开源的留出划分上评估:原始输出在 Stieger2021 运动想象上平衡准确率 54.08%,Sleep-EDF-SC 分期 70.45%,CHB-MIT 癫痫检测阈值 0.5 下每窗 72.11%(AUROC 0.825),0-10 疼痛评分 MAE 1.700;先验校正加温度缩放把 Sleep-EDF-SC 的 NLL 从 0.766 降到 0.606。冻结 REVE-L 编码器接 Qwen3.5-2B 加 LoRA。交互演示在 neuroimglab.github.io/EEG-Jev/(仓库 github.com/NeuroImgLab/EEG-Jev)。

papers.title: Training decision models for simulating human respondents

summary.en: Synthetic survey answers from off-the-shelf LLMs bias the econometrics downstream of silicon sampling, and neither proprietary models nor higher reasoning effort reliably reduces the bias. This McGill study trains decision models (System One architectures, KEV weights) as synthetic respondents: choice training updates the model on historical respondent-level choice microdata by conditional maximum likelihood before inference, with no target-study data. Across three model scales, training on two discrete choice experiments lowers treatment-effect error by 22% to 89% on four held-out studies from new domains (vaccines, nutrition labels, consumer rights, AI) and new response formats, and a small choice-trained model outperforms a much larger off-the-shelf LLM. Jev appears only in the bibliography; the trained artefacts are KEV-family models.
summary.zh: 现成 LLM 生成的合成问卷答案会让「硅基抽样」下游的计量推断带偏,换私有模型或加大推理力度都不可靠地消除偏差。这项麦吉尔大学的研究把决策模型(System One 架构、KEV 权重)训练成合成受访者:在推断之前用条件极大似然在历史受访者级选择微数据上做选择训练,完全不碰目标研究数据。在三个模型规模上,用两个离散选择实验训练后,四个新领域(疫苗、营养标签、消费者权益、AI)与新作答格式的留出研究上处理效应误差下降 22% 到 89%,小型选择训练模型甚至胜过大得多的现成 LLM。Jev 仅出现在参考文献;训练产物是 KEV 家族模型。

papers.title: JevBench: Metamorphic Coherence Testing for Typed Probabilistic Decision Models

summary.en: Do typed probabilistic decision models keep their probabilities coherent when the same question is reworded, negated, combined, given different options or placed in different batches? JevBench (single author) tests exactly this without gold labels: 50 metamorphic relations each check one law of probability or choice across five dimensions - representation, batch independence, probability measure, logical order and choice-set conditioning - by changing the question or batch while holding the input fixed. JevBench-240 runs 12,000 tests over 240 synthetic cases in 12 decision domains; the fixed 1,200-test JevBench-mini reproduces the full-suite ranking at Spearman 0.983. Across 21 openly released Jev-compatible models served with their developers' own code (48M to 9.7B, seven architecture families), coherence scores range 56.5-83.9: batch independence holds for most, while additivity violations are common, and self-hosted answers are exactly repeatable. Hosted Jev itself is not among the tested models.
summary.zh: 类型化概率决策模型的概率,在问题被改写、取反、合并、换选项或换批次时还能保持自洽吗?JevBench(单作者)不用金标签就能测这件事:50 条蜕变关系各自检验一条概率或选择公理,覆盖表示、批次独立性、概率测度、逻辑顺序与选择集条件五个维度——固定输入、只变问题或批次。JevBench-240 在 12 个决策域的 240 个合成案例上跑 12,000 项测试;固定的 1,200 项 JevBench-mini 以 Spearman 0.983 复现全量排名。在 21 个用开发者自身代码自托管部署的开放 Jev 兼容模型(48M 至 9.7B、七个架构家族)上,自洽分介于 56.5-83.9:多数满足批次独立性,可加性违例却常见,自托管答案完全可复现。托管 Jev 本身不在受测之列。

problem.en: Are decision-model probabilities coherent under rewording, regrouping and rebatching?
problem.zh: 决策模型的概率在改写、重组与重排批次下是否自洽?

papers.title: Taxi: Analyzing Agents at (Real) Scale

summary.en: Debugging, clustering and monitoring agents at millions of steps needs analysis methods that scale. Taxi (Rival Research) combines scalable clustering to generate a taxonomy over steps, full SQL access for engineers and agents to ask complex questions, and a hybrid pipeline guided by a coding agent; it also includes an experimental third path based on Jev-style decision models that map state and bounded questions directly to typed, probabilistic decisions, adding low-cost semantic routing and evaluation where embeddings or literal queries fall short. The report is careful about scope: Jev-style refers to the broader interface, not only TypeSafe AI's original Jev model, and the integration is experimental. Extensible evaluators and daily reports round out the ecosystem.
summary.zh: 要在数百万步的智能体数据上做调试、聚类与监控,分析方法必须能扩展。Taxi(Rival Research)组合了可扩展聚类(为步数据生成分类法)、面向工程师与智能体的完整 SQL 访问,以及由编码智能体引导的混合流水线;并实验性地接入第三条路:Jev 式决策模型——把状态与有界问题直接映射为类型化概率决策——在嵌入或字面查询不够用的地方补充低成本语义路由与评估。报告对范围很谨慎:Jev-style 指更宽的接口,而非仅 TypeSafe AI 的原版 Jev;该集成仍属实验性。可扩展评估器与日报构成完整生态。

problem.en: How can engineers debug and monitor agent behaviour across millions of steps?
problem.zh: 工程师如何跨数百万步调试并监控智能体行为?

papers.title: Decision Models for Definition-Driven GitHub Actions Workflow Smell Detection

summary.en: Extending static analyzers to new GitHub Actions workflow smells means encoding constructs, applicability conditions and exceptions into detection rules. This Brazil-US software-engineering collaboration investigates definition-driven detection: models assess workflows against reusable natural-language smell definitions, focusing on decision-oriented models that return scores for bounded questions. Three decision-oriented configurations - two proprietary (Jev 1.13 and GPT Decisions) and one open-weight (Tev1 4B) - plus two generative models are evaluated on 1,710 manually validated workflow-smell pairs covering 19 smells, 903 workflows and 559 repositories. Effectiveness depends strongly on the decision policy: Jev 1.13 reaches 79.69% micro-F1 at threshold 0.5 and 85.43% with thresholds selected on a validation set; a static analyzer still outperforms it on 46 reconstructed workflows (87.8% vs 76.4%). With 0.675 s median latency and about US$0.22 in API charges for the whole benchmark, frequent model-assisted checks become operationally plausible.
summary.zh: 要让静态分析器覆盖新的 GitHub Actions 工作流坏味,就得把语法构造、适用条件与例外编进检测规则。这项巴美软件工程合作研究定义驱动检测:让模型按可复用的自然语言坏味定义评估工作流,聚焦返回有界问题分数的决策导向模型。在覆盖 19 种坏味、903 个工作流、559 个仓库的 1,710 对人工验证样本上,评估了三个决策导向配置——两个闭源(Jev 1.13 与 GPT Decisions)、一个开放权重(Tev1 4B)——加两个生成式模型。效果高度依赖决策策略:Jev 1.13 在阈值 0.5 时 micro-F1 79.69%,用验证集选阈值可达 85.43%;静态分析器在 46 个重建工作流上仍胜出(87.8% 对 76.4%)。0.675 秒中位延迟、全基准约 0.22 美元 API 费用,让高频模型辅助检查在运营上变得可行。

problem.zh: 决策模型能否按自然语言坏味定义检测工作流坏味,替代手写规则?

papers.title: Antares-Smaug: Adversarial Names, Tokens and Attack Rewrites: Sanitisers Miss Unseen Generalisations

summary.en: Software may act unseen on a one-pass decision model's answer, so prompt-style attacks matter as much as they do for LLMs. This Intel black-box catalogue attacks six Laya models (an open decision model family) with 81 programmatic edits of 566 synthetic items - injected sentences, label leaks, edited descriptions, decoy options, invisible and look-alike characters, floods - reporting the share of correctly answered items hijacked or lost with bootstrap intervals. Attack wordings no defence was built from win the attacker's option on 59% of items for released Laya and 36% for a fine-tune trained on 109 written injections: a sentence naming an option steers the released model even when negated (32%) while an imperative naming no option does not (5%), and option descriptions barely matter (2%). Sanitisers miss unseen generalisations, so defences need to be evaluated against held-out attack families. Jev itself is not attacked; the target is the open Laya family.
summary.zh: 软件可能在无人复核的情况下直接依据单次前向决策模型的答案行动,因此提示注入式攻击对它们的威胁不亚于对 LLM。这份 Intel 的黑箱攻击目录用 81 种程序化改写作用于 566 条合成样本,攻击六个 Laya 模型(开放决策模型家族)——注入句子、标签泄露、改写选项描述、诱导选项、不可见与形近字符、洪水文本——并以 bootstrap 区间报告被劫持或丢失的正确答案比例。防御从未见过的攻击措辞在已发布 Laya 上让攻击者选项赢得 59% 的条目,在用 109 条书面注入微调的 v1 上仍有 36%:点名某选项的句子即使被否定也能带偏已发布模型(32%),而不点名的祈使句则不能(5%),选项描述几乎无关(2%)。净化器漏掉了未见过的泛化,防御评估必须用留出的攻击族。论文未攻击 Jev 本体,对象是开放的 Laya 家族。

problem.zh: 用已知提示攻击构造的净化器,能否扛住从未见过的攻击族?

papers.title: Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions

summary.en: Conversational recommenders must rank items against needs that catalogs record only in part, while users add, withdraw and reverse needs and switch requests. LLM rankers re-read the whole dialogue every turn - slow, and their ordering hides which needs an item meets. This Adobe work shows a conversational recommender can be built from typed decisions instead: named questions over fixed options answered with option probabilities. Each turn, one typed request maps the message onto catalog fields, keeps what no field expresses in the user's words, and decides how the turn changes each earlier need; Needwise then ranks candidates must-first - kind, place and price form a tier, within which one holistic decision and need-level verdicts (supported, contradicted, unknown) combine with equal weight. The result is generation-free recommendation whose every score decomposes into named need verdicts. Jev appears only in the references.
summary.zh: 对话式推荐要按目录只部分记录的需求来排序,而用户还会新增、撤回、反转需求并切换请求。LLM 排序器每轮都要重读全部对话——又慢,排序结果也看不出商品满足了哪些需求。这项 Adobe 工作证明对话推荐可以改用类型化决策搭建:固定选项上的命名问题,以选项概率作答。每轮用一次类型化请求把消息映射到目录字段,保留目录表达不了的用户原话,并判定本轮如何改变既有需求;Needwise 再按「必须优先」排序——种类、地点、价格构成一层,层内一次整体决策与需求级判定(支持/矛盾/未知)等权合并。由此得到零生成的推荐,且每个分数都能分解为具名需求判定。Jev 仅出现在参考文献。

problem.zh: 对话式推荐能否跑在类型化决策上,让分数直接显示商品满足了哪些需求?

papers.title: Reducing Order Sensitivity in Decision Models

summary.en: Recent decision models such as Jev process options sequentially, so the same request can return different predictions depending on option order. Across ten open- and closed-source decision models - explicitly including TypeSafe AI's Jev and the OpenAI Decisions API - this Cornell study finds order-sensitivity pervasive, causing substantial accuracy degradation that worsens as options grow and compounds across multi-step decisions. The authors systematically compare eight mitigation methods on robustness, accuracy and inference efficiency, and find tree attention surprisingly effective: it achieves order invariance by processing options as parallel branches of a shared context, matches or beats heavier ensembling when used in training, and stays cheap at inference. The paper sets a reference protocol for measuring order robustness of decision models.
summary.zh: 以 Jev 为代表的决策模型按顺序处理选项,同一请求会因选项次序不同而给出不同预测。这项康奈尔大学研究在十个开源与闭源决策模型上——明确包括 TypeSafe AI 的 Jev 与 OpenAI Decisions API——发现顺序敏感性普遍存在:造成可观的准确率损失,选项越多越严重,并在多步决策中级联放大。作者系统对比八种缓解方法的稳健性、准确率与推理效率,发现树形注意力出奇地有效:把选项作为共享上下文的并行分支处理以实现顺序不变,训练时即追平或超过更重的集成方法,推理开销依然低廉。论文同时确立了衡量决策模型顺序稳健性的参照协议。

problem.zh: 决策模型为何对选项顺序如此敏感,最廉价的修复是什么?

papers.title: DKnown-Jev-2: Article-Level Answer-Evidence Classification and Efficient Inference with a Pre-trained Language Model

summary.en: Normative knowledge question answering needs evidence selection: deciding whether a candidate article directly supports an answer under the question's applicable conditions. DKnown-Jev-2 (Beijing Caizhi Tech) is an article-level answer-evidence classifier that jointly encodes question conditions, article metadata and paragraph content, using a pointer-style classification head to predict Answer Evidence versus Non-answer Evidence in a single forward pass across all paragraphs. On a manually annotated test set of 972 instances it reaches 91.77% accuracy and 91.28% macro-F1, outperforming hosted Jev by 2.16 and 2.37 points respectively (Jev 89.61%/88.92%) and OpenAI Decision by about 8 points, while reducing evidence misses and non-evidence false positives. The lead-priority version's single-pass design serves long articles without repeated encoding.
summary.zh: 规范性知识问答需要证据选择:判断候选文章是否在问题适用条件下直接支持答案。DKnown-Jev-2(北京财智科技)是文章级「答案-证据」分类器,联合编码问题条件、文章元数据与段落内容,用指针式分类头在一次前向中跨全部段落预测答案证据(Answer Evidence)与非答案证据(Non-answer Evidence)。在 972 条人工标注测试集上达到 91.77% 准确率与 91.28% 宏 F1,分别超过托管 Jev 2.16 与 2.37 个百分点(Jev 为 89.61%/88.92%),领先 OpenAI Decision 约 8 个点,同时减少证据漏选与非证据误报。其单次前向设计免去长文的重复编码。

papers.title: Triage Accuracy of Jev and Open-Weight System One Decision Models and Their Use for Early Emergency Recognition in Symptom-Assessment Applications

summary.en: Laypeople already ask LLMs for triage advice, but free-text answers are hard to evaluate for medical devices; decision models that assign a probability to each predefined triage category may be easier. This clinical-informatics team (DOCYET, Charite, Imperial, Leuphana) evaluated 16 decision models - 14 open-weight plus two proprietary comparators, gpt-6-luna-decisions and jev-1.14, all called through the OpenRouter API - on 233 synthetic and 10,000 real-world symptom-assessment cases, 163,728 total assessments. The best models triaged 72.1% of synthetic cases correctly and agreed with an existing algorithm on 56.1% of real-world cases - good enough to assist but not replace professionals. For early emergency recognition from demographics, chief complaints, risk factors and red-flag answers, the best model reached AUROC 0.87, and at a 5% error margin could decide for or against an emergency for about half of users.
summary.zh: 普通人已经在向 LLM 寻求分诊建议,但自由文本答案难以按医疗器械标准评估;给每个预定义分诊类别输出概率的决策模型可能更容易评估。这个临床信息学团队(DOCYET、夏里特医学院、帝国理工、莱普哈纳)评估了 16 个决策模型——14 个开放权重加两个闭源对照 gpt-6-luna-decisions 与 jev-1.14,全部经 OpenRouter API 调用——在 233 条合成与 10,000 条真实症状评估案例上共 163,728 次评估。最好的模型在合成案例上正确分诊 72.1%,与既有算法在真实案例上的一致率为 56.1%——足以辅助、不足以替代专业人员。在仅凭人口学信息、主诉、危险因素与红旗问答做早期急症识别时,最佳模型 AUROC 达 0.87,在 5% 误差容忍下可对约半数用户作出「是/否急症」的判定。

papers.title: Seeing Is Locating: Spatial Awareness and Geographic Bias in Decision Language Models
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

summary.en: Decision models are increasingly used as classifiers and evaluators for inputs tied to real-world locations, yet nobody had measured whether they leverage spatial context or carry geographic bias. GeoDecisions (UNSW and HKUST-Guangzhou) is a multimodal benchmark with two tasks - geo-aware image classification and location rating on objective and subjective topics. Evaluating six decision models, including hosted Jev-1.14 in the comparison tables, against supervised task-specific models, the study finds spatial awareness requires vision (textual coordinates alone are insufficient for everyday photos and satellite images) and substantial geographic bias: on everyday photos, decision models perform unevenly across regions despite similar overall accuracy. A training-free mitigation combining decision models with a location prior improves spatial awareness without substantially increasing performance bias. Code is at github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/GeoDecisions.
summary.zh: 决策模型越来越多地充当与真实地点相关的分类器与评估器,但没人测过它们能否利用空间上下文、是否携带地理偏见。GeoDecisions(新南威尔士大学与港科大广州)是包含两个任务的多模态基准:地理感知图像分类,以及客观与主观主题的地点评分。在六个决策模型(对比表中含托管 Jev-1.14)对监督式任务专用模型的评测中,研究发现空间感知离不开视觉(仅文本坐标不足以分类日常照片与卫星图像),且存在显著地理偏见:日常照片上各模型在不同地区的表现参差,尽管总体准确率相近。一种把决策模型与地点先验结合的训练无关方法改善了空间感知,又没有明显加重表现偏见。代码在 github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/GeoDecisions。

papers.title: Disclosure Bias in AI Reviewers

summary.en: Many venues now require authors to state how they used AI - but does that statement change how an AI reviewer rates the paper? This (University of Antwerp-adjacent) preliminary study varied only the AI-use statement of 150 ICLR 2027 submissions, in up to nine versions adapted from real statements ranging from no AI through writing help and coding to an AI research agent and an AI author. Six AI reviewers rated the versions: hosted Jev (version 1.13.0, TypeSafe AI - a decision model answering with probabilities) and five language models (Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 4 Argon), yielding 23,652 reviews. Every reviewer rates papers lower on average when the statement says AI did all the work; the AI-research-agent statement lowers the rating significantly for Jev, Sonnet and Argon. On Jev's fine-grained expected rating, the same statement rejects 77 percent more papers than re-reviewing alone.
summary.zh: 许多会议现在要求作者声明如何使用 AI——但这份声明会改变 AI 审稿人的评分吗?这项初步研究只改动 150 篇 ICLR 2027 投稿的 AI 使用声明,最多九个版本,取材自真实声明:从不用 AI、写作辅助、代码辅助,到 AI 研究智能体与 AI 作者。六位 AI 审稿人参与评分:托管 Jev(1.13.0 版,TypeSafe AI——以概率作答的决策模型)与五个语言模型(Claude Haiku 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5、Gemini 3.8 Flash、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Gemini 4 Argon),共 23,652 份评审。当声明称 AI 完成全部工作时,所有审稿人的平均评分都更低;「AI 研究智能体」声明对 Jev、Sonnet 与 Argon 的降分显著。在 Jev 的细粒度期望评分上,该声明比单纯复审多拒掉 77% 的论文。

papers.title: Voyag: Joint Multi-Intent Detection and Execution-Relation Classification for In-Vehicle Voice Assistants

summary.en: An in-vehicle voice assistant must decide which intents an utterance contains and how co-active intents may execute: concurrently, in a fixed order, or not at all. Voyag (Launch Tech) is a single-forward decision model that jointly predicts ten controlled vehicle-intent slots and a three-way execution relation (parallel, sequential, mutually exclusive) over each co-active intent pair. It combines a multilingual ModernBERT-style encoder (mmBERT-base, 306.9M), a typed per-slot choice head, and a lightweight GroupCalibration relation head (1.61M) consuming marker hidden states, pooled context, resource-requirement profiles and symmetrized outer-product conflict features, with all objectives optimized in one joint loss. Execution relation thus becomes a decision-layer quantity predicted by the same forward pass that reads the utterance. The model is the authors' own narrow calibrated decision model; Jev is not used.
summary.zh: 车载语音助手不仅要判断话语包含哪些意图,还要判断共现意图如何执行:并行、按序还是互斥。Voyag(零束科技)是单次前向的决策模型,联合预测十个受控车辆意图槽,以及每对共现意图的三值执行关系(并行、顺序、互斥)。它由多语言 ModernBERT 式编码器(mmBERT-base,306.9M)、逐槽 typed 选择头和一个轻量 GroupCalibration 关系头(1.61M)组成,关系头吃进标记隐状态、池化上下文、资源需求画像与对称外积冲突特征,全部目标在一个联合损失中优化。执行关系由此成为由同一次前向预测的决策层量。模型为作者自建的窄域校准决策模型;未使用 Jev。

problem.en: Can one forward pass decide both which intents are present and how they may execute together?
problem.zh: 能否一次前向同时判定存在哪些意图、以及它们能否共同执行?

papers.title: PixelOne: From Options to Pixels in a Single Forward for GUI Grounding

summary.en: GUI grounding needs precise clicks at low latency. Recent one-forward models such as GUI-Decisions and GUI-Swift predict coordinates with fixed global bins plus local refinement, but screenshot downsampling destroys the detail needed to locate small controls while fixed bins cover larger pixel ranges at higher resolutions. PixelOne (Fudan, JD.com, Shanghai Innovation Institute) transfers spatial knowledge from a search teacher to a student that predicts clicks directly from native-resolution screenshots: the teacher uses VideoJEV's text-option scorer to select rows and columns and progressively zoom into candidate regions; the student inherits the teacher's parameters and matches its distributions over explored regions through spatial distillation alongside box supervision. At inference one decision head selects a visual token and a lightweight pixel head predicts the click within it - all in a single forward pass. The teacher is the open VideoJEV scorer; hosted Jev is not used.
summary.zh: GUI 定位要求低延迟下的精确点击。GUI-Decisions、GUI-Swift 等单次前向模型用固定全局分箱加局部细化预测坐标,但截图降采样会抹掉定位小控件所需的细节,分辨率升高时固定分箱又要覆盖更大像素范围。PixelOne(复旦、京东、上海创新研究院)把搜索教师的空间知识迁移给直接从原生分辨率截图预测点击的学生:教师用 VideoJEV 的文本-选项打分器选行选列、逐步放大候选区域;学生继承教师参数,通过空间蒸馏加框监督匹配教师在探索区域上的分布。推理时同一个决策头选出视觉 token,轻量像素头在其内预测点击——全部一次前向完成。教师是开放的 VideoJEV 打分器;未使用托管 Jev。

problem.zh: 能否一次前向就在原生分辨率截图上定位精确点击?

papers.title: AdaptRouter: Adaptive Routing across Evolving Tasks and Models

summary.en: Model routers are either untrained for the pool at hand or fit once and forget earlier tasks when updated. AdaptRouter trains an adaptive router by policy learning: a compact multimodal decision model (StartLux or a JevAny-style router, both 0.8B) reads each question with cards describing the current experts and learns from native task feedback, without routing labels, to select one frozen expert. Open-weight and API experts share the router and its quality-cost trade-off but use different losses - cheap open-weight experts are explored with RL, paid API experts are queried once and their cached feedback reused as soft labels. New tasks are learned without replay, new experts enter as cards, and an open-weight quality-first advantage provably keeps cost from overriding quality. The router backbones evaluated (JevAny-4B and StartLux variants) are open-weight; hosted Jev is not used.
summary.zh: 模型路由器要么没针对当前模型池训练过,要么一经更新就遗忘旧任务。AdaptRouter 用策略学习训练自适应路由器:一个紧凑的多模态决策模型(StartLux 或 JevAny 式路由器,均为 0.8B)读入问题与描述当前专家的卡片,从任务原生反馈中学习选择一个冻结专家,无需路由标注。开放权重与 API 专家共用路由器与质量-成本权衡但损失不同——便宜的开放权重专家用 RL 探索,付费 API 专家只查询一次并把缓存反馈复用为软标签。新任务无需回放即可学会,新专家以卡片形式接入,开放权重的质量优先优势可证明不让成本压倒质量。所评估的路由器底座(JevAny-4B 与 StartLux 变体)均为开放权重;未使用托管 Jev。

papers.title: UUBench: Understanding the Unspoken toward Full-Duplex Multimodal Interaction
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
China University of Mining and Technology-Beijing
Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
King Abdullah University of Science and Technology

summary.en: Real-time full-duplex multimodal interaction requires systems to understand not only what users say but the needs conveyed through prosody, expressions, gestures and context, and existing evaluations cannot tell whether systems translate that understanding into effective responses. UUBench (a 15-institution consortium led by Great Bay University and HKUST-Guangzhou) introduces Process-Oriented Scoring that grounds the assessment of intent fulfillment in observable auditory and visual cues, with hosted Jev (TypeSafe AI) as the decision-model scorer: Jev retains the full user context, rates one quality criterion per request using the primitive labels and applicability conditions the benchmark fixes, and scores both outcome-oriented criteria under audio, visual and audiovisual observation conditions and process-oriented scores over aligned utterances and time-localized visual observations. Nine systems are compared on 216 shared inputs (1,944 scored outcomes). The consortium positions the release as a v0.1 preview.
summary.zh: 实时全双工多模态交互要求系统不仅听懂用户说了什么,还要理解韵律、表情、手势与上下文传达的需求,而既有评测无法判断系统是否把这种理解转化为有效回应。UUBench(大湾区大学与港科大广州牵头的 15 家机构联合)提出「面向过程的评分」:把意图满足程度的评估锚定在可观察的听觉与视觉线索上,并以托管 Jev(TypeSafe AI)作决策模型评分器——Jev 保留完整用户上下文,按基准固定的原语标签与适用条件,每次请求评一项质量标准,既在音频/视觉/视听三种观察条件下评结果导向标准,也对对齐语句与时间段化的视觉观察评过程分。九个系统在 216 个共享输入(1,944 个被评结果)上对比。联合体将其定位为 v0.1 预览版。

problem.zh: 如何评估交互系统是否真正回应用户未明说的沟通需求?

papers.title: When "A or B" Is Less Likely than A: Coherent Probabilities for Vision Decision Models

summary.en: Vision decision models answer a multiple-choice question with one probability per option, and software uses those numbers directly - but the probabilities depend on how options are grouped. This Korea University study shows a merged option "A or B" receives on average 11.5 points less probability than the sum of A and B, an under-additivity that appears at every model size from 0.85B to 26B and survives fine-tuning on labels. CORE (Coherent Regrouping) asks each training question with its options regrouped and trains the answers toward one target distribution over the original options; on 1,050 items from seven benchmarks it cuts the total-variation distance between a regrouped answer and the original answer summed into the same groups from 14.8 to 5.8 points on the 0.85B model, against 9.4 for the best baseline trained on the same data. Evaluated models are the open d3 family and the authors' LLM-as-Jev adaptations; hosted Jev is cited, not called.
summary.zh: 视觉决策模型对图像选择题给每个选项一个概率,软件直接使用这些数字——但概率竟取决于选项的分组方式。这项韩国大学的研究表明,合并选项「A 或 B」平均比 A 与 B 之和少拿 11.5 个百分点的概率,这种次可加性在 0.85B 到 26B 的所有模型规模上都出现,且在标签微调后依然存在。CORE(一致重分组)让每道训练题以重新分组的选项形式提问,并把答案训练到原始选项上的同一目标分布;在七个基准的 1,050 道题上,0.85B 模型的重分组答案与原始答案按同组求和之间的总变差距离从 14.8 降到 5.8 个点,而用同样数据训练的最佳基线为 9.4。受测模型为开放的 d3 家族与作者的 LLM-as-Jev 改造;托管 Jev 仅被引用,未被调用。

problem.zh: 为什么「A 或 B」的概率低于 A 加 B,训练能否修复?

papers.title: S1Arena-MM: Which Multimodal Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin

summary.en: Perception systems make discrete decisions - flag a hateful meme, predict whether a pedestrian will cross, detect a spoofed voice, pick the next game move - but which of these can System-1 models handle, and where do MLLMs do better? S1Arena-MM (UT Austin) gives every model the same decision requests and scores the probabilities returned: 51,060 questions across 94 tasks with image, video and audio input from 94 public datasets plus three program-generated ones, and 102 closed-loop game environments the model plays from screenshots - in real-time mode the game continues while the model decides. Thirty-three open models are evaluated, spanning System-1 families (OneJev, Jev-Omni, d3, Clef and others) and MLLM bases; findings include that accurate MLLMs pass the best System-1 models only slightly, thinking raises most MLLMs' Brier score, and closed loops separate the models sharply. Jev is cited via its 1.13.0 model-card reference; hosted Jev itself is not evaluated.
summary.zh: 感知系统做的是离散决策——标记仇恨表情包、预测行人是否过马路、检测伪造语音、选下一步棋——但其中哪些交给 System-1 模型就行、哪些 MLLM 更强?S1Arena-MM(得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校)给每个模型同样的决策请求并为其返回的概率打分:51,060 道题覆盖 94 个图像/视频/音频任务(来自 94 个公开数据集与 3 个程序生成集),另有 102 个从截图游玩的闭环游戏环境——实时模式下模型思考时游戏照常进行。共评估 33 个开放模型,涵盖 System-1 家族(OneJev、Jev-Omni、d3、Clef 等)与 MLLM 底座;发现包括:准确的 MLLM 只略胜最佳 System-1 模型,思考反而抬高多数 MLLM 的 Brier 分数,闭环环境把模型差距拉得很开。Jev 经 1.13.0 模型卡引用;托管 Jev 本体未被评估。

papers.title: Layer-Level Control of Language Model Execution in Agent Frameworks

summary.en: Agent frameworks orchestrate language models only through prompt-and-response interfaces, so computation cannot be allocated inside the model. This Huawei prototype exposes intermediate model states and layer-level execution controls to the agent runtime: it learns stitching bridges and state-conditioned execution policies from paired model states, then at inference selects among continue, exit and stitch. Dispatcher supervision picks the least-computation action whose full-vocabulary next-token prediction matches the source model's full-depth prediction; components are trained on a frozen proxy corpus of 5,000 typed-decision items and evaluated on the 231-item public JevBench v1.2 subset, measuring task accuracy, agreement with full-model predictions and end-to-end latency (for example, all 92 items departing at layer 26 are stitched). The evaluated benchmark is public JevBench; hosted Jev is not used.
summary.zh: 智能体框架只通过「提示-响应」接口编排语言模型,无法在模型内部调配算力。这个华为原型把中间模型状态与层级执行控制暴露给智能体运行时:从成对模型状态学习拼接桥与状态条件化执行策略,推理时在「继续/退出/拼接」中选择。调度器监督选取「全词表下一 token 预测与源模型全深度预测一致」的最省算力动作;组件在 5,000 条类型化决策项的冻结代理语料上训练,并在 231 条公开 JevBench v1.2 子集上评估任务准确率、与全模型预测的一致率和端到端延迟(例如在第 26 层离开的 92 条全部被拼接)。评估用的是公开 JevBench;未使用托管 Jev。

papers.title: DeciForm: Incorporating Task Structure into Decision Models

summary.en: Decision models unify candidate selection, Boolean judgment and numerical scoring behind one interface, yet their answer spaces carry different structure: classification candidates form an unordered set while scores have intrinsic order and distance. DeciForm builds those distinctions into computation and supervision - candidate-free queries and isolated candidate branches keep classification consistent under reordering, a log-spherical objective trains candidate probabilities, and a decimal-prefix readout combines individual-value and interval-weighted cumulative supervision for scoring. Shared adapters, task-private residuals and output-channel gains support joint adaptation; on a shared 15,000-request test set DeciForm improves all three decision metrics on Qwen and ModernBERT backbones. Code is available at github.com/roytian1992/DeciForm. Hosted Jev is cited for the interface; the models are the authors' own.
summary.zh: 决策模型把候选选择、布尔判断与数值打分统一在一个接口后面,但答案空间的结构并不相同:分类候选是无序集合,分数却有内在的顺序与距离。DeciForm 把这些差别做进计算与监督——无候选查询与隔离的候选分支让分类在重排下保持一致,log-spherical 目标函数训练候选概率,十进制前缀读出把逐值监督与区间加权累积监督结合起来做打分;共享适配器、任务私有残差与输出通道增益支撑联合适配。在共享的 15,000 条请求测试集上,DeciForm 在 Qwen 与 ModernBERT 两个底座上同时改善三类决策指标。代码见 github.com/roytian1992/DeciForm。托管 Jev 仅作接口引文;模型均为作者自训。

papers.title: MolReJev: Decision Models Are In-Context Molecular Predictors

summary.en: Molecular prediction needs cross-task generalization that specialized predictors lack, while token-by-token language models add inference cost. This NUS team proposes MolReJev, which combines Jev-style candidate scoring with in-context learning on a language model: it retrieves similar labeled examples from existing task data and scores candidate labels jointly in one forward pass. In-context learning improves predictions from both the released general-purpose Kev checkpoint and the separately trained MolReJev; for the trained model, gains span all evaluation groups including held-out tasks, and extend to compounds absent from training. The scoring head is the open Kev/MolReJev stack - hosted Jev is not called.
summary.zh: 分子预测需要专用预测器缺乏的跨任务泛化,而逐 token 的语言模型又引入推理开销。这支 NUS 团队提出 MolReJev:把 Jev 式候选打分与语言模型上的上下文学习结合,从既有任务数据检索相似标注示例,并在一次前向中联合为候选标签打分。上下文学习对已发布的通用 Kev 检查点与单独训练的 MolReJev 都有提升;对训练后的模型,增益覆盖包括留出任务在内的全部评估组,并延伸到训练中未见过的化合物。打分头是开放的 Kev/MolReJev 技术栈——未调用托管 Jev。

papers.title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
affiliations: A*STAR Centre for Frontier AI Research

summary.en: Computer-use agents perceive the screen through discrete snapshots, and VLM inference latency in live environments opens a perception-action gap where observed state goes stale before the action executes. NightWatch (NUS, A*STAR CFAR, SenseTime, HKBU) is a plug-and-play framework giving any CUA continuous, temporally grounded perception without changing its model, prompt or action space: NightWatch-0.8B, a lightweight System-1 model, streams monitoring of interface state and keeps the agent synchronized, raising proactive awareness of the environment. Baselines include a pixel-rules watcher and a closed System-1 Jev API watcher (0.59 s per check); NightWatch-0.8B answers in 0.25 s per check and substantially outperforms both watchers on the framework's benchmarks while costing far less than the 30x-larger D3-27B (7.6 s per call). Code, model and data are released.
summary.zh: 计算机操作智能体靠离散截图感知屏幕,而实时环境里 VLM 的推理延迟造成「感知-行动」鸿沟:观察到的状态在动作执行前就已过期。NightWatch(新加坡国立、A*STAR CFAR、商汤、浸会大学)是即插即用框架,在不改智能体模型、提示或动作空间的前提下为其提供连续、有时间锚点的感知:轻量 System-1 模型 NightWatch-0.8B 流式监控界面状态,让智能体与环境保持同步、提升前瞻意识。基线包括像素规则监视器与闭源 System-1 的 Jev API 监视器(每次检查 0.59 秒);NightWatch-0.8B 每次检查 0.25 秒,在框架基准上大幅超过两种监视器,又远比大 30 倍的 D3-27B(每次调用 7.6 秒)便宜。代码、模型与数据已开源。

problem.en: How can a computer-use agent keep its view of a changing screen from going stale between snapshots?
problem.zh: 计算机操作智能体如何避免两次截图之间屏幕认知过期?

papers.title: OmniDecisionBench: Evaluating and Benchmarking the Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models

summary.en: Multimodal System One models had been probed only on narrow task slices, so nobody could say where they beat general VLMs or where their reliability ends. This Jilin University benchmark assigns 45 datasets (192,975 records) to five capability families and twelve primary angles across four typed interfaces, scoring accuracy and candidate-probability calibration, and adds a validation layer with single-factor diagnostics that vary visual presentation, textual evidence sufficiency and target dataset. Across hosted Jev 1.14 (TypeSafe AI), open-weight JEV-27B-VL and d3-27B versus two general VLMs, three regularities emerge: System One models lead discrete tasks with lower ECE15 on most perception, reading and reasoning angles (Jev 1.14: 80.14% accuracy, 4.50% ECE15) while VLMs lead ordinal grading and Box grounding; reliability shifts with the input, with option-only rendering nearly tripling Jev 1.14's selective risk; and risk cutoffs estimated on donor datasets often fail to transfer. The stated code repository (Glax147/OmniDecisionBench) 404s at review time.
summary.zh: 多模态 System One 模型此前只在狭窄任务切片上被测过,没人能说清它们在哪里胜过通用 VLM、可靠性又到哪里为止。这项吉林大学的基准把 45 个数据集(192,975 条)按四类 typed 接口分到五个能力族与十二个主角度,同时评准确率与候选概率校准,并加一层单因素诊断验证(改变视觉呈现、文本证据充分性与目标数据集)。在托管 Jev 1.14(TypeSafe AI)、开放权重 JEV-27B-VL 与 d3-27B 对两款通用 VLM 的对比中得出三条规律:System One 在多数感知、阅读与推理角度上以更低 ECE15 领先离散任务(Jev 1.14:80.14% 准确率、4.50% ECE15),VLM 则在有序分级与 Box 定位上占优;可靠性随输入形态漂移,仅渲染选项就把 Jev 1.14 的选择性风险放大近三倍;在供体数据集上估的风险阈值往往无法迁移。论文声称的代码仓库(Glax147/OmniDecisionBench)审阅时 404。

problem.en: Where exactly do multimodal System One models beat general VLMs, and where does their reliability end?
problem.zh: 多模态 System One 模型究竟在哪些方面胜过通用 VLM,可靠性边界又在哪里?

papers.title: NavDecision: Parallel Multi-Step Action Prediction with Persistent Self-Referential Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
affiliations: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
University of Science and Technology Beijing
Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

summary.en: Autoregressive VLN models generate action descriptions token by token, adding latency; decision models are fast but struggle with short-horizon action coherence and long-horizon goal alignment. NavDecision (CASIA, USTB, BUPT) introduces parallel multi-step action prediction (PMAP) to predict multiple action distributions from a shared vision-language state, and memory-augmented self-referential policy optimization (M-SRPO) that learns from unsuccessful trajectories using successful ones as references, with a cross-iteration success memory accumulating historical trajectories for training feedback. Built on the open OmniJev stack with a Qwen3.5-4B backbone, NavDecision reports state-of-the-art results with lower latency on standard VLN benchmarks.
summary.zh: 自回归的视觉-语言导航模型逐 token 生成动作描述带来延迟;决策模型虽快,却难以兼顾短时动作连贯与长程目标对齐。NavDecision(中科院自动化所、北京科技大学、北邮)提出并行多步动作预测(PMAP):从共享的视觉-语言状态一次预测多个动作分布;以及记忆增强的自参照策略优化(M-SRPO):用成功轨迹作参照从失败轨迹中学习,配合跨迭代成功记忆积累历史轨迹提供训练反馈。模型构建在开放的 OmniJev 技术栈与 Qwen3.5-4B 底座上,在标准 VLN 基准上以更低延迟报告了领先结果。

problem.en: Can a decision model navigate coherently over many steps without autoregressive action decoding?
problem.zh: 决策模型能否不经自回归动作解码,就连贯地完成多步导航?

papers.title: JevNavAgent: A Single-Forward Visual Navigation Agent with Trajectory-Level RL for Gigapixel Pathology

summary.en: Gigapixel whole-slide images exceed single-pass VLM capacity at cellular resolution, while multiple instance learning relies on query-agnostic offline patching; multi-step VLM navigation agents inspect regions on demand but autoregressive action decoding throttles exploration and online RL, and offline distillation suffers an existential-versus-universal stopping asymmetry. Under the Jev (System One) paradigm - distributions over predefined decision spaces in one forward pass, with deterministic code executing navigation - this Fudan team builds JevNavAgent, a 2B-parameter agent with factorized stopping, spatial-candidate and confirmation heads. Trajectory-level RL trains it online; on Clean Visual WSI-VQA it reaches 51.57% multi-scale overall accuracy with screening-mode gains, at a fraction of VLM-agent latency. The paradigm and its name derive from Jev; hosted Jev is not called.
summary.zh: 千兆像素全切片图像超出单次 VLM 容量,多实例学习又依赖与查询无关的离线切块;多步 VLM 导航智能体虽可按需查看区域,但自回归动作解码拖慢探索与在线 RL,离线蒸馏还受「存在性对普遍性」的停止不对称之苦。在 Jev(System One)范式下——一次前向输出预定义决策空间上的分布、确定性代码执行导航——这支复旦团队构建了 2B 参数的 JevNavAgent,配备因子化的停止、空间候选与确认头,用轨迹级 RL 在线训练;在 Clean Visual WSI-VQA 上多尺度总体准确率 51.57%,筛查模式亦有增益,延迟远低于 VLM 智能体。范式与命名源自 Jev;未调用托管 Jev。

papers.title: Legal Is Not Good: A Pre-Registered Benchmark of Low-Cost Language and Decision Models on a New Strategy Game

summary.en: Carrying the 'Measure Before You Train' method to a second domain, this independent researcher asks a deliberately modest question: how well do low-cost agents play a turn-based strategy game under a protocol fixed in advance? hexfolk is a minimal two-player 4X game written for the purpose - no model has seen its rules or positions - with a deterministic engine, one agent interface, a referee that never corrects an illegal or late move, and per-decision logs making every game replayable; questions and expected answers were committed before the games on held-out seeds with mirrored seats and 95% Wilson intervals. Two small open language models (8B and 3B) lose every game to a few-line rule player, and answering in free text they are invalid on the large majority of decisions; low-cost decision models fare comparably poorly under the same pre-registered protocol. Engine, harness, agents and protocol are at github.com/federicolucca/hexfolk (tag bench-v1).
summary.zh: 把「训练之前先测量」方法带到第二个领域,这位独立研究者问了个刻意保守的问题:低成本智能体在预先固定的协议下,回合制策略游戏玩得如何?hexfolk 是为此写的极简双人 4X 游戏——任何模型都没见过它的规则与局面——带确定性引擎、统一智能体接口、从不纠正违规或超时走子的裁判,以及让每局可重放的逐决策日志;问题与期望答案都在对局前按留出种子与镜像座位提交,报告 95% Wilson 区间。两个小型开放语言模型(8B 与 3B)输给了几行规则玩家全部对局,自由文本作答时绝大多数决策无效;低成本决策模型在同一预注册协议下同样表现不佳。引擎、测试框架、智能体与协议在 github.com/federicolucca/hexfolk(tag bench-v1)。

problem.zh: 低成本智能体在预注册协议下玩全新策略游戏到底有多差?

papers.title: When to Test, Repair, or Regenerate: Decision-Guided Efficient RTL Generation
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: LLM agents that refine register-transfer-level designs usually lean on simulation feedback, but without a reference testbench, generating one for every initial implementation costs inference even when the RTL is already correct. This Southeast/HKUST/Sheffield harness gives the orchestrating role to a specialized decision model - hosted Jev in the base configuration, compared against the OpenAI Decisions API and a general-purpose DeepSeek judge for selective early stopping. The controller accepts high-scoring initial implementations as soon as they compile and generates testbenches only for the rest; when further search is needed, the initial decision score allocates budget between repair and independent regeneration, Jev defect-hypothesis scores (one per error category, twelve in the paper's example) rank what to repair alongside simulation feedback, and final selection prioritizes test-passing candidates ranked by decision-model scores. A preliminary Jev-based error-category evaluation on MAEDA (macro-F1 86.01% across five categories, 300 examples) motivated the defect mechanism. With DeepSeek as the generator, the harness improves mean Pass@1 by 5.4-7.1 points across three benchmarks while cutting estimated aggregate inference cost by 11.0-14.3% against a testbench-guided repair baseline under the same candidate cap.
summary.zh: 用 LLM 生成寄存器传输级(RTL)设计的智能体通常靠仿真反馈做细化,但在没有参考测试平台时,为每个初始实现都生成一套测试平台,即使 RTL 已经正确也要付推理成本。这个东南大学/港科大/谢菲尔德的流程把调度权交给专用决策模型——基础配置用托管 Jev,并与 OpenAI Decisions API 及通用 DeepSeek 裁判在「选择性提前停止」上对比:控制器对编译通过且得分高的初始实现直接接受,只为其余生成测试平台;需要继续搜索时,初始决策分数在「修复 vs 重新生成」之间分配预算,Jev 的缺陷假设打分(每类错误一个,论文示例为 12 个)与仿真反馈一起决定修什么;最终选择优先取通过测试的候选,再用决策模型分数排序。在 MAEDA 上的 Jev 式错误类别初评(五个类别、300 例、macro-F1 86.01%)启发了缺陷机制。以 DeepSeek 为生成器,该流程在三个基准上将平均 Pass@1 提高 5.4–7.1 个点,同时把估计总推理成本较同等候选上限的测试平台引导修复基线降低 11.0–14.3%。

problem.en: When an LLM-generated RTL design might already be correct, is generating a testbench for every candidate worth the cost?
problem.zh: 当 LLM 生成的 RTL 设计可能已经正确时,为每个候选都生成测试平台值得吗?

papers.title: LoopSeek: Decoupling System One Search from System Two Answering for Long Video Understanding

summary.en: Long-video question answering needs evidence found before it can be reasoned over, but single-pass frame selection can miss critical evidence and adaptive search usually burns budget on repeated text generation. LoopSeek decouples evidence search from answer generation through a System One / System Two division of labor: search is expressed as a sequence of small typed decisions, letting four non-thinking System I role agents (controller, verifier, locator, selector) navigate a tree of video windows and coordinate through probability outputs to select frames, assess evidence and revise the search without generating any text. System I is three LoRA adapters on a frozen OneJev-4B, OmniJev's open multimodal System One decision model; it trains from annotated evidence on questions that System II answers correctly only from that evidence, while the verifier's evidence estimates steer the search. A frozen Qwen3-VL-8B answers once from the selected 32 frames. Across five long-video benchmarks LoopSeek improves average accuracy from 53.5 to 63.9 over the uniform baseline and takes 32-80% less GPU time per question than agentic methods. Hosted Jev is not used; the Jev blog post is cited for the System One paradigm.
summary.zh: 长视频问答先要找到证据才能推理,但单次前向的选帧可能漏掉关键证据,自适应搜索又依赖反复生成文本来决定看哪里。LoopSeek 用 System One/System Two 分工把证据搜索与答案生成解耦:搜索被表达为一串小型类型化决策,四个非思考的 System I 角色智能体(控制器/校验器/定位器/选择器)在视频窗口树上导航,只靠概率输出协调,完成选帧、评估证据、修正搜索,全程不生成文本。System I 是冻结 OneJev-4B(OmniJev 的开源多模态 System One 决策模型)上的三个 LoRA 适配器;训练数据来自「System II 仅凭该证据才能答对」的问题的标注证据,校验器的证据估计在推理时引导搜索。冻结的 Qwen3-VL-8B 从选出的 32 帧一次性作答。在五个长视频基准上,LoopSeek 相对均匀采样把平均准确率从 53.5 提到 63.9,每题 GPU 时间比智能体式方法少 32–80%。未使用托管 Jev;Jev 博文仅作为 System One 范式的出处被引用。

problem.zh: 长视频智能体如何在每一步不为文本生成买单的情况下搜索证据?

papers.title: Where the Image Sits: Vision-Text Order Bias in Jev
affiliations: Hong Kong Institute of Science & Innovation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: Jev-style system-1 decision models read a choice from a single prefill - the next-token distribution is restricted to the supplied option labels, with no generation and no parsing. Generative vision-language models are known to be sensitive to the relative order of image and text tokens; this single-author study asks whether that sensitivity reaches the Jev-style readout, where the answer is always read at the end of the prompt so moving the image changes the distance from visual evidence to the decision but never the readout position. Using four placements (prefix, pre-question, pre-options, suffix) with the option listing held fixed, across Qwen3-VL-2B/4B/8B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Idefics3-8B, LLaVA-OneVision-7B and LLaVA-NeXT-7B run locally, suffix placement flips 41.0% of decisions and lowers accuracy by 18.6 points; the curve is monotone rather than U-shaped, unlike prior results on generative VLMs, and the effect survives token-distance, subset-sampling and readout-choice controls. A prefix-question averaging (P+Q) readout that averages two forward passes is at least as accurate as prefix and outperforms prior baselines. Hosted Jev is not called; Visual Jev and PixelJev are cited as the interface's multimodal relatives. The repository stated in the abstract (Youzhi333/Visual_Tex_Order_Bias_Jev) returned 404 at review time and is not recorded.
summary.zh: Jev 式 system-1 决策模型从单次 prefill 中读出选择——把 next-token 分布限制在给定选项标签上,不生成、不解析。生成式视觉语言模型已知对图文 token 的相对顺序敏感;这项单作者研究追问这种敏感性是否同样到达 Jev 式读出:答案永远在提示末尾读取,移动图像改变的是视觉证据到决策的距离,而非读取位置。在四种放置(前缀/问题前/选项前/后缀)、选项列表固定的设置下,对本地运行的 Qwen3-VL-2B/4B/8B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Idefics3-8B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B、LLaVA-NeXT-7B 测量:后缀放置翻转 41.0% 的决策、准确率降 18.6 个点;曲线单调而非 U 形,与生成式 VLM 上的已有结论不同;效应经 token 距离、子集采样、读出方式等对照后依然成立。提出的「前缀-问题平均」(P+Q)两次前向读出至少与前缀一样准,并优于既有基线。全文未调用托管 Jev;Visual Jev 与 PixelJev 作为该接口的多模态近亲被引用。摘要中给出的代码仓库(Youzhi333/Visual_Tex_Order_Bias_Jev)审阅时404,未予记录。

problem.en: Does the order of image and text tokens change what a Jev-style decision readout decides?
problem.zh: 图像与文本 token 的顺序会改变 Jev 式决策读出的判断吗?

papers.title: Decision models for UAVBench and the viability of edge deployment

summary.en: A benchmark score does not tell us whether a model will actually run on the edge computer a drone carries. On UAVBench's 2,000 validated multiple-choice questions, this InferLink study evaluates 24 model configurations on an ordinary Mac: 20 size-and-precision configurations of 11 generative models plus four open-weight structured decision models (GLiDE 0.4B and 0.8B, Liquid d1 2B, H2O Lightning 4B) that received no UAVBench-specific training. H2O Lightning 4B achieves the highest accuracy observed, 77.65% on the Mac - above the benchmark authors' hosted Gemini 2.5 Flash at 76.75% - showing small decision models suit these tasks. The paper explicitly does not evaluate the commercial Jev model itself, framing GLiDE, Liquid d1 and H2O as releases of the same interface rather than reproductions of Jev's undisclosed implementation. Deploying the decision models to a Qualcomm RB3 Gen 2 board hits conversion and runtime limits described in detail (H2O completed only a 100-question diagnostic; GLiDE and Liquid d1 could not run at all). Matched Mac-RB3 runs of two generative models preserve ranking but not individual answers, so local screening shortlists candidates while final testing stays on the target hardware.
summary.zh: 基准分数并不能说明模型能否真正跑在无人机携带的边缘计算机上。这项 InferLink 研究在 UAVBench 的 2,000 道经过校验的多选题上,于普通 Mac 上评测 24 种模型配置:11 个生成式模型的20 种规模-精度组合,加上四个未经 UAVBench 定制训练的开放权重结构化决策模型(GLiDE 0.4B/0.8B、Liquid d1 2B、H2O Lightning 4B)。H2O Lightning 4B 拿到全场最高准确率 77.65%,高于基准原作者用托管版测出的 Gemini 2.5 Flash(76.75%),说明小型决策模型很适合这类任务。论文明确不评测商业 Jev 本身,并把 GLiDE、Liquid d1、H2O 定位为同一接口的开放发布而非对 Jev 未公开实现的复现。把决策模型部署到 Qualcomm RB3 Gen 2 开发板则遇到详细记录的转换与运行时限制(H2O 只完成了 100 题诊断;GLiDE 与 Liquid d1 完全跑不起来)。两个生成式模型在 Mac 与 RB3 上的配对评测保排名不保答案,因此本地筛选可列候选名单,最终测试仍须在目标硬件上进行。

problem.en: Will a model that scores well on a UAV decision benchmark actually run, and run usefully, on an edge computer?

papers.title: Decision Columns as an Index: Interpretable Embeddings for Explainable Entity Matching and Search

summary.en: As agents begin to act on business records, entity matching and retrieval need reasons a person can check, but dense embeddings are opaque coordinates that cannot be filtered by meaning and require corpus re-encoding to add a property. This Microsoft paper proposes interpretable embeddings built from decision columns: each column stores a decision model's calibrated answer to a natural-language question over the record, with outcomes yes, no or not stated, so a record's vector is its answers across an ordered question space and every similarity score decomposes exactly into per-question contributions. New questions add coordinates without re-encoding existing ones, and questions derived from retrieval failures triple mean reciprocal rank. The answering model is Microsoft's Decision 1 (MD1) alongside gpt-6-luna as a generative comparison; hosted Jev is not used. On WDC Products and STaRK-Amazon, question-space retrieval statistically matches dense candidate generation in a retrieve-then-verify matcher while explaining every accepted match, and one small MLP predicts the full interpretable vector from an existing dense embedding, backfilling a corpus from a few thousand labeled rows at roughly 1/200 the cost.
summary.zh: 当智能体开始在业务记录上行动,实体匹配与检索都需要人可核查的理由,而稠密嵌入是不透明的坐标,既不能按语义过滤,新增属性还要重编码整个语料。这篇微软论文提出由「决策列」构成的可解释嵌入:每一列存一个决策模型对某条自然语言问题给出的校准答案(是/否/未提及),记录的向量就是它在一组有序问题空间上的答案,任意相似度分数都能精确分解到每个问题的贡献。新增问题只增加坐标、不改写既有答案;从检索失败反推的问题让 MRR 翻三倍。应答模型是微软的 Decision 1(MD1),并以 gpt-6-luna 作生成式对照;未使用托管 Jev。在 WDC Products 与 STaRK-Amazon 上,问题空间检索在「检索后验证」的实体匹配器中与稠密候选生成统计持平,且对每个接受的匹配给出精确解释;一个小型 MLP 从既有稠密嵌入预测完整可解释向量,用几千行标注就能以约 1/200 的成本回填百万行语料。

papers.title: Decision Models for Multilingual Emotion Classification: A Comparative Study Against LLMs and Encoders
affiliations: Sirio – Research & Innovation, Sidea Group, Bari, Italy

summary.en: Decision models receive a question with a closed list of answers and return a probability for each answer; they promise low latency and robustness to prompt wording, but no study had compared several of them with fine-tuned encoders across languages. This one asks whether zero-shot systems can replace fine-tuning and what the decision format adds over a general-purpose LLM. Given Italian instructions, three decision models (Jev - TypeSafe's closed API, run as jev-latest and confirmed as jev-1.13.0 - OpenAI Decisions, Strands Decider 2B) and two LLMs (GPT-6 Luna, Qwen3.5-2B) are compared with two fine-tuned multilingual encoders (tabularisai, XLM-EMO) on joy, sadness, anger and fear in 10 social-media datasets across five languages, with paired difference and equivalence tests. The three best zero-shot systems - Jev, OpenAI Decisions and GPT-6 Luna, averaging 0.708, 0.707 and 0.706 macro-F1 - score about one point below an encoder fine-tuned on the target dataset (a 4-5 point gap cannot be excluded, and on single datasets either side wins by up to 22 points) and beat by 8-15 points encoders fine-tuned on another dataset. OpenAI's decision endpoint matches GPT-6 Luna at a fifth of its median latency, and the 2B decision model beats a same-size general LLM by 10 points owing to its training rather than the decision format; the best zero-shot systems vary by about one point across prompts.
summary.zh: 决策模型接收一个带有封闭答案列表的问题,并为每个答案返回一个概率;它们承诺低时延与对提示措辞的鲁棒性,但此前没有研究把多个决策模型与微调编码器跨语言地比较过。本文追问零样本系统能否取代微调,以及决策格式相对通用 LLM 多带来了什么。在意大利语指令下,把三个决策模型(Jev——TypeSafe 的闭源 API,以 jev-latest 运行并确认为 jev-1.13.0;OpenAI Decisions;Strands Decider 2B)与两个 LLM(GPT-6 Luna、Qwen3.5-2B),同两个微调的多语言编码器(tabularisai、XLM-EMO)在 5 种语言、10 个社交媒体数据集的喜、悲、怒、惧四类情绪上比较,采用配对差异与等价性检验。表现最好的三个零样本系统——Jev、OpenAI Decisions、GPT-6 Luna,宏 F1 平均为 0.708、0.707、0.706——比在目标数据集上微调的编码器低约 1 个点(不能排除 4–5 个点的差距;在单个数据集上任何一方都可能领先最多 22 个点),比在别的数据集上微调的编码器高 8–15 个点。OpenAI 的决策接口以五分之一的中位时延追平其底座 GPT-6 Luna;20 亿参数的决策模型比同尺寸通用 LLM 高 10 个点,这归功于训练而非决策格式;最佳零样本系统在不同提示下约有 1 个点的波动。

problem.zh: 零样本决策模型能否跨语言取代微调编码器做情绪分类?

papers.title: Too Fast to Doubt? Skipping Reasoning Leaves Jev-like Models Vulnerable
affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University

summary.en: Fast decision models offer low-latency actions with explicit confidence; this paper asks whether that speed costs robustness to deceptive content. The authors build 1,440 paired synthetic browser tasks (six computation families, eight difficulty levels), each with a clean page and two poisoned variants that inject false conclusions or evidence interpretations through external comments, and evaluate four decision models on the same frozen benchmark: Jev 1.13, Jev 1.14, GPT-6 Luna Decisions and Microsoft Decision-1. Clean accuracy averages 91.0%, yet two-shot attack success reaches 81.2%, and mean expected calibration error rises from 2.6% on clean inputs to 36.7% under conclusion poisoning and 36.1% under evidence poisoning - so clean accuracy and calibration do not ensure reliable decisions under injection. On 48 matched tasks, low-effort GPT-6 Luna with a chain of thought averaging fewer than 30 reasoning tokens per response answers 95.83% of poisoned inputs correctly against 38.54% for Luna Decisions, the decision model sharing its base, while mean latency grows from 0.29 to 1.94 seconds: a sharp latency-robustness trade-off.
summary.zh: 快速决策模型以低时延给出动作和明确的置信度;本文追问这种速度是否以对欺骗性内容的鲁棒性为代价。作者构建了 1,440 组成对的合成浏览器任务(六类计算、八个难度级),每组有一张干净页面和两个被投毒的变体——通过外部评论注入错误结论或对证据的曲解——并在同一冻结基准上评测四个决策模型:Jev 1.13、Jev 1.14、GPT-6 Luna Decisions 与 Microsoft Decision-1。干净输入上平均准确率 91.0%,但两步攻击的成功率达 81.2%;平均期望校准误差从干净输入的 2.6% 升到结论投毒下的 36.7%、证据投毒下的 36.1%——可见干净条件下的准确率与校准并不能保证注入下的决策可靠。在 48 个匹配任务上,带平均不到 30 个推理 token 思维链的低开销 GPT-6 Luna 对投毒输入的正确率为 95.83%,而与其同底座的决策模型 Luna Decisions 只有 38.54%,代价是平均时延从 0.29 秒增至 1.94 秒:时延与鲁棒性之间存在尖锐权衡。

problem.en: How vulnerable are fast decision models to false conclusions injected into web content?
problem.zh: 快速决策模型面对网页内容中注入的错误结论有多脆弱?

papers.title: Efficient Natural Language to Temporal Logic Translation for Real-Time Physical AI
affiliations: Automatic Control Laboratory, ETH Zürich, Switzerland

summary.en: Robots can be controlled with guaranteed correctness when task instructions are given in a formal language, and LLMs are usually asked to translate natural language into it - but on a robot, compute and energy are limited and offloading to the cloud may be infeasible. Noting that a formula in a fixed fragment follows a well-defined syntax, the authors ask whether text generation is needed at all: for linear temporal logic (LTL), the translation can be decomposed into a set of questions with predefined answers. They build the first family of NL-to-LTL translators on a System-One model rather than a generative LLM, using the open-weight Laya (421 million parameters, a ModernBERT-large encoder) as the base and fine-tuning it: a one-pass translator that replaces Laya's head with one head per question, and a level-by-level translator for requirements that need nested LTL formulas, with accuracy guarantees established for the pipelines. On three benchmarks the translators match or exceed the best local LLMs at up to an order of magnitude lower runtime and energy, make 3.6 times fewer errors than the most accurate fine-tuned LLM on Mine rover, generalize to unseen atomic propositions and temporal patterns, and run on embedded hardware such as a Raspberry Pi 5. Hosted Jev is mentioned only as the cloud-hosted alternative that is deliberately not used.
summary.zh: 当任务指令用形式语言给出时,可以保证机器人控制的正确性;通常由 LLM 把自然语言翻译成形式语言,但在机器人上算力与电能有限,把计算卸载到云端又可能不可行。注意到固定片段内的公式遵循明确的语法,作者追问是否根本需要文本生成:对于线性时序逻辑(LTL),翻译可以拆成一组答案预先确定的问题。他们构建了首个基于 System-One 模型而非生成式 LLM 的自然语言到 LTL 翻译器家族,以开放权重的 Laya(4.21 亿参数,ModernBERT-large 编码器)为底座并做微调:单次前向的翻译器用「每个问题一个头」替换 Laya 的输出头;层级式翻译器处理需要嵌套 LTL 公式表达的需求;并为各流程给出了准确性保证。在三个基准上,这些翻译器以最多低一个数量级的运行时间与能耗追平或超过最好的本地 LLM;在 Mine rover 上比最准的微调 LLM 少 3.6 倍错误;能泛化到训练中未见的原子命题与时序模式;可在树莓派 5 等嵌入式硬件上运行。托管 Jev 仅作为刻意不用的云端方案被提及。

problem.en: Does translating natural language into temporal logic on a robot need a generative LLM at all?
problem.zh: 在机器人上把自然语言翻译成时序逻辑,真的需要生成式 LLM 吗?

papers.title: WePM: Hierarchical Conflict Reconciliation for Unified MLLMs
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: Running multimodal intelligence on a device keeps sensitive data local and cuts inference cost, but deploying one specialized model per capability duplicates vision-language capacity under tight memory budgets. The paper formalizes heterogeneous capability density (HCD) - how broadly and effectively a model serves heterogeneous task families per unit of resident inference memory - and presents WePM, a family of pocket models that unifies representation, generation and decision in one Qwen3.5 vision-language backbone. Multi-Granularity Visual Budgeting splits a fixed visual-token budget across global, regional and fine-grained banks; Unified Listwise Knowledge Distillation enriches separately collected data with soft teacher guidance instead of cross-task paired annotation; and Stable and Efficient Multitask Optimization weights each task's loss with exposure schedules and sequential gradient accumulation. In the joint representation-generation setting WePM raises the Joint score from 38.15 to 52.74; in single-task evaluation WePM-4B averages 72.86 over 30 embedding, 62.41 over 39 generation and 61.11 over seven typed-decision benchmarks (S1MB, JevBench, Open-Jev, JevAny, Valen, DecisionBench), and against the separate-model stack with the highest HCD it achieves slightly higher balanced performance with 61.9% less resident weight memory. Decision-oriented tasks - schema-constrained option selection, ordinal scoring, binary judgment - are one of its three capability families; hosted Jev is described as background and not evaluated.
summary.zh: 把多模态智能放到设备端能让敏感数据留在本地并降低推理成本,但每种能力部署一个专用模型,会在紧张的内存预算下重复占用视觉语言容量。论文形式化了「异构能力密度」(HCD)——模型每单位常驻推理内存能多广、多好地服务异构任务族——并提出 WePM:一族把表示、生成与决策统一进同一个 Qwen3.5 视觉语言骨干的袖珍模型。多粒度视觉预算把固定的视觉 token 预算分给全局、区域与细粒度三组;统一列表知识蒸馏用教师的软标签充实各自采集的数据,免去跨任务配对标注;稳定高效的多任务优化通过曝光调度与顺序梯度累积为各任务损失加权。在表示—生成联合设定下,WePM 把联合分数从 38.15 提到 52.74;单项评测中 WePM-4B 在 30 个嵌入、39 个生成、7 个类型化决策基准(S1MB、JevBench、Open-Jev、JevAny、Valen、DecisionBench)上平均得 72.86、62.41、61.11;与 HCD 最高的分离模型栈相比,它以少 61.9% 的常驻权重内存取得略高的均衡性能。决策类任务(受 schema 约束的选项选择、有序打分、二元判断)是其三大能力族之一;托管 Jev 仅作为背景被介绍,未被评测。

papers.title: Bel: Step-Level Policy Improvement of Visual Agents Without Training

summary.en: A visual agent - tapping and typing on a screen, or pointing in a camera image for a robot - can fail its task on one wrong step, even when the right action is among its own samples, passed over by greedy decoding. The authors find that judging an action is itself a visual judgment: given the screenshot and a tap's coordinates, a decision model chooses among GUI-R1-3B's samples significantly worse on average than when the tap is drawn where it lands. Bel turns this into a method that trains nothing and needs only a frozen policy's samples and an image on which each action can be drawn: it marks every candidate on its own copy of that image, asks a decision model (Jev, called through its public API as jev-1.14, with the marked screenshot in the state) for the probability that executing it is the right decision - so every kind of action shares one scale - and acts on another candidate only when greedy scores below a threshold and trails it by a margin. On recorded GUI steps Bel significantly beats greedy decoding for each of three policies on mobile, web and desktop screens and, on the same candidates, gives each a higher mean step success than voting, CATTS, the trained GUI-Critic-R1 and two prompted Qwen3-VL judges; it also significantly improves the much larger Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B, raises live AndroidWorld and MiniWoB++ task success for two other policies, and improves robot pointing for three policies.
summary.zh: 视觉智能体——在屏幕上点按输入,或在相机图像里为机器人指点位——一步走错就可能任务失败,哪怕正确动作其实就在它自己的采样里,只是被贪心解码错过了。作者发现,评判一个动作本身就是一种视觉判断:只给截图与点按坐标时,决策模型在 GUI-R1-3B 的候选中做选择,平均显著差于把点按画在它落点的图上再判断。Bel 据此提出免训练方法,只需要冻结策略的采样和一张可以画出动作的图像:把每个候选动作标在各自的图像副本上,请决策模型(Jev,经公开 API 以 jev-1.14 调用,状态里带标注后的截图)给出「执行它是正确决策」的概率——于是各类动作共用一个尺度——只有当贪心动作低于阈值且落后某个差距时才改选他人。在录制的 GUI 步骤上,Bel 对三个策略在手机、网页、桌面屏幕上都显著优于贪心解码;在相同候选上,平均步骤成功率高于投票、CATTS、训练过的 GUI-Critic-R1 与两个提示式 Qwen3-VL 裁判;对大得多的 Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B 也有显著提升;在真实 AndroidWorld 与 MiniWoB++ 上提高了另外两个策略的任务成功率,并改进了三个策略的机器人指向。

papers.title: Decision Models Are General-Purpose Process Reward Models

summary.en: RL from verifiable outcomes gives a language agent one reward per episode, so every step is credited alike and nothing about the task is learned when all rollouts fail; step-level credit usually needs step labels, a learned critic, costly LLM judges or hand-written rules. DM-PRM turns a general-purpose decision model - hosted Jev 1.13, used as provided through its API - into a zero-shot process reward model: it asks one yes/no question per step and adds the standardised answers to the advantage, with no step labels, fine-tuning or critic. It plugs into any policy-gradient method, and one model with one question text per environment serves household tasks, web shopping and multiple RL methods. With Qwen2.5-1.5B it lifts GRPO by over twenty points on ALFWorld and over ten on WebShop, overtakes GiGPO on ALFWorld in far fewer iterations, improves GiGPO and GraphGPO on both benchmarks and reaches the highest success of the comparison, ahead of critic-based PPO and state-of-the-art variants; its scores locate useful steps inside failed rollouts, and trained agents drop idle actions and explore instead of circling.
summary.zh: 基于可验证结果的强化学习每个回合只给语言智能体一个奖励:每一步被同等记功,而所有 rollout 都失败时什么都学不到;步级信用分配通常需要步骤标签、学习得到的评论家、昂贵的 LLM 裁判或手写规则。DM-PRM 把通用决策模型——按原样经 API 使用的托管 Jev 1.13——变成零样本的过程奖励模型:每一步问一个是非题,把标准化后的答案加到优势里,不需要步骤标签、微调或评论家。它可接入任意策略梯度方法;一个模型、每个环境一段问题文本,就能服务家务任务、网页购物与多种强化学习方法。配合 Qwen2.5-1.5B,它让 GRPO 在 ALFWorld 上提升二十多个点、WebShop 上提升十多个点,在 ALFWorld 上以少得多的迭代超过 GiGPO,在两个基准上都改进了 GiGPO 与 GraphGPO,并取得对比中最高的成功率,领先基于评论家的 PPO 与多个最先进变体;其分数能在失败的 rollout 中定位有用的步骤,训练后的智能体会丢掉无意义的动作而不再原地打转。

papers.title: Same Facts, Different Decision: Fact-Invariant Manipulation and Provenance-Based Defense in Typed Decision Models
affiliations: China University of Mining and Technology

summary.en: Typed decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev answer only with a probability, an option or a score, but their inputs often carry text from outsiders - and prior attacks test that risk poorly: injected instructions rarely work on these models, and added facts can make a changed decision correct. The paper shows that outside comments alone can persuade these models into a wrong decision without adding any fact. LEVER writes such comments with four levers from argumentation theory, uses a separate verifier to discard any comment that adds a fact, and searches for effective comments guided by the model's output probabilities. On three benchmarks (BoolQ, MuSR, SST-5) it flips 34.7% of Jev's correct decisions - the main target is jev-1.13.0, queried through TypeSafe's API - which is 2.8 times as many fact-free successes as the strongest prior attack, and it flips 47-67% on five other models. The Provenance Gate defense accepts a changed decision only if the model reaches it again without the outside comments: it blocks every attack at the cost of at most one extra query and still accepts trusted updates.
summary.zh: TypeSafe Jev 这类类型化决策模型只回答概率、选项或分数,但它们的输入常常包含外来文本——而既有攻击对这一风险的检验并不得要领:注入的指令对这些模型基本无效,而添加事实又可能让改变后的决策反而是对的。本文表明,仅凭外部评论就能说服这类模型在不添加任何事实的情况下做出错误决策。LEVER 借论证理论的四种「杠杆」撰写这类评论,用独立的校验器丢弃任何引入新事实的评论,并在模型输出概率的引导下搜索有效评论。在三个基准(BoolQ、MuSR、SST-5)上,它翻转了 Jev 34.7% 的正确决策(主目标是经 TypeSafe API 查询的 jev-1.13.0),不计添事实的成功时是最强已有攻击的 2.8 倍;对另外五个模型翻转率为 47–67%。防御方案「来源门」(Provenance Gate)只有在去掉外部评论后模型仍得出同一决策时才接受该变更:它以至多一次额外查询的代价挡下全部攻击,同时仍接受可信的更新。

problem.en: Can outside text flip a typed decision model's answer without adding a single fact, and how can software defend?
problem.zh: 外部文本能否不添加任何事实就翻转类型化决策模型的判断?程序该如何防御?

papers.title: JevRisk: Zero-Shot Financial Risk Assessment with a Language Decision Model
affiliations: School of Computing and Artificial Intelligence, Southwestern University of Finance and Economics
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: A zero-shot system for banks' financial-risk assessment, such as anti-money-laundering customer risk rating and credit risk, where every label may need an expert review or months of repayment history. JevRisk works in two steps: code first computes exact risk indicators following regulatory guidelines, then a language decision model - hosted Jev (version jev-1.14.0), one call per customer - reads these indicators together with the customer's profile and an activity summary as structured text, judges the case in context and returns the probability of high risk (the product of its occupation-risk and customer-risk probabilities). It is evaluated on anti-money laundering with public synthetic Scotiabank data and on credit risk with real Home Credit and Lending Club data, where it outperforms rule-based and unsupervised methods and is on par with or better than supervised models (GBDT, TabPFN) trained on about a thousand labelled customers. Swapping in Qwen3.5-9B first-token probabilities, Clef-Flash or Jev-Omni gives lower AUC in the reported comparisons on the same cases and questions.
summary.zh: 面向银行金融风险(如反洗钱客户风险评级、信用风险)的零样本评估系统——这类任务的每个标签都可能需要专家复核或数月的还款记录。JevRisk 分两步:先用代码按监管指引算出精确的风险指标,再由语言决策模型——托管 Jev(版本 jev-1.14.0),每位客户一次调用——把这些指标连同客户画像与活动摘要组成的结构化文本一起读入,结合语境判断,并返回高风险的概率(职业高风险概率与客户高风险概率之积)。评测覆盖反洗钱(Scotiabank 公开合成数据)与信用风险(Home Credit、Lending Club 真实数据):JevRisk 优于基于规则与无监督的方法,与用约一千名已标注客户训练的有监督模型(GBDT、TabPFN)相当或更好。换成 Qwen3.5-9B 的首 token 概率、Clef-Flash 或 Jev-Omni 后,在相同案例与问题的对比中 AUC 更低。

problem.en: Can a bank rate a customer's financial risk without labelled training data?
problem.zh: 银行能否在没有标注数据的情况下评估客户的金融风险?
