papers.title: Reward Integrity in Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for LLM Guardrail Red-Teaming

summary.en: Studies reward fidelity inside an adversarial RL loop that red-teams guardrails for financial-services language models: an attack can look successful only because it omitted the personally identifiable information (PII) the task prescribed, or because the reward judge credited a reply that never broke the targeted policy. The authors add two reward-integrity checks. For presence verification, on attacker-generated and AdvPIIBench-derived examples, hosted TypeSafe Jev checks whether the prescribed PII is present and gets the highest balanced accuracy on both sets (97.3 and 98.3), ahead of Opus 4.8 and a GLM-OCR matcher. For policy-break scoring against logged Opus 4.8 judgements from a replay corpus, Jev, pretrained and post-trained Laya and pretrained CLM-8B are compared: Jev ranks well but its fixed decision threshold gives only 66.5% break recall, while post-training markedly improves Laya's agreement with the judge. On a separate author-reviewed off-target set that establishes Opus can award false wins, Jev rejects 223 of 274 cases. The findings motivate specialised decision-model judges for this loop.
summary.zh: 研究对抗式强化学习红队循环中的奖励保真度,对象是金融服务语言模型的护栏:一次攻击看似成功,可能只是因为它漏掉了任务规定必须包含的个人身份信息(PII),或者因为奖励裁判给一个并未违反目标策略的回复记了功。作者加入两项奖励完整性检查。存在性校验上(攻击器生成与 AdvPIIBench 派生的样本),托管 TypeSafe Jev 判断规定的 PII 是否存在,在两个集合上平衡准确率都最高(97.3 与 98.3),优于 Opus 4.8 与 GLM-OCR 匹配器。策略违反打分上(对照回放语料中记录的 Opus 4.8 判断),比较了 Jev、预训练与后训练的 Laya 以及预训练的 CLM-8B:Jev 排序表现很好,但固定的决策阈值使其违规召回率只有 66.5%;后训练显著提高了 Laya 与裁判的一致性。在一个经作者复核、证明 Opus 会给假胜的离靶集合上,Jev 拒绝了 274 例中的 223 例。结论是为这类循环配备专门的决策模型裁判。

problem.zh: 对抗式红队循环里的奖励裁判,能保证只给真实的护栏突破记功吗?

papers.title: Are Calibrated Decision Models Calibrated on Markets? Geolocated News, Markov Switching and a System One Model for Nasdaq-100 Allocation

summary.en: Tests whether Jev's reported calibration holds against real market outcomes. Every Friday from January 2025 the authors ask whether the Nasdaq-100 will close lower four weeks later, and compare three sources: a two-regime Markov-switching model estimated on 1990-2026 data, Jev (version jev-1.14) reading the week's most widely published headlines together with geolocated news features computed with PostGIS spatial queries, and a combination of the two. A knowledge probe places Jev's knowledge cutoff in late 2024, so it is evaluated on 88 weeks. None of the models predicts the direction better than the historical base rate. Raw Jev overestimates the probability of a decline (mean forecast 0.48 against an observed frequency of 0.38; ECE 0.10), and for declines of more than 10% (base rate 4%) it forecasts 16-24% on average. A prior shift to the historical base rate, which uses no outcomes from the test period, lowers the ECE to 0.015 and lifts a half-Kelly Jev strategy from 3.1% to 14.5% a year (buy-and-hold QQQ returns 15.3%), whereas Platt scaling, isotonic regression and the combination with the Markov model all make the forecasts worse; the Markov model is best at flagging large declines (AUC 0.81). The practical lesson is to anchor decision-model probabilities to the base rate of the market event before using them to size positions.
summary.zh: 追问 Jev 公告的校准性在真实市场结果上是否成立。作者自 2025 年 1 月起每周五询问「纳斯达克 100 指数四周后是否会收低」,比较三个来源:用 1990–2026 年数据估计的两区制马尔可夫区制转换模型;读取当周传播最广的标题与 PostGIS 空间查询算出的地理定位新闻特征的 Jev(版本 jev-1.14);以及二者的组合。知识探针显示 Jev 的知识截止在 2024 年末,故在其后的 88 周上评测。没有一个模型在方向判断上超过历史基准率。原始 Jev 高估下跌概率(平均预测 0.48,实际频率 0.38;ECE 0.10);对幅度超过 10% 的下跌(基准率 4%)平均预测 16–24%。向历史基准率做先验偏移(不使用测试期的任何结果)把 ECE 降到 0.015,半凯利仓位下 Jev 策略的年化收益从 3.1% 升到 14.5%(买入持有 QQQ 为 15.3%);而 Platt 缩放、等渗回归以及与马尔可夫模型的组合都让预测更差;马尔可夫模型最擅长识别大幅下跌(AUC 0.81)。实践启示:用决策模型的概率决定仓位之前,必须先把概率锚定到市场事件的基础比率上。

problem.en: Is a decision model that is calibrated on benchmarks still calibrated against real market outcomes?
problem.zh: 在基准上校准良好的决策模型,面对真实市场结果还校准吗?

papers.title: MM-SystemOneBias: Evaluating Bias in Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
affiliations: School of Artificial Intelligence, Jilin University
Engineering Research Center of Knowledge-Driven Human-Machine Intelligence, Jilin University
International Center of Future Science, Jilin University
King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
School of Big Data and Software Engineering, Chongqing University

summary.en: Puts multimodal Jev-style System One decision models and their vision-language backbones through one bias protocol. MM-SystemOneBias evaluates 13 models on 5,323 instances from nine public datasets and 11 task scenarios with six paired interventions: option order, option label, external judgment, image-text description, irrelevant information and rating scale. Across seven matched decision-model/backbone pairs the decision models are more stable under option-label, irrelevant-information and rating-scale changes in all seven pairs, and six show lower option-order flip rates; they lose less accuracy under incorrect external judgments and conflicting descriptions but also gain less from correct ones. Even when the semantic decision is unchanged, mean answer probabilities move by 4.56 to 11.55 percentage points. The closed-source reference is hosted TypeSafe Jev (jev-1.14.0), which has no matched backbone.
summary.zh: 把多模态 Jev 式 System One 决策模型与其视觉语言骨干放进同一套偏置评测协议。MM-SystemOneBias 用六种成对干预——选项顺序、选项标签、外部判断、图文描述、无关信息、评分量表——在九个公开数据集的 5,323 条样本、11 个任务场景上评测 13 个模型。七组匹配的「决策模型—骨干」对里,决策模型在选项标签、无关信息、评分量表变化下全部更稳定,六组的选项顺序翻转率也更低;面对错误的外部判断与冲突描述,准确率损失更小,但从正确判断中获得的提升也更少。即使语义决策不变,答案概率平均仍会移动 4.56 至 11.55 个百分点。闭源参照是托管的 TypeSafe Jev(jev-1.14.0),没有匹配骨干。

papers.title: GLiDE: A Fast, Calibrated Decision Model Distilled from Reasoning Teachers

summary.en: Asks whether the benefit of reasoning can be kept in a decision model without paying to generate reasoning text. GLiDE is a family of single-pass decision models (0.4B to 27B) built on Qwen hybrid language models: causal masking is removed from the full-attention layers so that context, question and candidate answers interact bidirectionally; soft-target distillation from several teachers, including a reasoning model, plus progressive post-training on diverse decision tasks carry reasoning into one forward pass; and parameter-free recurrent depth adds inference-time compute without generating tokens. GLiDE lies on the performance-parameter Pareto frontier of the Hugging Face Decision Index. GLiDE V1.2 (27B) scores 71.52 with 2.0% expected calibration error and a 92.9 ms median latency on a single GPU, and checkpoint averaging with recurrent depth lift it to 73.37 at 2.1%. Hosted Jev 1.14 (Decision Index reference) and Jev 1.13 (JevBench) are the comparison points, with Jev numbers reported by the leaderboard and benchmark maintainers rather than re-run by the authors.
summary.zh: 追问能否不付生成推理文本的代价,就把推理的收益留在决策模型里。GLiDE 是基于 Qwen 混合语言模型的单次前向决策模型家族(0.4B 至 27B):去掉全注意力层的因果掩码,让上下文、问题与候选答案双向交互;用含推理模型在内的多教师软标签蒸馏,加上多样化决策任务上的渐进式后训练,把推理能力搬进一次前向;再用无参数的循环深度在不生成 token 的前提下增加推理时计算。GLiDE 位于 Hugging Face Decision Index 的性能—参数帕累托前沿:GLiDE V1.2(27B)得 71.52 分,期望校准误差 2.0%,单 GPU 中位时延 92.9 ms;检查点平均加循环深度后升至 73.37(2.1%)。托管 Jev 1.14(Decision Index 参照)与 Jev 1.13(JevBench)是对比对象,其数字来自榜单与基准维护方,而非作者重跑。

problem.en: Can a decision model keep the benefit of reasoning without paying to generate it?
problem.zh: 决策模型能否不付生成推理的代价,就保住推理的好处?

papers.title: System-One RSI: Building Muscle Memory for Interactive Agents through Guided Practice
affiliations: Alibaba Token Foundry - Infra & Model RSI - EconML
Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: Reasoning models understand multimodal tasks well but struggle with sub-second control because deliberation increases decision latency; fast decision models meet the response window, yet prompting and few-shot examples do not readily supply the fine-grained experience a new task needs. Inspired by coached motor learning, System-One Recursive Self-Improvement (System-One RSI) couples two loops. The high-frequency online loop is an Observe, Orient, Decide, Act cycle in which a decision model (a 27B decision model throughout the experiments) maps each visual observation and task question to structured judgments and a decision tree converts them into timed actions without invoking a reasoning model. The offline loop is a recursive improvement cycle run by a team of reasoning agents that revises the decision-model prompt and decision tree, captures interaction records, derives supervision from them, and trains or deploys updated parameters before the improved system returns to the environment. It works from a small number of real episodes without expert demonstrations, environment modification, sandboxing or parallel simulation: in Snake the mean score rises from 1.30 to 7.35, in Zenless Zone Zero the median completion time of an evaluated scenario drops 8.4%, and in Black Myth: Wukong the evasive policy reaches 11 times the survival time of a stationary reference while the offensive win rate goes from 0% to 66.7%. Hosted Jev is cited as related work only.
summary.zh: 推理模型对多模态任务理解很强,却因反复推敲拉高决策时延,难以胜任亚秒级控制;快速决策模型能赶上响应窗口,但仅靠提示与少样本示例难以获得新任务所需的细粒度经验。受「教练式动作学习」启发,System-One 递归自我改进(System-One RSI)耦合两个循环。高频在线回路是一个「观察—定向—决策—行动」(OODA)循环:决策模型(实验全程使用同一个 27B 决策模型)把每次视觉观测与任务问题映射为结构化判断,决策树再把判断转成带时机的动作,全程不调用推理模型。离线回路是一组推理智能体执行的递归改进循环:修订决策模型的提示与决策树,记录交互,从中导出监督信号,训练或部署更新后的参数,改进后的系统再回到环境中。它只需少量真实回合,不需要专家示范、改动环境、沙箱或并行仿真:Snake 平均分从 1.30 升到 7.35;《绝区零》某受评场景的通关时间中位数缩短 8.4%;《黑神话:悟空》中闪避策略的存活时间达到静止参照的 11 倍,进攻策略胜率从 0% 升到 66.7%。托管 Jev 仅作为相关工作被引用。

problem.en: How can a fast decision model acquire the fine-grained task experience that sub-second control needs?
problem.zh: 快速决策模型如何获得亚秒级控制所需的细粒度任务经验?

papers.title: Keystone: Judging Previews at Key Steps for Test-Time Search in Diffusion Models

summary.en: A training-free judge for test-time search in text-to-image diffusion and flow models. Keystone compiles the prompt into typed questions about objects, counts, colours and positions and has an off-the-shelf multimodal decision model - Jev 1.14, used as released through its provider's API - answer them about early previews. The authors find that a generation's outcome is largely settled as denoising starts and already shows in the previews, which reward models read near chance. Reading counts and positions this way beats reward models reading finished images. On GenEval with SD3.5-Medium, adaptive search and pruning at these key steps significantly outperform best-of-8 with every other verifier at under half its generator compute, and the Keystone score also improves best-of-N, seed pruning and FK steering without retuning. An open vision-language model answering the same questions is examined as an alternative judge.
summary.zh: 面向文生图扩散与流模型的免训练测试时搜索评判器。Keystone 把提示词编译成关于物体、数量、颜色、位置的类型化问题,让现成的多模态决策模型——按原样经供应商 API 调用的 Jev 1.14——在早期预览图上作答。作者发现生成结果在去噪开始时基本已经确定并体现在预览里,而奖励模型读预览图接近随机。这样读数量与位置,优于奖励模型读成图。在 GenEval(SD3.5-Medium)上,在这些关键步做自适应搜索与剪枝,以不到一半的生成器计算量显著超过所有其他验证器的 best-of-8;Keystone 分数作替换验证器还能免调参改进 best-of-N、种子剪枝与 FK 引导。另考察了开源视觉语言模型回答同一组问题作为替代评判器。

problem.en: When in denoising should test-time search judge a candidate, and with what judge?
problem.zh: 测试时搜索该在去噪的哪一步、用什么评判器来判断候选?

papers.title: VisualJevBench: A Benchmark and Black-Box Attacks for Visual Typed Decision Models

summary.en: Red-teams “Visual Jev”, the image-input mode of Jev, with direct manipulations of the image. VisualJevBench has 800 images and 3,200 questions across eight scenarios and four attack surfaces - typographic manipulation, visual evidence spoofing, target selection interference and geometric transformation - spanning NOUL, CHOICE, SCORE and BOX questions. Adaptive Black-Box Parameter Search (ABPS) uses the typed-output feedback to find effective manipulations, both image-specific and universal. On jev-1.14.0, image-specific attacks reach an attack success rate of up to 69.6%, universal attacks average 33.15% on unseen images without further optimization, and geometric transformations average 40.09% in cross-scenario transfer.
summary.zh: 用对图像的直接篡改给「Visual Jev」(Jev 的图像输入模式)做红队评测。VisualJevBench 含 800 张图像、3,200 道问题,覆盖八个场景与四类攻击面——排版文字篡改、视觉证据伪造、目标选择干扰、几何变换——横跨 NOUL、CHOICE、SCORE、BOX 四种问题类型。自适应黑盒参数搜索(ABPS)借助类型化输出的反馈寻找有效篡改,支持单图攻击与通用攻击。在 jev-1.14.0 上,单图攻击成功率最高 69.6%,通用攻击在未见图像上平均 33.15%(无需再优化),几何变换跨场景迁移平均 40.09%。

papers.title: Stop Going in Circles:Loop-Triggered Routing for System 1 Decision Agents
affiliations: College of Computer Science, Sichuan University

summary.en: System 1 decision models such as Jev select actions fast and cheaply, but agents built on them can loop, repeating the same action without progress. LoopRoute is a training-free router: the decision model (Jev-1.13.0) acts by default, and when recurring state-action pairs signal a stall an LLM takes over for a short, feedback-driven stretch bounded to two actions, then returns control. Across three benchmarks and seven LLMs, LoopRoute improves task success over standalone Jev, with mean gains of 21.0%, 60.1% and 30.1% on ALFWorld, MapReader and TextWorld cooking, while cutting mean cumulative API time and API-call cost per task compared with full LLM control. The same rule also improves the success rates of six frozen decision models.
summary.zh: Jev 这类 System 1 决策模型选动作快而便宜,但基于它构建的智能体会「原地打转」——重复同一动作却不见进展。LoopRoute 是一个免训练路由器:决策模型(Jev-1.13.0)默认执行,一旦反复出现的状态—动作对表明停滞,就由 LLM 接管一小段(上限两个动作)给出反馈式协助,随后交回控制权。在三个基准、七个 LLM 上,LoopRoute 比单独使用 Jev 的任务成功率更高,ALFWorld、MapReader、TextWorld cooking 上平均提升 21.0%、60.1%、30.1%,同时相较全程 LLM 控制大幅降低每任务的累计 API 时间与调用成本。同一规则对另外六个冻结决策模型也有提升。

problem.en: How can an agent escape action loops without paying for LLM reasoning at every step?
problem.zh: 如何让智能体摆脱动作循环,又不必每一步都付 LLM 推理的代价?

papers.title: Incorporating argumentation frameworks for LLM decision-making: Task-specific design and evaluation
affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Mathematical Sciences, Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences
School of Mathematical Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: Asks how argumentation frameworks should be built into LLM decision-making. Existing argumentation-augmented methods are abstracted into a four-stage workflow and their design choices are investigated on debate-based decision-making and retrieval-based fact verification; with recent LLMs, the existing methods do not consistently improve performance. Two task-specific methods follow. Qnt-Arg organizes arguments around the original speakers in debate material and aggregates model-estimated argument strengths and candidate-answer priors under gradual semantics; Qlt-Arg uses credibility estimates to order conflicting evidence and grounded semantics to select acceptable evidence for later LLM inference. The paper also examines the roles of generative and decision models, with Perplexity Decider in the debate experiments and Jev (via TypeSafe's official API) in the retrieval experiments: Qnt-Arg consistently outperforms other argumentation-augmented methods across matched configurations, and Qlt-Arg improves retrieval-based fact verification.
summary.zh: 研究论证框架该如何融入 LLM 决策。作者把已有的论证增强方法抽象为四阶段流程,在辩论式决策与检索式事实核查上考察其设计选择,发现换用新近 LLM 时现有方法并不能稳定涨点。据此提出两个任务定制方法:Qnt-Arg 围绕辩论材料中的原始发言者组织论证,在渐近语义下聚合模型估计的论证强度与候选答案先验;Qlt-Arg 用可信度估计为冲突证据排序,再用基连语义选出可接受的证据供后续 LLM 推理。论文还考察了生成模型与决策模型的角色——辩论实验用 Perplexity Decider,检索实验用 Jev(经 TypeSafe 官方 API):Qnt-Arg 在匹配配置下稳定优于其他论证增强方法,Qlt-Arg 提升了检索式事实核查。

problem.zh: 针对具体决策任务,论证框架该如何设计并与 LLM 结合?

papers.title: LLMs Are Already Confidence-Aware Zero-Shot Classifiers
affiliations: Department of Computer Science, University of Sheffield

summary.en: Compares ways of getting a confidence that can be trusted out of zero-shot LLM classifiers: black-box verbalised confidence and sampling against white-box P(True) and several logit-scoring methods using constrained generation. Eleven open-weight LLMs (1B-32B) are evaluated on five classification datasets with 3 to 151 labels, measuring accuracy, F1-macro, AUROC, ECE and Brier score. The confidence method rarely changes accuracy significantly, but logit-based scoring discriminates much better (AUROC 0.74-0.77 against 0.57-0.66). Single-token label identifiers preserve discrimination at a cost of 3-6 accuracy points, and a decision-only scoring scheme that scores only where labels diverge in the prefix trie cuts decode steps by 88-96% on the three largest label sets. The best configurations (Gemma 4 31B, Qwen 3.5 9B) are competitive with TypeSafe's Jev 1.13.0, which was run as the reference classifier: comparable accuracy and AUROC, but the open-weight combinations are generally worse on raw calibration.
summary.zh: 比较从零样本 LLM 分类器得到可信置信度的方法:黑盒的口头置信度与采样,对比白盒的 P(True) 与约束生成下的多种 logit 打分。在 11 个开放权重 LLM(1B–32B)、5 个数据集(3 至 151 类)上测准确率、宏 F1、AUROC、ECE 与 Brier 分数。置信度方法很少显著影响准确率,但基于 logit 的打分区分度明显更好(AUROC 0.74–0.77,黑盒方法 0.57–0.66)。单 token 标签标识保住区分度却损失 3–6 个准确率点;只在前缀树标签分叉处打分的「仅决策」打分,在三个最大标签集上减少 88–96% 解码步。最佳组合(Gemma 4 31B、Qwen 3.5 9B)与作为参照运行的 TypeSafe Jev 1.13.0 相当:准确率与 AUROC 接近,但开放权重组合的原始校准普遍较差。

problem.en: How can a zero-shot LLM classifier report a confidence that can be trusted?
problem.zh: 零样本 LLM 分类器给出的置信度怎样才能可信?

papers.title: What a Calibrated Probability Hides: Belief-Level Post-Training for Decision Models
affiliations: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

summary.en: A calibrated decision model can predict how often each answer is chosen, but one pooled prediction hides whether the spread reflects confident disagreement between groups of people or uncertainty within a group that shares a belief - and the two call for different responses. Belief-Grouped Policy Optimization (BGPO) has the policy propose a list of beliefs, estimate their prevalence and predict a choice distribution for each. During training, Bayes' rule estimates how likely each belief was to generate an observed choice, and these estimates weight the choice's contribution to each belief's log-score reward; lists proposed after seeing a few observed choices are kept only if they predict held-out choices well, which surfaces rare beliefs. At inference only the question is needed. On benchmarks covering opinions, conversation safety, emotions elicited by artwork and photo aesthetics BGPO achieves the lowest conditional, worst-group and overall Jensen-Shannon divergence across model initializations, and on a synthetic image task with known beliefs it recovers the groups better than baselines trained with belief labels. Hosted Jev, run zero-shot with and without the image, is the external reference.
summary.zh: 校准的决策模型能预测各答案被选中的频率,但一个汇总后的预测掩盖了分布的来源:是人群之间有把握的分歧,还是共享同一信念的群体内的不确定——两者需要不同的应对。信念分组策略优化(BGPO)让策略提出一组信念、估计其普遍程度并分别预测选择分布。训练时用贝叶斯法则估计每个信念生成观测选择的可能程度,并以此加权该选择对各信念对数得分奖励的贡献;看过少量观测后提出的信念列表,只有在能很好预测留出选择时才保留,用以发现稀有信念。推理时只需问题。在观点、对话安全、艺术作品引发的情绪、照片美学等基准上,BGPO 在不同模型初始化下都取得最低的条件、最差组与总体 JS 散度;在已知信念的合成图像任务上,比用信念标签训练的基线更准地恢复分组。托管 Jev 的零样本结果(含图与纯文本)是外部参照。

papers.title: Calibrated Decision Rewards: Training Language Models with a Judge That Knows How Sure It Is

summary.en: Reinforcement learning can only teach a language model what its reward can recognize: answer checkers are exact but need a reference answer, while reward-model and LLM-judge scores are not probabilities. RLCDR (Reinforcement Learning from Calibrated Decision Rewards) turns an LLM into a decision model that answers a typed question about a response (“is the final answer correct?”, “which step is the first error?”) with a probability distribution read in one forward pass, debiased over option orders and calibrated with about a hundred labels. Training Qwen3-1.7B with GRPO on MATH, this reference-free reward raises MATH500 accuracy from 72.2% to 76.8%, matching training on the answer key (76.9%) while a random reward gains only 0.65 points. The reward stays calibrated on the policy's own changing samples (expected calibration error 0.074 against 0.141 for a softmax judge on the same 27B backbone) and finds the first wrong step better than a dedicated 7B process reward model, but trails the answer key when training only on problems the base model mostly fails. Hosted Jev is cited, not used.
summary.zh: 强化学习只能教会语言模型「奖励能识别的东西」:答案校验器精确但需要参考答案,奖励模型与 LLM 裁判的分数又不是概率。RLCDR(基于校准决策奖励的强化学习)把 LLM 变成决策模型,对响应回答类型化问题(「最终答案对吗?」「第一步错在哪?」),以一次前向读出概率分布,按选项顺序去偏,并用约一百条标签校准。用该奖励对 Qwen3-1.7B 在 MATH 上做 GRPO 训练,MATH500 准确率从 72.2% 升到 76.8%,追平直接用答案键训练(76.9%),而随机奖励只涨 0.65 分。奖励在策略不断变化的样本上保持校准(期望校准误差 0.074,同一 27B 骨干上的 softmax 裁判为 0.141),找第一步错误优于专门的 7B 过程奖励模型,但只在基座模型大多做不出的难题上训练时不及答案键。托管 Jev 仅被引用、未使用。

problem.zh: 校准、无需参考答案的决策模型能否充当语言模型的强化学习奖励?

papers.title: FinVeriQA: Financial Research Agents for Question Answering: Routing, Retrieval, MCP Tool Use, and Provenance-Aware Evidence Verification

summary.en: An open-source multi-agent research prototype for financial question answering over SEC filings and live market data that asks which component should do each job. A compact typed-decision model (Laya) routes each question and screens out advice requests, Python computes every number, retrieval and tools fetch evidence, Mistral-7B writes a cited answer, a code validator checks that cited IDs exist and that numbers match computed notes, and a Model Context Protocol server exposes the pipeline. In live experiments Laya routed better than Mistral-7B (0.85 against 0.52; 0.86 against 0.68 overall), a 12B Mistral decided no better, and DeepSeek-R1-8B decided better but about 9.9 times more slowly. Mistral-7B computed 29% of 100 financial calculations correctly against 100% for Python, and a live quote cut price error from 210% to 0.00%. A controlled upper-bound study on FinRank explains why validation must be independent of the evidence the writer saw: when one figure in the shared evidence is corrupted, self-consistency stays confident while accuracy falls from 0.50 to 0.00, a shared-evidence check catches 35% of the errors and a check against the original passage catches 77%. Hosted Jev is not used.
summary.zh: 一个面向 SEC 文件与实时行情的金融问答开源多智能体研究原型,追问「每个环节该由谁来做」。紧凑的类型化决策模型 Laya 负责路由并拦下投资建议类请求,Python 算所有数字,检索与工具取证据,Mistral-7B 写带引用的回答,代码校验器核对引用 ID 是否存在、数字是否与计算笔记一致,再由 MCP 服务器把流程暴露出去。实测 Laya 路由优于 Mistral-7B(0.85 对 0.52;总体 0.86 对 0.68),12B 的 Mistral 并不更好,DeepSeek-R1-8B 判断更准但慢约 9.9 倍。100 道金融计算里 Mistral-7B 只算对 29%,Python 全对;接入实时报价把价格错误从 210% 降到 0.00%。在 FinRank 上的对照上界研究说明,校验必须独立于写作者看到的证据:共享证据里篡改一个数字后,自一致性仍保持高置信而准确率从 0.50 跌到 0.00;基于共享证据的检查抓住 35% 的错误,对照原文的检查抓住 77%。未使用托管 Jev。

papers.title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate

summary.en: Asks whether the System One decision paradigm - fast, parallel prediction as in Jev - can do more than judge. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model (Qwen3.5-4B) and repurposes its visual-semantic knowledge for image generation: text-to-image, image-to-image and dense prediction are all treated as typed decisions answered in one forward pass. To keep parallel predictions globally coherent, every position is conditioned on a shared random state, so each draw yields a different but coherent image; because the model tends to ignore that state under direct image supervision, a distribution over discrete image codes is learned first to guide single-pass generation. One checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass, generating a 512x512 image in 78 ms - up to 122x faster than existing unified models - while keeping competitive image quality and dense prediction performance. Hosted Jev itself is neither used nor evaluated.
summary.zh: 追问 System One 决策范式——像 Jev 那样快速、并行地预测——能否不止于「做判断」。Jeveration 基于冻结的视觉语言模型(Qwen3.5-4B),把其视觉语义知识转用于图像生成:文生图、图生图与密集预测都被当作类型化决策,在一次前向中作答。为让并行预测在全局上一致,所有位置都以一个共享随机状态为条件,于是每次采样得到不同却连贯的图像;由于在直接的图像监督下模型会忽略该状态,作者先学习离散图像码上的分布来引导单次生成。单个检查点支持全部三类任务,各只需一次前向,生成 512x512 图像仅需 78 ms——比现有统一模型最快快 122 倍——同时保持有竞争力的图像质量与密集预测性能。既未使用也未评测托管 Jev。

papers.title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement

summary.en: Piccolo is a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) implementing the Jev-like interface - Choice, Score and Noul - for text and images through direct candidate-logit readout from a language-model head, covering general text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows and interactive games. The models and their training data co-evolve through agentic data engineering and recursive self-improvement: research agents analyse model behaviour, construct training data, run experiments and use the results to refine later proposals, with semantic slices and a shared research memory connecting these actions across the family's development. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59 (Piccolo-9B 68.35, Piccolo-4B 67.46), and all three rank first on the Private benchmark in their size categories. Three reported lessons: backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency; targeted data curation lets 4B-9B models rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and continuous loss reduction can decouple from, or even degrade, discrete decision accuracy. Hosted Jev is not evaluated.
summary.zh: Piccolo 是一个多模态决策模型家族(0.8B 至 27B),通过语言模型头直接读出候选 logit,实现面向文本与图像的类 Jev 接口——Choice、Score、Noul——覆盖通用文本与视觉判断、智能体 harness、数据工作流与交互式游戏。模型与训练数据经由智能体数据工程与递归自我改进共同演化:研究智能体分析模型行为、构造训练数据、做实验并用结果改进后续提案,语义切片与共享研究记忆把这些动作串整个研发过程。Piccolo-27B 以 75.59 分登顶 Decision Index Vision Full 榜单(Piccolo-9B 68.35、Piccolo-4B 67.46),三者均在 Private 基准的各自尺寸组排名第一。三条经验:骨干与配方的协同适应比骨干新旧更重要;有针对性的数据整理能让 4B–9B 模型在专用工作流上比肩 27B 基线;训练损失持续下降可能与离散决策准确率脱钩,甚至有害。未评测托管 Jev。

papers.title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report

summary.en: Technical report for Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model (35B total, 3B active parameters) that adapts Gated Delta Networks to block diffusion; it leads the seven evaluated agent metrics, including 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified, and reports 680 tokens/s on one GB300 GPU. The decision-model part is one section of the report: a Clover decision-model variant answers up to eight related questions about shared material jointly in a single denoising pass, after context prefill. On an internal set of 500 groups joint prediction raises question accuracy from 90.37% to 93.88% and all-correct group accuracy from 65.4% to 77.0% (on partially completed Sudoku boards 78.30% to 95.60% and 22.0% to 76.0%). The variant is scored against Jev v1.13 as a frozen API evaluation reference on JevBench (88.31% against 86.58%) and Decision Index 0.2.1 (58.23 against 57.93), and is planned for a subsequent release.

papers.title: EgoJev: Finding Evidence in Egocentric Video by Reading VLM Decisions

summary.en: Questions about long egocentric video often depend on one brief moment that a vision-language model seeing a few evenly spaced frames usually misses; training-free methods rank frames with a separate image-text model or ask the VLM to write a time. In a controlled test the VLM itself locates the moment better when it chooses among labeled frames, and that choice is read from its output distribution - treating the VLM as a decision model that returns a probability for each option, as in Jev. EgoJev is a training-free frame selector for wearable assistants built on this: it reads where the evidence is from labeled thumbnails, looks again at the windows it points to, and places its few answer frames at the quantiles of the resulting distribution, so one frozen VLM selects, answers and returns the evidence time with no second model. With Qwen3.5-4B and eight answer frames it raises QAEgo4D accuracy from 51.2% with uniform sampling to 62.0% and outperforms recent training-free frame selectors on QAEgo4D and MyEgo; a single-level version runs on a Mac and an iPhone. Hosted Jev is not used.
summary.zh: 关于长时第一视角视频的提问,常常取决于一个短暂瞬间,而只看几帧均匀抽样画面的视觉语言模型通常会错过它;免训练的补救办法要么用单独的图文模型给帧排序,要么让 VLM 写出时间。在对照实验中,让 VLM 自己在带标签的帧里做选择,定位更准,而且这个选择可以直接从其输出分布读出——即把 VLM 当作「每个选项返回一个概率」的决策模型来用,正如 Jev。EgoJev 是据此构建、面向可穿戴助手的免训练选帧器:从带标签的缩略图读出证据所在,再回看它指向的时间窗,并把少量答案帧放在所得分布的分位点上,于是一个冻结 VLM 就同时完成选择、作答与证据时间定位,不需要第二个模型。用 Qwen3.5-4B、八个答案帧,QAEgo4D 准确率从均匀采样的 51.2% 提到 62.0%,并在 QAEgo4D 与 MyEgo 上超过近期的免训练选帧器;单层版本可在 Mac 与iPhone 上运行。未使用托管 Jev。

papers.title: UEmo-D1: An Efficient and Calibrated Decision Model for Unified Multimodal Emotion Recognition
affiliations: Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics

summary.en: Multimodal emotion recognition has two main lines, task-specific models and MLLM-based approaches, and neither, the authors argue, reconciles cross-task generalization, efficient decision-making and receptiveness to multiple plausible interpretations. Inspired by decision models, UEmo-D1 maps multimodal inputs, guided by natural-language instructions, directly to distributions over candidate options, and is presented as the first decision model for multimodal emotion recognition. To support joint training and systematic evaluation the authors curate UEmo-Data, with 977,270 training samples and 41 evaluation subsets across six tasks. Experiments show a combination of strong recognition performance, low inference latency and well-calibrated confidence estimates, and further analyses trace how training strategies and data composition shape these capabilities. Hosted Jev is not used.
summary.zh: 多模态情绪识别此前有两条主线——任务专用模型与基于多模态大模型的方法——作者认为二者都没能同时兼顾跨任务泛化、高效决策与对多种合理解读的接纳。受决策模型启发,UEmo-D1 在自然语言指令引导下,把多模态输入直接映射为候选选项上的分布,被称为首个面向多模态情绪识别的决策模型。为支持联合训练与系统评测,作者构建了 UEmo-Data:97.7 万余条训练样本,覆盖六类任务的 41 个评测子集。实验显示其在识别性能、推理时延与置信度校准上兼得,进一步的分析梳理了训练策略与数据构成如何影响这些能力。未使用托管 Jev。

papers.title: When Do Decision Models Help LLM-Driven Network Discovery?
affiliations: Illinois Advanced Research Center at Singapore

summary.en: Network discovery, identifying live hosts and exposed services, is increasingly automated by LLM-driven harnesses, and recent work inserts fast, non-generative decision models to validate actions before execution. This paper quantifies whether that validation improves discovery across three network scales (10, 100 and 1,000 hosts) in a simulation calibrated on a 30-node containerized testbed. Chunked batch dispatch recovers 92% to 100% of open ports in large-scale networks, whereas single-host dispatch collapses to under 6% because of context saturation and scan latency. At the measured proposal quality of the local model, decision gating (with Laya, an open typed-decision model) increases its port recall from 75.5% to 89.0% on small networks and intercepts costly decoy tarpits, but imposes additional latency on frontier models during early host discovery. Hosted Jev is cited only.
summary.zh: 网络发现(找出存活主机与开放服务)正越来越多地由 LLM 驱动的 harness 自动执行,近期工作在动作执行前插入快速的非生成式决策模型做校验。本文度量这种校验是否有用:在按 30 节点容器测试床校准的仿真里,对 10、100、1,000 台主机三种规模做实验。分块批量派发在大规模网络中能找回 92% 至 100% 的开放端口,而单主机派发因上下文饱和与扫描时延跌到 6% 以下。在本地模型实测的提案质量下,决策门控(使用开源类型化决策模型 Laya)把小网络的端口召回率从 75.5% 提到 89.0%,并拦下代价高昂的诱饵蜜罐,但对前沿模型在主机发现早期会增加时延。托管 Jev 仅被引用。

problem.zh: 用决策模型给提案命令把关,真的能改善 LLM 驱动的网络发现吗?

papers.title: Vanguard: Knowing When to Trust the Draft in Speculative Vision-Language Agents

summary.en: Step-level speculation for vision-language agents: a small model drafts each step and the large target model is called only on rejected drafts, so the outcome rests on the judge. Vanguard is a training-free judge that leaves the draft and target models unchanged: a general decision model (Jev, release jev-1.13.0), with the screenshot in view, gives each candidate step a probability of being right in one forward pass; the best candidate is kept if it clears a threshold, and otherwise the large model writes the step. On web, mobile and embodied agents a 2B draft judged by Vanguard is at least as accurate as its 8B target and significantly more accurate on Mind2Web and EB-ALFRED, while the target writes only a minority of the steps; it completes far more closed-loop episodes, and with a 27B target from another family it is both faster and more accurate. The calibrated threshold transfers to unseen websites, and the judge also matches trained process reward models on mathematics.
summary.zh: 视觉语言智能体的步级投机:小模型起草每一步,大目标模型只重写被否决的草稿,因此成败取决于评判器。Vanguard 是不改动起草与目标模型的免训练评判器:通用决策模型(Jev,版本 jev-1.13.0)看着截图,对每个候选步骤一次前向给出「正确」的概率;最优候选超过阈值即保留,否则由大模型重写该步。在网页、手机与具身智能体上,经 Vanguard 评判的 2B 起草模型至少与 8B 目标模型同样准,在 Mind2Web 与 EB-ALFRED 上显著更准,而目标模型只写少数步骤;闭环完成的回合多得多,换用另一家的 27B 目标模型时同时更快更准。校准阈值可迁移到未见网站,该评判器在数学任务上也不输训练过的过程奖励模型。

problem.en: How can a speculative agent tell whether a small model's drafted step is right before calling the large model?
problem.zh: 投机式智能体如何在调用大模型之前,判断小模型起草的步骤对不对?

papers.title: A System 1 Decision Model for Medical Multiple-Choice Questions Built on Frozen Language Models

summary.en: A single-author study of how far a System 1 decision model built on frozen language models goes on medical exam questions, where the right option is often no more similar to the question than the wrong ones. The recipe is rebuilt from scratch for MedMCQA: frozen language models (Qwen3.5-0.8B, Granite-4.2-3B, Qwen3-8B) turn the question and each option into vectors, two small trained projection heads and one temperature place them in a shared space, and the closest option wins; only the heads are trained, with a contrastive loss using in-batch and hard negatives and a mask for repeated answers. With plain last-token vectors both small encoders answer about one question in three correctly (33.1% and 33.0% on 3,842 held-out questions, chance 25.0%); wrapping each text in a one-word-summary prompt and lowering the heads' learning rate raises this to 41.7% and 42.5%, and to 46.0% for Qwen3-8B. Shuffling questions against options returns accuracy to chance, so the heads do use the question. The author states what the evidence cannot show: validation gains were 1.7 to 2 times the test gains, and this is a cheap, fast baseline rather than a competitive system. Hosted Jev is credited as the idea's origin only.
summary.zh: 单作者研究:基于冻结语言模型的 System 1 决策模型,在医学考试选择题上能走多远——这类题目的正确选项往往并不比错误选项更接近题干。作者为 MedMCQA 从零重搭该做法:冻结的语言模型(Qwen3.5-0.8B、Granite-4.2-3B、Qwen3-8B)把题干与各选项变成向量,两个训练的小投影头加一个温度参数把它们放进共享空间,取最近的选项;只训练投影头,用带批内负例与难负例并屏蔽重复答案的对比损失。直接用末 token 向量时,两个小编码器大约三题对一题(3,842 道留出题上 33.1% 与 33.0%,随机为 25.0%);把每段文本包进「一词总结」提示并调低投影头学习率后,升到 41.7% 与 42.5%,Qwen3-8B 达 46.0%。把题干与选项打乱后准确率回到随机水平,说明投影头确实在用题干。作者明言证据的局限:验证集增益是测试集的 1.7 至 2 倍,且这只是廉价、快速的基线而非有竞争力的系统。托管 Jev 仅被提及为这一思路的来源。

problem.zh: 冻结编码器式的 System 1 决策模型,在医学选择题上能做到什么程度?

papers.title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China

summary.en: LLM agents pay for a large model (System-2) at every step even when many intermediate actions only choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such choices to a lightweight System-1 model but rely on workflow-specific hooks written per environment. AnyS1 turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions already say where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline it mines grounded enumerable decisions from over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to build Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing; at run time compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 below a calibrated confidence threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 families it preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent. Commercial Jev (jev-1.14.0) is a System-1 baseline, which the self-hosted 4B model beats on held-out decisions while saving more cost.
summary.zh: LLM 智能体每一步都要调用大模型(System-2),哪怕很多中间动作只是在很小的已知候选里做选择。现有双系统智能体把这类决策交给轻量 System-1 模型,却依赖为每个环境手写的工作流钩子。AnyS1 把人写的流程性技能——其指令本就说明了哪里会出现选择、有哪些选项——变成共享的、领域无关的决策点来源。离线阶段从 1,000 多个公开技能中挖掘有依据的可枚举决策,在隔离容器里采集真实执行得到的轨迹状态来构建 Any-DP,并训练单个带标签平滑的校准 4B 指针 System-1;运行时编译后的工作流一次前向解决常规决策,置信度低于校准阈值才回退到 System-2。在三个未见基准与不同 System-2 模型族上,它保持任务可靠性,相较未编译的 System-2 智能体把单回合成本降低 75–91%、模型调用时间降低 63–92%。商用 Jev(jev-1.14.0)是 System-1 基线,自托管的 4B 模型在留出决策上更准,同时省下更多成本。

problem.zh: 能否用单个 System-1 模型服务任意智能体工作流的决策点,而不必为每个环境手写钩子?

papers.title: Auditable Clinical Support with Decision Agents
affiliations: Perelman School of Medicine, University of Pennsylvania
University Hospital Heidelberg and Medical Faculty of Heidelberg University

summary.en: A clinical decision agent that works up an acutely ill patient without producing any text. In Decision2Care a decision model (hosted Jev 1.13.0) assigns a probability to each permitted EHR action through typed questions, fixed rules carry out the most probable one, and each work-up records which options were considered at every step, with what probabilities and under which execution rules. On the records of 546 emergency admissions across 12 diseases it reaches a diagnostic accuracy of 86.5% (86.1% for the text-based MIRA-v2 agent) with a median 2.2 s per work-up against 92-100 s. In 10 of the 12 diseases the differential diagnosis changes most at the test on which the guideline bases the diagnosis, and all but four of its most-confident single-work-up diagnoses were correct (98.5%), with the four errors traced to single imaging reports. The same kind of decision selects treatments; its prediction of death is comparable to three intensivists, and in five of eight ICU cohorts it exceeds the best of three 24-h severity scores within 2-6 h of records. Two other decision models driving the same controller reached similar accuracy.
summary.zh: 一个全程不生成文本的临床决策智能体。在 Decision2Care 中,决策模型(托管 Jev 1.13.0)通过类型化问题为每个允许的 EHR 动作给出概率,固定规则执行概率最高者,每次检查都记录每一步考虑了哪些选项、概率多少、依据哪条执行规则。在覆盖 12 种疾病的546 份急诊入院记录上,诊断准确率 86.5%(基于文本的 MIRA-v2 智能体为 86.1%),单次检查中位耗时 2.2 秒,对比 92–100 秒。12 种疾病中有 10 种的鉴别诊断在指南据以确诊的检查处变化最大;单次检查后最有把握的诊断除四例外全部正确(98.5%),这四个错误都可追溯到单份影像报告。同一类决策也用于选择治疗;其死亡预测与三位重症医生相当,在八个 ICU 队列中的五个里,取得记录后 2–6 小时内即超过三种 24 小时严重度评分中最好的一种。另外两个决策模型驱动同一控制器,准确率相近。

papers.title: Fast closed-loop STEM navigation using vision-language models with typed decisions
affiliations: Institute of Industrial Science, The University of Tokyo

summary.en: Closed-loop scanning transmission electron microscopy, in which each acquired image determines the next field of view and magnification, would automate navigation to defects and grain boundaries; it hinges on a decision step that must be both quick and correct. The paper isolates that step. On simulated atomic-resolution STEM images of a substitutional W dopant and a grain boundary in monolayer MoS2, where the true target position is known and every method starts from identical conditions, four vision-language models are compared under three decision methods. Typed Decision, which directly obtains the probabilities of candidate labels from a pretrained VLM, shows the shortest decision latency for all models (0.13-0.21 s) and generally the highest navigation success rate: best for all models in W-dopant navigation (66-91%) and best for Cosmos-Reason2 32B in grain-boundary navigation (43%). Navigating to the different targets works from natural-language specification alone, without task-specific training. Hosted Jev is cited, not used; code and data are on GitHub.
summary.zh: 闭环扫描透射电子显微镜(每采一张图就决定下一个视场与放大倍率)有望实现向缺陷与晶界的自动导航,而它取决于一个既要快又要准的决策步。本文单独考察这一步。在单层 MoS2 中替位钨掺杂原子与晶界的模拟原子分辨率 STEM 图像上(真实目标位置已知、各方法起点一致),比较四种视觉语言模型与三种决策方法。「Typed Decision」直接从预训练 VLM 获取候选标签的概率,在所有模型上决策时延最短(0.13–0.21 秒),导航成功率总体最高:钨掺杂原子导航中对所有模型都是最优(66–91%),晶界导航中对 Cosmos-Reason2 32B 最优(43%)。切换到不同目标只需自然语言指明,无需任务专属训练。托管 Jev 仅被引用、未使用;代码与数据已在 GitHub 发布。

papers.title: JEV vs. LLMs: A Comparative Analysis for Phishing Email Detection
affiliations: National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences

summary.en: Compares Jev 1.13, a typed decision model from TypeSafe AI, with three LLMs - Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra and Meta Llama 4 Maverick - on a labelled dataset of 1,500 emails, applying the same emails in the same order and recording predicted class, reported confidence, decision latency, token consumption, API cost and probability calibration. Jev achieves the highest accuracy (79.67%), precision (71.43%), recall (97.97%) and F1 (82.62%), the shortest batch time (173.88 s), the lowest token count and cost (USD 0.015 per 1,000 decisions), and the lowest Brier score (0.1698) and ECE (0.1594). The authors read Jev as a promising option for fast, structured, high-volume triage while noting that LLMs keep the advantage of generating explanations, which the study does not evaluate, and that all four systems require further validation before standalone deployment.
summary.zh: 把 TypeSafe AI 的类型化决策模型 Jev 1.13 与三个 LLM——Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra、Meta Llama 4 Maverick——在 1,500 封已标注邮件上对比:同一批邮件、同一顺序,记录预测类别、报告置信度、决策时延、token 消耗、API 成本与概率校准。Jev 取得最高准确率(79.67%)、精确率(71.43%)、召回率(97.97%)与 F1(82.62%),批处理时间最短(173.88 秒),token 与成本最低(每千次决策 0.015 美元),Brier 分数(0.1698)与 ECE(0.1594)也最低。作者认为 Jev 适合快速、结构化、大批量的初筛,同时指出 LLM 仍保留生成解释的优势(本研究未评测),且四个系统都需进一步验证后才能独立部署。

papers.title: RagHarnessDebugger: Jev-Guided Agentic RAG in Contract Inference Repair Auditing
affiliations: Illinois Tech - Chicago Kent College of Law
Yong Pung How School of Law, Singapore Management University
CodeX - The Stanford Center for Legal Informatics, Stanford University

summary.en: Records every repair decision inside a Jev-guided agentic RAG harness for ContractNLI contract inference, then audits that record: whether each trace is intact, whether each validation is counted for the right candidate, and which answers the acceptance rule can actually reach. The audit layer exposed a policy acceptance gap of 77%/76% of available but unrealized repairs (development/replication sets), and labeled error analysis plus counterfactual replay traced missing repairs to the terminal decision. The revised harness improves accuracy over the BM25-only baseline by 3.6/3.7 points and even the full contract-access reference by 1.1/2.4.

papers.title: Can Decision Models Replace LLMs in Real-World Contact Center Classification and Judging Tasks?

summary.en: Compares nine decision models against thirteen generative LLMs, zero-shot, on eight real contact-center use cases (six classification, two judging), covering the API-based closed JEV 1.13 alongside Gemini-Decision-1, OpenJev, Clef and open variants. Many decision models match frontier LLMs on classification, with the API-based closed models cheapest per request among API options; confident predictions are more accurate, enabling selective routing. The dominant weakness is abstention - most rarely choose the no-answer option, which accounts for most of the gap to the strongest LLMs (Gemini-Decision-1 the exception) - and smaller models judge worse and are more position-biased.
summary.zh: 零样本对比九个决策模型与十三个生成式 LLM,覆盖八个真实客服中心场景(六分类、两裁判),含 API 闭源 JEV 1.13、Gemini-Decision-1、OpenJev、Clef 及开源变体。多数决策模型在分类上能追平前沿 LLM,API 闭源模型在 API 类中单价最低;高置信预测更准,可支撑选择性路由。主要弱点是弃答——大多几乎不选「无答案」选项,构成与最强 LLM 差距的大头(Gemini-Decision-1 是例外);小模型裁判质量骤降且更受位置偏置影响。

problem.en: Which contact-center decisions can decision models take over from LLMs, and where do they fail?
problem.zh: 客服中心里哪些判断可以交给决策模型、哪些会翻车?

papers.title: When Do Typed Decision Models Work in Transportation? Evidence from Travel Choice and Traffic Signal Control
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: First systematic look at typed decision models in transportation: TypeSafe Jev and GPT-6 Luna Decisions versus conventional discrete-choice methods, reinforcement learning, and four chat LLMs on Swissmetro travel-mode choice and closed-loop traffic signal control. papers.title: SlideJev: Order-Stable and Tissue-Grounded Jev Decisions for Whole-Slide Pathology
affiliations: Institute of Intelligent Medicine, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences

summary.en: Builds a Jev decision interface for whole-slide pathology VQA: each candidate answer is scored separately, by the difference between support and rejection log-likelihoods from the original frozen language-model head, in parallel prompts without option-position labels. papers.title: SpecSearch: Towards Hardware-Aware Efficient Speculative Decoding

summary.en: A hardware-aware search engine that jointly optimizes decoding strategy, draft length and precision per workload-GPU pair, using an analytical cost model plus calibration measurements from multiple GPUs. A Jev-based predictor - a frozen Qwen3-4B with LoRA adapters and a linear correction layer, parameter-efficiently trained on calibration data - then selects high-throughput configurations on held-out GPUs without deployment-GPU calibration. Across RTX 5090, H100, L40 and MI300X, full-calibration SpecSearch averages 2.01x autoregressive and 1.36x speculative decoding throughput under vLLM; the predictor keeps 1.30x over SD while retaining 97.36% of full-calibration throughput.

papers.title: Deciding Without Pointing: A Case Study of Whether a Decision Model Localizes the Anomalies It Detects

summary.en: A single-author case study asking whether a decision model that flags an anomaly also knows where it is. Clef-flash (post-trained Qwen3.5-9B backbone) detects unevenly on industrial inspection (per-category image AUROC 0.924 on MVTec AD, 0.668 on MVTec AD 2); on MVTec AD its decision-head routing attention yields only 0.391 mean per-image pixel AUROC and hiding image tokens leaves detection unchanged. The backbone's attention points at the defect but falls below a center prior when the question changes and below chance without textual context, while probing backbone states on the test split does carry location. Region-specific questions, head retraining or reading the backbone recover some location, none matching dedicated few-shot localizers; Clef (27B backbone) gives no useful head map either.
summary.zh: 单作者案例研究:决策模型判断出异常时,它知道异常在哪吗?Clef-flash(Qwen3.5-9B 后训练骨干)在工业检测上检测能力不均衡(MVTec AD 每类图像 AUROC 0.924,MVTec AD 2 仅 0.668);前者上决策头路由注意力每图像素 AUROC 仅 0.391,遮住图像 token 检测不变。骨干注意力确实指向缺陷,但换问法即低于中心先验、去掉文本上下文即低于随机;测试集上探测骨干状态确实携带位置信息。按区域提问、重训决策头或读骨干可部分恢复定位,但都不及专用少样本定位器;Clef(27B 骨干)的决策头同样给不出有用的图。

problem.en: Does a decision model that detects an anomaly also know where it is?

papers.title: FaceJev: Direct Visual Decisions for Face Forgery Detection

summary.en: An MLLM face-forgery detector that adopts the Jev formulation: eight independent questions about facial parts share one image encoding, anomaly probabilities are read from the native answer logits, and a face is classified as forged if any part is abnormal, linking the verdict to per-part decisions. The PartForensics dataset (~160k images with binary per-part targets) supervises the decisions, and FS-GRPO optimizes each part decision through exact reward comparison with its alternative. Outperforms the strongest baseline by 7.25 percentage points on unseen manipulations.
summary.zh: 采用 Jev 范式的 MLLM 人脸伪造检测:八个人脸部位问题共享同一图像编码,从原生答案 logits 读出异常概率,任一部位异常即判伪造,判定与部位决策直接挂钩。新数据集 PartForensics(约 16 万张图、八部位二值标注)监督这些决策,FS-GRPO 以与其备选项的精确奖励对比优化每个部位决策。在未见伪造类型上超过最强基线 7.25 个百分点。

papers.title: Jev-as-a-Reward: Validating Probabilistic Safety Judges for Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: A protocol for validating probabilistic safety judges before and during RL training: separate the share of confidently passed harm from its amount, re-validate after each judge version change, and watch for policies exploiting the confidence gate's blind spot. Applied to two versions of hosted Jev as the probability reward: passed harm shrinks in all 11 runs under the primary reference but mostly more slowly than caught harm and concentrates in the blind spot; binarizing the judge meets the escape criterion on Llama; with a helpfulness term, HarmBench attack success on Llama-3.1-8B falls from 0.287 to at most 0.033.
summary.zh: 提出在 RL 训练前后持续校验概率安全裁判的协议:区分「被自信放行的伤害」的份额与数量,裁判换版本后重新校验,并监测策略对置信门盲区的利用。应用于两个版本的托管 Jev 概率奖励:主参照下 11 次运行中被放行伤害均收缩但多慢于被捕获伤害,且集中于盲区;二值化裁判在 Llama 上达到逃逸判据;加辅助性项后 HarmBench 攻击成功率从 0.287 降至至多 0.033。

problem.en: Can a cheap probabilistic safety judge remain a safe RL reward when policies learn its blind spot?
problem.zh: 当策略学会利用置信门盲区时,廉价概率安全裁判还能当 RL 奖励吗?

papers.title: A First Look at System One Decision Models for Malware Detection
affiliations: Department of Engineering, Niccolò Cusano University, Rome, Italy

summary.en: First evaluation of System One decision models for Windows PE malware detection: Ghidra and capa decompose each binary into a canonical textual state, then three readouts score it - A0 (probability of one verdict question), A1 (32 atomic behavioral questions) and A2 (heads on the state embedding). Hosted Jev is explicitly outside the evaluation because its usage policy prohibits malware analysis; the study covers CLM-8B, ten open decision models and two LLMs on BODMAS temporal splits, SOREL-20M out-of-distribution malware and 14,534 matched benign files. A0 wastes static evidence (AUROC 0.4025-0.8590 across 13 models); A1 raises every model by +54.61% on average; the S1Mal ensemble reaches AUROC 0.9946, detecting 93.47% of malware at a realized 1.45% FPR.
summary.zh: System One 决策模型在 Windows PE 恶意软件检测上的首次评估:Ghidra 与 capa 把二进制分解为规范化文本状态,三种读出打分——A0(单判定问题概率)、A1(32 个原子行为问题)、A2(状态嵌入上的头)。托管 Jev 因使用政策禁止分析恶意软件而明确不在评估内;研究覆盖 CLM-8B、十个开源决策模型与两个 LLM,数据为 BODMAS 时序切分、SOREL-20M 分布外恶意样本与 14,534 组匹配良性文件。A0 浪费静态证据(13 个模型 AUROC 0.4025-0.8590);A1 平均提升 +54.61%;S1Mal 集成达 AUROC 0.9946,在实测 1.45% FPR 下检出 93.47%。

papers.title: When Should Decision Models Compare Candidates?

summary.en: Compares three scoring interfaces for decision models that select among candidate actions - Pointwise (each candidate scored independently), Setwise (scores depend on the set) and Candidate Attention - on five external agent-decision benchmarks (BFCL, MetaTool, Open-Jev, JevBench, Mind2Web; same 9,156 requests per method) plus two controlled synthetic tasks. Pointwise scoring remains competitive; Setwise wins on some tool-selection and binary-decision tasks; Candidate Attention does not consistently improve on Pointwise, though targeted relational training teaches Setwise models candidate dependencies that transfer to shifted inputs.
summary.zh: 比较决策模型选动作的三种打分接口——Pointwise(逐个候选独立打分)、Setwise(分数依赖集合)与 Candidate Attention(候选间注意力)——在五个外部智能体决策基准(BFCL、MetaTool、Open-Jev、JevBench、Mind2Web,每方法相同的 9,156 条请求)加两个受控合成任务上评估。Pointwise 保持竞争力;Setwise 在部分工具选择与二判任务上占优;Candidate Attention 未能稳定超过 Pointwise,但定向关系训练能让 Setwise 学会候选间依赖并迁移到偏移输入。

problem.zh: 候选动作该单独打分,还是参照同组其他候选一起打分?

papers.title: General-Purpose Decision Models for AI Configuration Tuning

summary.en: AI configuration tuning searches for settings that improve system performance under a limited budget, and the choice of decision strategy is central to both quality and cost. This King's College London study asks whether general-purpose decision models can guide tuning, using hosted Jev as the deployed representative that returns structured choices and numeric scores. Across eight AI tuning tasks, Jev is compared as an optimizer, a performance predictor and a region guider against conventional methods and an LLM: conventional optimizers rank first in six of eight comparisons and established predictors beat Jev on seven, but through region guidance Jev finds configurations with lower perplexity than the native tuner selects - a quality gain where the extra decision time and API fees are acceptable. The findings map where a deployed decision model is and is not worth its cost inside PromiseTune-style integrations.
summary.zh: AI 配置调优在有限预算下搜索能提升系统性能的设置,决策策略的选择同时决定质量与成本。这项伦敦国王学院的研究问:通用决策模型能否指导调优?以托管的 Jev 为部署代表(返回结构化选择与数值分数),在八个 AI 调优任务上把 Jev 分别用作优化器、性能预测器与区域引导器,与传统方法及一个 LLM 对比:传统优化器在八比六中排第一,成熟预测器在七个任务上胜过 Jev;但经区域引导,Jev 找到的配置困惑度低于原生调优器的选择——在可接受额外决策时间与 API 费用时带来质量增益。结论画出了部署型决策模型在 PromiseTune 式集成中何处值回成本、何处不值。

problem.en: Where does a deployed general-purpose decision model actually help AI configuration tuning?
problem.zh: 部署型通用决策模型在 AI 配置调优中究竟哪里有用?

papers.title: Do We Still Need Fine-Tuned Classifiers? Swapping Typed Decision Models into 24 ACL-Venue Papers

summary.en: Swaps the predictors of 24 ACL-venue papers for hosted Jev under each paper's own splits, label definitions and metric; the 46 resulting English test sets form the TDM-Gauntlet benchmark, cross-checked with Cloudflare's Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1 and OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna Decisions. A zero-shot Jev prompt directly replaces the paper's predictor on 12 of 46 sets (mostly single judgments with plain labels); with 500 training labels, calibration plus GEPA-style prompt optimization closes a median 72% of the gap to the paper's method for a median $1.66 per search, while LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3.8-27B closes 97% - fine-tuning remains the most accurate option.
summary.zh: 在 24 篇 ACL 论文各自的切分、标签定义与指标下,把原预测器换成托管 Jev;得到的 46 个英文测试集构成 TDM-Gauntlet 基准,并用 Cloudflare Clef、Microsoft-Decision-1、GPT-6 Luna Decisions 交叉核对。零样本 Jev 直接替换其中 12/46 个测试集的预测器(多为标签平实的单次判断);给 500 条标注后,校准加 GEPA 式提示优化以每次 1.66 美元的中位成本弥补与原方法差距的中位 72%,Qwen3.8-27B 的 LoRA 微调弥补 97%——微调仍最准。

papers.title: Can decision models extract clinical data from cancer pathology reports? An evaluation of accuracy, calibration, and failure modes
affiliations: Department of Radiation Oncology, Tata Medical Center, Kolkata
Department of Pathology, Tata Medical Center, Kolkata

summary.en: First evaluation of decision models on clinical text: two open-weights models (Nimble 9B and Tev1 4B) extract 25 fields from 1,113 oral-cavity cancer pathology reports from a single centre, against a prospectively maintained clinical database, compared with Qwen3.5 9B run locally and GLM-5.3-flash via cloud API (hosted Jev and Laya not evaluated). Tev1 reaches mean field accuracy 0.917, statistically equal to Qwen3.5 9B (0.918) and four times faster (15 s per report), with pooled ECE 0.022-0.026; both decision models match GLM-5.3-flash on simple dichotomous fields and are weak on binned measurements and unreported answers; routing answers below probability 0.94 to GLM-5.3-flash raises Tev1 to 0.982 with 38% escalated.
summary.zh: 决策模型在临床文本上的首次评估:两个开源权重模型(Nimble 9B、Tev1 4B)从单中心 1,113 份口腔癌病理报告中提取 25 个字段,与前瞻维护的临床数据库比对,并与本地 Qwen3.5 9B、云端 GLM-5.3-flash 对比(未评托管 Jev 与 Laya)。Tev1 平均字段准确率 0.917,与 Qwen3.5 9B(0.918)统计持平且快四倍(每份 15 秒),合并 ECE 0.022-0.026;两个决策模型在简单二值字段上追平 GLM-5.3-flash,在分箱测量与未报告字段上偏弱;把概率低于 0.94 的答案升级给 GLM-5.3-flash 可将 Tev1 提到 0.982,升级占 38%。

papers.title: AgenticJevNav: Agentic Object Search and Navigation via Event-Driven Verification

summary.en: An agentic object-search-and-navigation architecture: a planning Agent owns the goal and authorizes a bounded action set, hosted Jev reviews structured evidence after blocked or failed execution or two consecutive low-progress segments (version, freshness and once-only checks govern decision application), goal revisions revoke obsolete requests, and an independent RGB reflex can stop forward motion. Across six simulated task families it reaches 73.33% success over 60 trials, 21.67 points above the next-best agent-only control; a GENISOM L1 quadruped deployment achieves 70.0% over 30 trials.

summary.en: Budgeted joint-action search (BJAS) for satellite edge computing: bounded candidate pools (single-terminal updates plus power-inheriting offload replacements) are constructed for joint offloading and power allocation, hosted Jev (jev-1.13.0) assigns within-pool option probabilities for batched selection, and improvement is numerically verified before an update is accepted. affiliations: Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR), Tsinghua University

summary.en: Turns a decoder-only VLM into an encoder-style driving policy: a linear head reads the pre-first-token hidden state to score a fixed set of 5,273 candidate trajectories in one forward pass; with the candidate set fixed, rewards are computed offline so supervised targets can be reward-weighted and reinforcement learning maximizes the exact expected reward, while multiple-choice training keeps visual question answering in the same pass. Plans in 84 ms of GPU time, six times faster than Qwen-Drive-1.0 and at least as well on NAVSIM, PAI-AV and WOD-E2E; answers visual multiple-choice questions as well as the base VLM does by decoding.

papers.title: Beyond Plain MCP: Do Decision Models and Code Mode Make Tool Use Cheaper and Faster?

summary.en: A pre-registered evaluation of MCP tool-use paradigms on a controlled harness across 12 servers, up to 1,958 distractor tools and three open-weight agents (Qwen, Gemma, Nemotron): code mode, where agents write scripts against typed tool stubs, substantially outperforms plain MCP, cutting token usage by 70-90% while boosting utility; declaring return-shape hints in stubs swings success by up to 39.5 points for lower-performing agents, a larger effect than adding a router; and the central hypothesis that a decision layer in front of code mode beats code mode alone is not confirmed (minor, non-significant gains for weaker agents, a slight cost for the strongest). Releases the harness, a fine-tuned 4B tool-selection model and all evaluation traces.
summary.zh: 在覆盖 12 个服务器、至多 1,958 个干扰工具与三个开源权重智能体(Qwen、Gemma、Nemotron)的受控测试台上,预注册评估 MCP 工具使用范式:code mode(智能体对类型化工具桩写脚本)大幅胜过普通 MCP,token 用量降 70-90% 且效用更高;工具桩声明返回形状提示可使弱智能体成功率波动至多 39.5 分,影响大于加路由器;「code mode 前加决策层更好」的中心假设未获证实(弱智能体轻微不显著提升,最强者略有代价)。发布测试台、微调 4B 工具选择模型与全部评估轨迹。

affiliations: Data Science & Artificial Intelligence Research Institute, China Unicom

summary.en: Query-adaptive candidate menus for decision-model classification over large label spaces: a compact menu of labels is retrieved per query from labeled examples (its size adapts via aggregated retrieval scores) and a single decision-model request is made, avoiding serial hierarchical calls. papers.title: UltraBERT-JEV: Encoder models for System One Applications

summary.en: A technical report comparing four fine-tuning recipes for UltraBERT-380M with one mask per option, differing in how options are scored and turned into probabilities (one follows DeepSeek-V3's expert gate). Trained on the same data as Qwen3-0.6B under the LLM-as-Jev recipe (67.6%), the encoder reaches 69.7-72.1%; scoring 'yes' minus 'no' beats 'yes' alone (69.7 to 71.3 on test, 57.8 to 59.6 external), sigmoid normalisation adds 0.8 points, and a square-root softplus adds none. Latency is 29 ms per decision versus 68 ms on an A100 at the cost of more peak memory (2.8 vs 2.2 GiB); an auxiliary head trained with a SelfCite-adapted reward predicts evidence sentences in the same pass.
summary.zh: 技术报告:比较 UltraBERT-380M 每选项一个掩码的四种微调配方,差别在选项打分方式与概率化方式(其一沿用 DeepSeek-V3 专家门)。与 LLM-as-Jev 配方的 Qwen3-0.6B 同数据训练(67.6%),编码器达 69.7-72.1%;"yes 减 no"打分胜过单用 yes(测试 69.7 升至 71.3,外部 57.8 升至 59.6),sigmoid 归一化加 0.8 点,平方根 softplus 无增益。A100 上每决策 29 毫秒对 68 毫秒,代价是峰值显存更高(2.8 对 2.2 GiB);辅助头以 SelfCite 改造的奖励训练,同次前向预测支持句。

papers.title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent

summary.en: A non-autoregressive 7B text-to-SQL model, inspired by TypeSafe's Jev, acting as a System 1 gate for a slower LLM agent: one forward pass predicts slot scores over a bounded grammar of query plans, up to 32 candidate plans are compiled and run, and a trained validator picks an answer or escalates. Alone it reaches 68.03% execution accuracy on BIRD's hidden test at 0.84 s per question on a single GPU, keeps accuracy in 9 GB with 8-bit weights, and transfers zero-shot to five other SQL engines within 3.1 points; in a pre-registered confidence cascade with Claude Opus 5.5 over 227 post-cutoff questions it answers nearly half locally and cuts API cost by 33.3% at the same accuracy.
summary.zh: 受 TypeSafe Jev 启发的非自回归 7B text-to-SQL 模型,作为慢速 LLM 智能体的 System 1 门:一次前向预测有界文法查询计划的槽位分数,编译并运行至多 32 个候选计划,由训练出的校验器作答或上报。单独在 BIRD 隐藏测试集上以单卡 0.84 秒/题达到 68.03% 执行准确率,8 比特权重下 9 GB 显存仍保持精度,零样本迁移到五种 SQL 引擎差距 3.1 分以内;与 Claude Opus 5.5 预注册置信级联,227 个截止后问题上本地作答近半、同等准确率下省 33.3% API 成本。

papers.title: S1Pert: Scalable Target-Specific Gene Response Prediction with System-One Intelligence

summary.en: A System-One framework for target-specific gene response prediction: a frozen Jev-style encoder (the open-source DECIDER-4B) extracts reusable representations of perturbation targets, query genes and historical evidence; pair-specific interactions are computed offline and cached (multilevel landmark caching), and a lightweight hierarchical cross-attention decoder combines them with cross-target pairwise ranking and synchronized historical-evidence dropout to reduce reliance on gene-level response frequencies. Directional Welch tests and equivalence testing separate statistically supported responses from inconclusive labels.
summary.zh: 面向靶点特异性基因响应预测的 System-One 框架:冻结的 Jev 式编码器(开源 DECIDER-4B)提取扰动靶点、查询基因与历史证据的可复用表示,成对交互离线计算并缓存(多级地标缓存),轻量层次交叉注意力解码器结合跨靶点成对排序与同步历史证据丢弃,降低对基因级响应频率的依赖;方向性 Welch 检验与等价检验把有统计支持的响应与不确定标签分开。

papers.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents

summary.en: Asks which role suits decision models in long-horizon agents: actor, judge, or teacher. Comparing three decision models (including jev-1.13-20260917 and pplx-decider-v1.2) with three general LLMs on ALFWorld, all six are pulled off a necessary subgoal by an easier one when acting, yet as trajectory judges they credit the right steps. Using JEV as a GRPO teacher lifts a Qwen2.5-1.5B policy from 72.8% to 82.9% on ALFWorld and 56.8% to 71.4% on WebShop - although JEV itself completes only 42.9% of tasks as an actor - with the question wording ('did each action help' versus 'will the task succeed') separating useful from useless teaching signals.
summary.zh: 考察决策模型在长程智能体中适合哪种角色:执行者、裁判还是老师。在 ALFWorld 上比较三个决策模型(含 jev-1.13-20260917 与 pplx-decider-v1.2)和三个通用 LLM:作为执行者六者都会被更容易的子目标带偏必要的先序子目标,而看过完整轨迹的裁判能正确归因各步。用 JEV 当 GRPO 老师把 Qwen2.5-1.5B 策略在 ALFWorld 从 72.8% 提到 82.9%、WebShop 从 56.8% 提到 71.4%——尽管 JEV 自己作执行者只完成 42.9% 的任务;提问方式('每步是否有帮助'对比'任务能否成功')是区分有用与无用教学信号的关键。

problem.en: Can a decision model that acts poorly still teach a policy well?
problem.zh: 一个自己行动得很差的决策模型,还能当好策略的老师吗?

papers.title: The Value of Thinking: Learning When to Reason in Hybrid Decision Models

summary.en: Proposes zero-or-T thinking in a hybrid decision model (HDM): one frozen backbone either answers inside a single forward pass or runs full autoregressive reasoning, with a lightweight self-routing block estimating the value of thinking per request against a price threshold. For episodic agentic tasks without per-decision labels, Calibrated Decision Policy Optimisation trains the router from episode-level returns. On JevBench, HDM-4B scores 0.857 against hosted Jev 1.13.0 at 0.851 (+0.7%) with median latency 0.179 s versus 0.652 s (-72.5%), and on MiniWoB HDM-27B cuts token cost by 80.1%.
summary.zh: 提出混合决策模型(HDM)中的零或 T 思考:单一冻结骨干要么在一次前向内作答,要么执行完整自回归推理,由轻量自路由块逐请求估计'思考的价值'并与价格阈值比较来选择模式。针对没有逐决策标签的情景式智能体任务,用校准决策策略优化(CDPO)从回合级回报训练路由。JevBench 上 HDM-4B 得 0.857,对比托管 Jev 1.13.0 的 0.851(+0.7%),中位延迟 0.179 秒对 0.652 秒(-72.5%);MiniWoB 上 HDM-27B 省 80.1% token。

problem.en: When should a decision model pay for explicit reasoning?
problem.zh: 决策模型何时才值得为显式推理付费?

papers.title: S1-Evo: Experience-Guided Evidence Competition Attacks on Typed System-1 Decision Models

summary.en: Proposes S1-Evo, a self-evolving attack framework aimed at typed System-1 decision interfaces, which perturb untrusted fields through contract-aware evidence channels to create evidence competition while preserving fact invariance, distilling verified flips into reusable experience cards. Across four benchmarks and three S1 models it reaches 71.99% mean attack success and 57.47% high-confidence success on jev-1.14 (also jev-1.13 and kev-4B), causes up to 24.00% end-to-end agent violations in dual-system S1/S2 workflows, and cuts attacker LLM token usage by 32.10-62.26% against iterative rewriting baselines; two inference-time mitigations are examined.
summary.zh: 提出面向高速打字决策(System-1)接口的自进化攻击框架 S1-Evo:通过契约感知的证据通道扰动不可信字段,在保持事实不变的前提下制造证据竞争,并把验证过的翻转蒸馏为可复用的经验卡。在四个基准、三个 S1 模型上,对 jev-1.14 的平均攻击成功率 71.99%、高置信成功率 57.47%(另测 jev-1.13 与 kev-4B),在双系统 S1/S2 工作流中造成最高 24.00% 的端到端违规;相较迭代改写基线,攻击方 LLM token 开销降低 32.10-62.26%,并检验了两种推理时缓解措施。

papers.title: Look Here, Then Decide: Small Decision Models in a Harness Find Memory-Safety Vulnerabilities at Scale on Commodity GPUs

summary.en: Builds a vulnerability-discovery harness around Intern-Decision-4B, an open-weight typed-decision model that scores candidate C/C++ functions in one forward pass (4.4 decisions per second on one GB10, 9.8 on an RTX 4090). Alone the model is weak - AUC 0.73 separating vulnerable from benign functions, 0.56 against their own patches - but useful for ordering queues: on 75 held-out CVEs the fixed function reached its repository top 25 in 21% of cases (1.4x random), and the campaign confirmed 187 memory-safety findings (12 critical, 148 high by CVSS) across more than 4,000 projects searched at 900-1,100 repositories per hour, with deterministic miners and verification carrying the rest.

papers.title: Recalibrating a Typed-Decision Model in an Afternoon: A Hands-On Recipe for Laya's Confidence Scores

summary.en: A hands-on tutorial recalibrating the released Laya checkpoint's confidence scores with a five-step recipe (measure, diagnose, fit, validate, deploy) in 130 lines of numpy using only standard methods. On 1,065 synthetic LLM-labelled items the pooled ECE of 0.073 hides a bucket-macro ECE of 0.143: the 12-option bucket is over-confident by +0.22 while the three-to-five-option bucket is under-confident by 0.05, and one global temperature makes pooled ECE worse - per-bucket temperatures are the recommendation. The example is deliberately small and the methods deliberately old; the contribution is the worked, reproducible workflow.
summary.zh: 一篇动手教程:用五步法(度量、诊断、拟合、验证、部署)和 130 行 numpy 标准方法,对已发布的 Laya 检查点做置信度再校准。在 1,065 条合成 LLM 标注数据上,池化 ECE 0.073 掩盖了桶宏平均 ECE 0.143:12 选项桶过度自信 +0.22,3-5 选项桶自信不足 0.05,且单一全局温度反而让池化 ECE 变差——建议按桶设温度。示例刻意小巧、方法刻意传统,贡献在于可复现的完整工作流。

papers.title: CURATOR: Scalable Fine-grained Evidence Selection for Retrieval-Augmented Generation using Decision Models

summary.en: Shows that using a pretrained decision model (pplx-decider-flash-v1.2) to judge many candidate evidence spans simultaneously is cheap but degrades as the simultaneous decision count grows, and fine-tunes CURATOR, a decision model trained to select varying numbers of supporting spans from large candidate pools. CURATOR keeps evidence discrimination strong as candidates increase, generalizes across tasks and document domains, and improves downstream RAG performance, especially when the available context is limited - retaining the efficiency of joint decision-making.

papers.title: From Large Language Models to Efficient System One Models via Adaptive Computation

summary.en: Studies how much backbone depth typed decisions require when an LLM is converted to a System One model. Decision information concentrates in intermediate layers - early layers build essential features and the final six layers are removable without loss - and independently trained smaller models mostly mimic the full model rather than developing specialized decision skill. It proposes NESTONE: a full model jointly trained with prefix sub-models that share its final layers and decision head through self-distillation, with a lightweight gate at each exit deciding whether more computation is needed. Across seven decision benchmarks the approach matches or beats independently trained models at every depth with better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs.
summary.zh: 研究把 LLM 转成 System One 模型后,高速打字决策到底需要多少骨干深度。决策信息集中在中间层——前层构建关键特征,最后六层可无损移除;独立训练的小模型大多只是在模仿完整模型,并未形成专门的决策能力。据此提出 NESTONE:完整模型与前缀子模型联合训练,经自蒸馏共享尾部层与决策头,每个出口配轻量门控决定是否继续计算。在七个决策基准上,该方法在每个深度都追平或超过独立训练的同尺寸模型,准确率-效率权衡更优。

problem.en: How much network depth does a typed decision actually need?
problem.zh: 高速打字决策究竟需要多少层网络深度?

papers.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models

summary.en: Introduces SO-Arena, a benchmark of 11 domains and five capability families for System One models, with evidence-grounded manually verified labels, domain-specific difficulty criteria, sandboxed interactive evaluation, and reasoning-intensive tasks enabling System one-two comparison. Beyond accuracy it measures decision reliability via option-set stability and missing-answer recognition. Across 21 models - including Jev API 1.14 (jev-1.14.0, score 60.4) and OpenAI Decisions - scaling and added reasoning help unevenly across domains, and strong overall performance does not imply reliability: the two most reliable models (JevAny-27B and Jev API 1.14) rank only eighth and sixth of 18 in performance.
summary.zh: 提出 SO-Arena:覆盖 11 个领域、五个能力族的 System One 模型基准,配有人工核验的证据型标签、领域专属难度准则、沙箱交互式评测,并用推理密集型任务做 System 1/2 对比。在准确率之外,以选项集变化下的稳定性与无有效选项时的拒答度量决策可靠性。21 个模型(含 Jev API 1.14 即 jev-1.14.0,得分 60.4,与 OpenAI Decisions)中,规模与推理的收益因领域而异;总体性能强不等于可靠——最可靠的两个模型(JevAny-27B 与 Jev API 1.14)在性能榜上仅列第 8 和第 6。

papers.title: The Noise Floor of a Quantization Comparison: Engine, restart, batch and kernel drift, measured against 8-bit and 4-bit effects in two decision models

summary.en: Measures, on the same 2,400 public decisions for Cloudflare's Clef-flash (9B) and Clef (27B) on an NVIDIA GB10, how much decision drift comes from things a quantization comparison silently changes: serving engine, server restart, batching, and library-selected kernels. Non-quantization sources move 0-0.92% of decisions (llama.cpp restarts are bit-identical; vLLM restarts flip up to 20-22 decisions), while every 4-bit quantization interval (5.79% and 5.67% of decisions at NVFP4) excludes every non-quantization source. Accuracy hides most of this: Clef Q4_K_M shifts net accuracy by six questions (-0.02 points) although 436 decisions get worse. Two of five pre-registered predictions fail; code, recipes, per-record outputs and the pre-registration are released.
summary.zh: 在 NVIDIA GB10 上,用 Cloudflare 决策模型 Clef-flash(9B)与 Clef(27B)的同一组 2,400 条公开决策,量化'量化对比悄悄改变的东西'带来多少决策漂移:推理引擎、服务重启、批处理与库自动选择的内核。非量化因素移动 0-0.92% 的决策(llama.cpp 重启逐位一致;vLLM 重启最多翻转 20-22 条),而两种模型的 4-bit 区间(NVFP4 达 5.79% 与 5.67%)都与全部非量化因素分离。准确率掩盖了大部分变化:Clef 的 Q4_K_M 净准确率只动 6 题(-0.02 分),却有 436 条决策变差。五条预注册预测中两条失败;代码、量化配方、逐条输出与预注册一并发布。

papers.title: Small Heads, Strong Decisions: A Controlled Study of Typed-Decision Models

summary.en: A controlled study of the readout design space opened by Jev: five readouts re-implemented and trained under one protocol (same Qwen3-0.6B backbone, same 15 public English sources, same recipe with per-head learning-rate sweeps, same seed). Head complexity does not affect accuracy - every readout reaches 81.3-82.0% in-domain, and a 0.5M-parameter cosine head matches the 27M-parameter joint schema head adapted from Clef at half its inference time; reading all questions from one prompt matches one-prompt-per-question with 1.6x faster inference. Backbone size dominates: Qwen3-0.6B to Qwen3-4B adds 4 points in-domain and 11 on held-out sources, and base, instruct and thinking checkpoints of the same model tie. The recommendation: spend on the backbone, keep the head minimal.
summary.zh: 对 Jev 开创的读出头设计空间做受控实验:五种读出头在统一协议下重实现并训练(同一 Qwen3-0.6B 骨干、同一 15 个公开英文数据源、同一配方含逐头学习率扫描、同一随机种子)。头的复杂度不影响准确率——各读出头域内均达 81.3-82.0%,0.5M 参数的余弦头以一半推理时间追平改编自 Clef 的 27M 联合模式头;单提示同答全部问题与逐问题提示准确率相当,推理快 1.6 倍。骨干规模才是主导:0.6B 换 4B 域内加 4 分、留出源加 11 分,同模型的 base/instruct/thinking 检查点打平。建议:把预算花在骨干上,头保持极简。

papers.title: Can Model Answer Probabilities Represent Survey Populations? Conditional Prediction and Joint Validity in Jev Survey Simulation

summary.en: Tests whether Jev (jev-1.14.0) probabilities can stand in for survey respondents beyond marginal accuracy. On linked responses to 20 binary items from five archived survey waves, the authors compare population-only prediction, prediction given recorded answers, and sequential completion; recorded answers improve predictive scores while associations stay distorted, and large conditional errors appear (among men with traditional values the model predicts 16% see men and women as similarly able at work versus 56% in the survey). Sequential completion has mixed effects on joint validity, reversing question order yields different joint distributions in both tested cases, and order checks with classical marginal bounds are offered as pre-validation tools. Evidence covers selected binary tasks and one model version.
summary.zh: 检验 Jev(jev-1.14.0)的概率能否在边际准确率之外替代真实调查受访者。基于五个存档调查波次的 20 个二值条目的关联回答,比较仅人口预测、给定已答问题的预测与顺序补全:已知回答能提升预测分数但关联仍然失真,条件误差很大(自述持传统价值观的男性中,模型预测 16% 认为男女工作能力相近,调查实际为 56%)。顺序补全对联合有效性影响不一,颠倒提问顺序在两个测试用例中产生不同的联合分布;论文给出顺序检查与经典边际界作为事前校验工具。证据仅覆盖部分二值任务与单一模型版本。

papers.title: Learning a calibrated decision head from logged bandit feedback

summary.en: Adapts a deployed decision head (LoRA on Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B-Base) from logged bandit feedback - the setting TypeSafe AI announced with Jev, re-implemented independently (the paper positions itself against the published OpenJev-RLCD reconstruction). Three findings: the sampled action's own Brier or log score is not a usable REINFORCE reward (one run cut ordered-scale accuracy from .636 to .111), while pathwise-gradient scoring and r / r-minus-p rewards avoid the collapse; with full labels, none of four bandit arms beats cross-entropy plus one temperature on unseen-schema ECE; and Chosen-Action Proper Scoring (CAPS) from logged feedback alone beats fine-tuning on confirmed answers only (Banking77 +2.6 accuracy points, .053 lower ECE, lower selective risk), staying 1.5/.6 points below full-label training at N=5000. Code, adapters, logs and per-record results are public in the jevmark repository.
summary.zh: 研究已部署决策头(LoRA 于 Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B-Base)如何仅凭日志化 bandit 反馈持续适配——即 TypeSafe AI 随 Jev 发布场景的独立重实现(并与已发表的 OpenJev-RLCD 复现对照)。三个结果:采样动作自身概率的 Brier/对数分数不能作 REINFORCE 奖励(一次运行把有序量表准确率从 .636 打到 .111),按路径梯度给概率打分或 r、r 减 p 奖励可避免崩溃;有全量标签时,四个 bandit 臂在未见标签模式的 ECE 上都打不过交叉熵加一次温度;仅凭日志反馈时,选中动作适当打分(CAPS)胜过只在确认答案上微调(Banking77 准确率 +2.6 分、ECE 低 .053、选择性风险更低),N=5000 时距全标签训练 1.5/0.6 分。代码、适配器与逐条结果公开于 jevmark 仓库。

papers.title: JEV-VAD: Efficient Semantic Endpointing via Task-First Conditioning and Decoder-Prefix Pruning
affiliations: Shanghai Shenqijiyuan Intelligent Terminal Co., Ltd.

summary.en: Reframes audio turn endpointing as a typed stop decision: JEV-VAD conditions a frozen Qwen3-ASR-0.6B on the question and completion criteria placed before the audio tokens, maps the assistant-prefix hidden state to a stop probability through a scalar head, and prunes the decoder to its initial blocks with matched head refitting to pick useful depths. Supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning calibrates the binary decisions; on EOT-bench the framework shows cross-language transfer from English endpoint supervision and a selectable quality-resource trade-off.

papers.title: Browser Immune System (BIS): Innate and Adaptive Threat Detection in the Browser with a Cybersecurity Transformer

summary.en: Presents the Browser Immune System, a browser extension screening navigation with alias-web, a 4B cybersecurity transformer quantised to 4 bits and compiled to a 2.44 GB WebGPU graph, realising its typed decision mode (System 1) in-browser with the marker-token mapping, complete pointer head and final normalisation. A typed security question answers in about 150 ms on a laptop GPU; the same weights generate System 2 explanations at 10.5 tokens/s on demand. On the synthetic BISBENCH-8 the extension returns the expected verdict on 7/8 sites (micro-F1 0.71), scans a page in 0.9-6.4 s and is deterministic across samples and browsers; a first pass over eleven real public pages shows two of seven questions fire on ordinary scripts and login forms, leaving real-web specificity as the open problem.

papers.title: Is Jev a Good Multilingual Judge?

summary.en: Evaluates Jev (jev-1.13.0) as a multilingual judge against Qwen3.8-27B and GPT-6.1 on four human-annotated benchmarks spanning up to 47 language varieties in binary, pairwise and graded formats. At roughly 1/31 to 1/61 of GPT-6.1's evaluation cost, Jev is competitive on most multilingual judging tasks but falls behind on knowledge-intensive answer verification, accepts incorrect answers more often in low-resource languages than in English, and its probability outputs help identify errors across tasks. The paper closes with recommendations on evaluation instructions and confidence-based selection.

papers.title: MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

summary.en: A 5,448-question benchmark across 16 newly built task categories for single-select, multi-select and soft-label decision making, with option spaces from 2 to 1,024 and inputs to 64,817 tokens, run over 28 decision models. Jev 1.14.0 scores 67.17 hard single-select accuracy against 76.00 for the best open WeMM-JEV 27B and 73.32 for Liquid-d1-Ultra, while Perplexity Decider-V1.2 tops world knowledge at 78.75% but falls to 53.95% on option logic and 47.95% on constraint planning; the best hard multi-select accuracy across all models is 36.81%. Soft-label tasks come with Brier and calibration-error profiles. Questions are fresh constructions or source-grounded recompositions rather than recycled benchmarks, but labels and soft targets derive from the authors' own pipeline, and API versions are pinned at test time.

papers.title: LEASH: Stay Safe in Agentic Robotics

summary.en: Introduces RoboRisk, 92 simulated plus 13 physical robot tasks spanning task refusal, plan repair, execution hazards, injection and sequential memory, all executed closed-loop, and LEASH, a safety harness whose task, action and commit gates review the task, each action and each irreversible operation through a hosted decision model (Jev or OpenAI's Decisions API) under one shared safety policy. Six foundation models show high harm rates when off-leash; with Jev, harm falls and safe success rises for every reported planner in simulation and on physical robots, task completion is largely preserved, and time and token overhead stay small. Effects are reported per planner-environment pair, and the shared safety policy is the authors' design rather than an independently audited standard.

papers.title: PolyRoute: A Twelve-Language and Code-Mixed Benchmark for Typed-Decision Routing, with Baselines and a Leaderboard

summary.en: A fixed multilingual yardstick for typed-decision routing: 322 native-language support messages across 12 languages and 9 writing systems, 156 code-mixed or romanised messages (Hinglish, Spanglish, Arabizi), 967 optional native training rows and a three-way department-routing protocol. LLM-made labels pass a blind second pass (91% of candidates kept), an independent model agrees on 97.2% of test items, and the split resolves differences only above about 4 points; all texts and labels are LLM-generated. On the 13-system leaderboard the Laya family's English-root checkpoint scores 61.2%, the shipped multilingual checkpoint 77.3% and the best fine-tune 96.6%, while TF-IDF with logistic regression reaches 91.9% - a strong classical baseline for a small dataset - and on four withheld languages the multilingual systems score 77%, 90% and 93%. Hosted Jev is not among the evaluated systems.

papers.title: Omni-JEV: Text and Dual-Stream Speech Decisions

summary.en: Formulates full-duplex dialogue control at collected-segment endpoints and trains Omni-JEV, an open model mapping text or role-indexed dual-stream speech to probabilities over five interaction actions, built on an aligned speech-to-speech understanding backbone that encodes the acoustic roles separately and shares its candidate readout with text inputs.
