papers.title: Can the Confidence and Decisions of System 1 Models Be Trusted? An Explainability and Perturbation Audit of Jev-Style Decision Models

summary.en: An open, deterministic audit benchmark scoring System 1 decision models on calibration under label-preserving perturbations, cross-question interference in bundled requests and post-hoc attribution faithfulness, over NLI (e-SNLI), adversarial syntactic shortcuts (HANS), synthetic clinical triage, Tensor Trust prompt-injection defense and an 86-case logic-gate trigger suite. Across five open-weight models (0.8B-27B) plus logprob and JSON/CoT System 2 baselines: provider confidence proves an exact closed-form dispersion transform (1 - H(p)/ln K on sub-10B models) rather than empirical accuracy; bundling questions flips 11.7-22.4% of binary answers on the 0.8B model versus 0.1-0.2% at 4B; models at 4B and above are better calibrated under syntactic shift (ECE 0.030-0.087) than logprob (0.144) or JSON (0.378) baselines; 4B+ models reach 0.988-0.998 AUROC injection defense at 48-60 ms; and single-pass speed makes 512-coalition XAI interactive, with S1-SHAP mitigating softmax saturation on disjunctive OR gates. Hosted Jev appears as context; the audited models are open-weight.

papers.title: ZeroPoint: Lightweight Energy-Based Decision Model

summary.en: Observes that a standard energy-based decision model learns only relative compatibility - adding the same input-dependent quantity to all energies changes nothing - so there is no learned reference level for abstaining. ZeroPoint makes the empty answer a state with energy zero for every input, shared with the listed options in one distribution, turning select-or-abstain into ordinary inference trained with negative log-likelihood; the energy function is a small order-invariant multilingual encoder reading the input together with all options. With the same encoder and data, the fixed zero separates inputs with and without an acceptable option slightly better than a learned rejection class and clearly better than a thresholded softmax while leaving the choice among options unchanged, and ablations show most of the benefit comes from training with no-fit examples. The paper states no affiliation; comparisons use the open Laya model and baselines, not hosted Jev.
summary.zh: 指出标准能量决策模型只学相对兼容度——给所有能量加同一输入相关量不改变任何预测——因此缺少「全不选」的学习参考电平。ZeroPoint 把空答案设为对每个输入能量恒为零的状态，与候选共享同一分布，使「选择或弃权」并入普通推理并用负对数似然训练；能量函数是读取输入与全部候选的小型、顺序不变多语编码器。同编码器同数据下，固定零点对「有无合适选项」的区分略优于学习型拒绝类、明显优于阈值 softmax，且不改变选项间排序；消融显示收益主要来自带无匹配样本的训练。论文未署单位；对比用开放 Laya 模型与基线，未评测托管 Jev。

papers.title: Beyond Ranking: Are Decision Models Calibrated Relevance Scorers?

summary.en: Revisits pointwise relevance reranking in the decision-model era: after reproducing Beyond Yes and No's FLAN-UL2 setting on eight BEIR collections, it runs hosted Jev (jev-1.13 via OpenRouter) and two open-weight decision models under the same protocol, where Jev and the 27B pplx-decider rerank ahead of FLAN-UL2 and three cross-encoders on average. Jev's native probabilities are overconfident against TREC assessors - of the DL21 pairs it scores above 0.9, only 66% are relevant - but a two-parameter calibration fitted on 2,257 DL19 pairs removes much of the error and transfers to DL21, after which Jev's DL21 Brier score beats FLAN-UL2 and the cross-encoders mainly by separating relevant from non-relevant pairs; calibrated probabilities also let an expected-F1 cut-off rule match a DL19-tuned threshold with no parameter of its own. Conclusions span eight collections with TREC label sets, and the fitted calibration is collection-specific.
summary.zh: 在决策模型时代重访逐点相关性重排：先在八个 BEIR 库上复现 Beyond Yes and No 的 FLAN-UL2 设置，再用同一协议跑托管 Jev（经 OpenRouter 的 jev-1.13）与两个开放权重决策模型，Jev 与 27B pplx-decider 平均重排超过 FLAN-UL2 与三个交叉编码器。Jev 原生概率相对 TREC 人工判定过度自信——DL21 中打分超 0.9 的配对仅 66% 相关——但在 2,257 条 DL19 配对上拟合的两参数校准消除大部分误差并迁移到 DL21，此后 Jev 的 DL21 Brier 分数优于 FLAN-UL2 与交叉编码器，主要靠更好地区分相关/不相关；校准概率还让期望 F1 截断规则在无自有参数下追平 DL19 调优阈值。结论覆盖八个库与 TREC 标签；拟合的校准依赖具体集合。

problem.en: Are decision models' native relevance probabilities calibrated against human assessors?
problem.zh: 决策模型原生输出的相关性概率相对人工判定是否校准？

papers.title: NuJEV: Structured Visual Judgments for Consistent Nuclei Quantification

summary.en: Applies the Jev structured-decision idea to nuclear perception: visual LoRA and a parallel head are jointly trained on Qwen3-VL-2B to predict nuclear presence, centers and types, with one image encoding feeding both the nuclear head and the original language decoder, which interprets region and type requests while counts are computed from the predicted nuclei. On 2,732 PanNuke test images NuJEV reaches a five-query mean absolute error of 1.844 overall and 5.268 on dense images with localization/typed F1 of 0.816/0.682; a matched-encoder ablation attributes 41.0% of the dense-error reduction to visual adaptation, and language-request MAE falls 76.2% relative to direct generation. Evidence covers the PanNuke family only, the head is locally trained rather than a hosted Jev call, and code is promised but not yet released.
summary.zh: 把 Jev 结构化决策思想用于细胞核感知：在 Qwen3-VL-2B 上联合训练视觉 LoRA 与并行头，预测核存在性、中心与类型；一次图像编码同时供给核头与原语言解码器，后者解读区域/类型请求，计数由预测核直接计算。2,732 张 PanNuke 测试图上五查询平均绝对误差整体 1.844、致密图 5.268，定位/分型 F1 0.816/0.682；配对编码器消融把 41.0% 的致密误差下降归于视觉适配，语言请求 MAE 较直接生成降 76.2%。证据限于 PanNuke 一个数据集族；该头为本地训练而非调用托管 Jev；代码承诺开源但尚未发布。

problem.zh: 细胞核的计数与分型能否用结构化视觉判断替代自由文本生成？

papers.title: LoMASA: A Local Multi-Agent Sales Assistant with Confidence-Gated Delegation for B2B Quoting
affiliations: Information Systems Design Laboratory, Hokkaido University

summary.en: A training-free desktop assistant where a 35B mixture-of-experts model acts as System 1, answering each decision in one forward pass and reading its confidence from the probabilities of the answer options, while a 27B dense System 2 model writes customer replies and escalation briefs and is consulted only when System 1 is unsure; code computes every price, margin and option, and hard pricing rules cannot be overridden. On 500 simulated episodes with 1,512 decisions built from public supply-chain data, 38.0% of decisions settle automatically with a median latency of 2.67 s, 42.5% escalate to a manager by hard rule, and the salesperson decides only 19.5%; on automatically settled decisions the system matches a rule baseline's 0.894 accuracy with fewer below-floor margin commitments (2.61% versus 4.53%). Option probabilities are well calibrated without training, unlike confidence stated in words by the same model; the 27B model rarely changes a decision, and results rest on simulated episodes.
summary.zh: 免训练的桌面助手：35B MoE 模型作 System 1 单次前向作答并从选项概率读置信，27B 稠密模型作 System 2 撰写客户回复与上报摘要，仅在 System 1 不确定时被咨询；价格、毛利与选项全部由代码计算，硬性定价规则不可逾越。基于公开供应链数据构建的 500 次模拟、1,512 项决策中，38.0% 自动裁定（中位 2.67 秒），42.5% 按硬规则上报经理，销售仅决 19.5%；自动裁定准确率 0.894 追平规则基线，跌破毛利下限的承诺更少（2.61% 对 4.53%）。选项概率免训练即校准良好，同模型的文字置信则不然；27B 模型很少改变决策；结论限于模拟情境。

papers.title: DM-Call: Decision-Model-Guided Function Calling with Cumulative Verification Feedback

summary.en: Adds a decision-model verifier to function calling: local schema validation plus separate decision-model checks of function selection and argument correctness, with rejected candidates fed back through accumulated verification probabilities, binary judgments and schema errors in a hybrid numeric-plus-verbal representation, refining without executing external tools. On BFCL and API-Bank first-call settings, DM-Call with hosted Jev (jev-1.13.0) or the open-weight 27B PPLX Decider v1.1 as verifier improves accuracy over direct generation at modest additional cost, and the two verifiers land close to each other. Gains are shown on two function-calling suites, and the verified calls come from the same generation pipeline rather than an adversarially chosen set.
summary.zh: 在函数调用中引入决策模型验证器：本地 schema 校验之外，分别用决策模型核对函数选择与参数正确性；被拒候选的验证概率、二元判断与 schema 错误以数值+文字混合表示累积回传，无需执行外部工具即可迭代修正。在 BFCL 与 API-Bank 首调用设置下，以托管 Jev（jev-1.13.0）或开放权重 27B PPLX Decider v1.1 为验证器的 DM-Call 以适度额外成本超越直接生成的准确率，两种验证器成绩接近。增益仅见于两个函数调用套件；被验调用来自同一生成流水线而非对抗性挑选集。

problem.zh: 决策模型验证能否抓住格式合法但语义错误的函数调用？

papers.title: Evaluating Jev on Arabic: Comparing Decision Models and LLMs Across Arabic Tasks and Dialects
affiliations: Fraunhofer Institute for Intelligent Analysis and Information Systems IAIS
Lamarr Institute for Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence

summary.en: Evaluates 67 systems (47 decision models, 20 LLMs) on 43 Arabic tasks across 9 task families under one shared zero-shot protocol, with English controls in three parallel resources that can be removed in a separate comparison. Jev 1.14.0 averages 69.24 versus 68.77 for Jev 1.13.0 and 71.81 for the highest-scoring Gemma-4-31B; removing English controls or repeated cross-task items leaves the system order unchanged, and version-to-version gains vary by task family. Within Jev 1.14.0, pooled dialect-minus-MSA accuracy gaps run -7.94 to -0.35 points across four datasets, SIB-200's source-clustered interval includes zero, and paired contrasts show a larger Palestinian banking penalty for Jev 1.14.0 than for either compared LLM under simultaneous uncertainty while other gap contrasts remain inconclusive. All findings are explicitly descriptive - no general dialect-robustness ranking or causal claim.
summary.zh: 以统一零样本协议在 9 个任务族的 43 项阿拉伯语任务上评测 67 个系统（47 决策模型、20 LLM），三个平行资源内置英语对照并可单独剔除。Jev 1.14.0 平均 69.24，Jev 1.13.0 为 68.77，最高的 Gemma-4-31B 为 71.81；剔除英语对照或跨任务重复项后系统排序不变，两版 Jev 的增益随任务族而异。Jev 1.14.0 内部，四个数据集上方言减标准语的合并准确率差距为 -7.94 至 -0.35 个百分点，SIB-200 聚类区间含零；配对对比显示 Jev 1.14.0 在巴勒斯坦银行语料上的损失大于两个 LLM（联合不确定性下），其余对比不结论。全部结果为描述性，不构成方言鲁棒性的一般排序或因果解释。

papers.title: AbductionBench: Benchmarking Abductive Reasoning in Large Language Models

summary.en: A unified taxonomy of abductive reasoning instantiated on 27 datasets spanning ten domains, harmonizing heterogeneous tasks and separating final-answer evaluation from analysis of the observable reasoning traces and interaction histories produced alongside. Eight LLMs from four families are evaluated on single-choice selection together with Jev, a non-LLM System One decision system (69,599 static responses plus 2,400 passive and interactive episodes): Jev matches or exceeds small LLMs when selecting among explanations over compact evidence but falls substantially behind on longer cases, so candidate discrimination and extended evidence integration place different demands on a system. In interactive tasks the share of relevant actions declines at later steps and a relevant first question predicts a correct final answer; traces are analysed as observable outputs, not faithful internal computation. Hosted Jev's coverage is the single-choice subset only.
summary.zh: 提出溯因推理统一分类学，在十个领域 27 个数据集上实例化，统一异构任务形式，并把最终答案评分与伴随产生的可观察推理轨迹、交互历史的分析分开。四个家族的八个 LLM 在单选任务上与作为非 LLM System One 决策系统的 Jev 一同评测（静态回答 69,599 条，被动与交互过程 2,400 段）：在紧凑证据的解释选择上 Jev 追平或超过小 LLM，但在长案例上明显落后——候选判别与长证据整合对系统要求不同。交互任务中后期相关动作占比下降，首个问题相关则预测最终答案正确；轨迹按可观察输出分析，不等同内部计算。托管 Jev 仅覆盖单选子集。

papers.title: Track or Follow? A Jev-Compatible Multi-Agent Trading System When Web News Lags the Market
affiliations: UCL Centre for Blockchain Technologies and DLT Science Foundation

summary.en: Builds a multi-agent trading system whose agents share only point-in-time stores and answer typed questions through the Jev interface (hosted jev-1.13.0 among the readers), with code setting every position under a proved bound on how far text can move it. In a hash-committed test, a Jev-compatible reader built from a pinned LLM's option probabilities tracks announcement-window abnormal returns (weekly Spearman 0.119), also after the LLM's release, and its event types agree with the issuers' 8-K filings (AUC 0.833); Jev's own judgments on news published after its release track the reaction as well (descriptive). Exploratory analyses locate the association: 72% of earnings news appears after the issuer's filing, contributor-written items often report the price move, and measuring from the first post-publication trade collapses the association to 0.023. The confirmatory weekly test detects no rank information over code-only features, and decision cards traced 88% of successful attacks to a planted item.
summary.zh: 构建多 agent 交易系统：agent 仅共享时点数据存储，经 Jev 接口回答类型化问题（读者含托管 jev-1.13.0），代码在可证明的文本影响上限内定仓。哈希预注册测试中，由固定 LLM 选项概率构成的 Jev 兼容读者其判断与公告窗口异常收益相关（周度 Spearman 0.119），LLM 发布后亦然；事件类型与发行人 8-K 文件一致（AUC 0.833）；Jev 对其发布后新闻的判断同样追踪反应（描述性）。探索性分析定位关联来源：72% 财报新闻晚于发行人公告、贡献者稿件常报道已发生的涨跌，改从发布后首笔交易起算则关联降至 0.023。确证性周度检验未发现超出纯代码特征的排序信息；决策卡把 88% 的成功攻击追溯到植入条目。

papers.title: Reproducible LoRA Inference Through Deterministic Split-K Reduction

summary.en: Shows that vLLM's atomic Split-K reduction makes LoRA inference nondeterministic and quantifies the damage across GSM8K, MBPP and Jev-style structured toxicity decisions on Civil Comments: under identical-input replay, atomic Split-K=8 produces different FP32 shrink outputs in 97.61% of comparisons; repeated atomic inference changes generated outputs in 17.30% of GSM8K and 14.96% of MBPP comparisons; and structured-decision probabilities vary in 81.47% of atomic comparisons, with decision flips. Controlled tracing shows how shrink differences propagate into the KV cache and final answers. A deterministic Triton Split-K=8 keeps the parallelism with no observed variation, at 16.8-21.1% latency speedup over unsplit reduction and only 1.02-2.62% extra latency relative to the atomic kernel. The decision-model axis is one of three workloads, and determinism is claimed under identical inputs rather than across serving stacks.
summary.zh: 证明 vLLM 原子加法的 Split-K 归约使 LoRA 推理不确定，并在 GSM8K、MBPP 与 Civil Comments 上的 Jev 式结构化毒性决策三个负载上量化影响：同输入重放下原子 Split-K=8 在 97.61% 的对比中 FP32 shrink 输出不同；重复推理改变 17.30% 的 GSM8K 与 14.96% 的 MBPP 输出；结构化决策概率在 81.47% 的原子对比中变化并出现决策翻转。受控追踪显示 shrink 差异如何经 KV 缓存传导到最终答案。确定性 Triton Split-K=8 保持并行度且无观察差异，较不切分提速 16.8-21.1%，较原子核仅多 1.02-2.62% 延迟。决策模型仅为三个负载之一；确定性仅在同输入重放下成立，不跨服务栈。

papers.title: TrialJev: Open-Weight Single Pass Eligibility Scoring for Patient Trial Screening
affiliations: Department of Medical Biophysics, University of Toronto
Structural Genomics Consortium, University Health Network

summary.en: An open-weight eligibility scorer: LoRA-adapted Qwen models plus a pointer head score natural-language answer options in a single forward pass, trained on TREC Clinical Trials 2021 and evaluated on 6,975 eligible-or-excluded pairs from 50 unseen TREC 2022 synthetic patients. TrialJev reaches 80.97% (Qwen3.5-27B) and 81.84% (Qwen3.8-27B) accuracy versus 79.87-79.93% for LLMs fine-tuned to generate verdicts, and under a common development-fitted decision correction the two 27B models land at 80.99% and 81.88% against 81.28% for the hosted Jev API (jev-1.13.0), with paired confidence intervals including zero. In matched batch-1 measurements verdict generation takes 2.45-2.70 times the one-pass latency (about 178 ms per pair at 27B locally), and an A/B-logit ablation attributes the efficiency edge to avoiding decoding rather than the pointer head itself. Evaluation covers synthetic patients only, clinical use is unvalidated, and hosted latency is API-reported rather than local hardware.
summary.zh: 开放权重入组打分器：LoRA 适配的 Qwen 模型加指针头，单次前向为自然语言选项打分；在 TREC Clinical Trials 2021 训练、50 个未见 TREC 2022 合成病人的 6,975 个入组-排除对上评测。TrialJev 达 80.97%（Qwen3.5-27B）与 81.84%（Qwen3.8-27B），高于生成式微调 LLM 的 79.87-79.93%；在统一的开发集校正决策下，两个 27B 版本为 80.99% 与 81.88%，托管 Jev API（jev-1.13.0）为 81.28%，配对置信区间均含零。批量 1 下生成判决耗时为单遍的 2.45-2.70 倍（27B 本地约 178 毫秒/对）；A/B-logit 消融把效率优势归于免解码而非指针头本身。仅评合成病人、临床应用未验证；托管延迟为 API 上报值而非本地实测。

papers.title: Maya a1: Do the Options Read the Model, or Does Their Position? Order Sensitivity in a Non-Autoregressive Decision Model

summary.en: Re-engineers the open 421M-parameter Laya checkpoint (a two-layer option head with no positional tensor and a documented but unused parallel layout) and presents 951 Qwen-verified questions under every cyclic rotation of their options: the released checkpoint changes its answer for 25.8% of questions (19.7% on the English items), accuracy with the gold option first versus last differs by 10.1 points, and flips concentrate at low confidence (54% in the bottom tercile versus 8% at the top). Fine-tuning on 2,818 teacher-verified rows with option shuffling cuts the flip rate to 7.2%, of which shuffling alone accounts for 4.2 points, and the authors' parallel layout fine-tune reaches 0.5%; a confidence-weighted vote over orderings gains 0.6 points at 4.1x compute. Labels are LLM-made and teacher-filtered, and the conclusions concern Laya rather than hosted Jev.
summary.zh: 重建开放 421M 参数 Laya 检查点（两层选项头、无位置张量、文档记载未启用的并行布局），将 951 道 Qwen 校验题的选项做全部循环旋转：原检查点对 25.8% 的题目改变答案（英语子集 19.7%），金标居首与居末准确率差 10.1 个百分点，翻转集中于低置信区间（底三分位 54%，顶三分位 8%）。在 2,818 条教师校验行上带乱序微调把翻转率降到 7.2%，其中乱序本身贡献 4.2 个百分点；按作者并行布局微调后仅 0.5%；跨排序置信加权投票以 4.1 倍算力换 0.6 个百分点。标签为 LLM 制、教师过滤；结论限于 Laya 而非托管 Jev。

papers.title: Nudging Decision Models: Do Digital Nudges Steer Fast, Generation-Free AI Agents?

summary.en: Adapts an online shopping experiment previously run with humans and LLM agents to three decision models - hosted Jev (jev-1.13.0), Microsoft Decision-1 and Liquid d1 - across 600 runs per model with control, default-placement and social-influence conditions. In the control the preselected product is chosen 47-49% of the time; the automatic default nudge raises this to 97.5-99.9% and social-influence information to 75-96%, and all three models respond more strongly to the automatic nudge - the opposite of what has been reported for reasoning-capable LLM agents, matching the System 1 label developers use. First evidence that non-generative decision-model agents carry agent-type-specific nudge susceptibility; the setting is one synthetic shop with three models, and the human and LLM-agent comparisons come from the earlier experiments rather than a re-run under identical conditions.
summary.zh: 把此前用于人类与 LLM agent 的在线购物实验适配到三个决策模型——托管 Jev（jev-1.13.0）、Microsoft Decision-1 与 Liquid d1——每模型 600 次，含对照、默认选项与社交影响条件。对照组 47-49% 选中预设商品；自动（默认）助推将其升至 97.5-99.9%，社交信息升至 75-96%，且三个模型都对自动助推反应更强——与推理型 LLM agent 的已有报告相反，与开发者所用 System 1 标签一致。这是无生成决策模型 agent 存在类型特异助推敏感性的首批证据；情境为单一模拟商店、三个模型，与人类及 LLM 的对比沿用早前实验而非同条件重跑。

papers.title: Same Facts, Different Remedy: Linguistic Profiling and Arbitrariness in LLM and System One Decisions
affiliations: School of Risk and Actuarial Studies, UNSW Business School

summary.en: Audits three remedy-decision systems - GPT-4o-mini and GPT-5-mini returning single labels, and Jev 1.13.0 returning a distribution over remedies - on US consumer financial complaints rewritten by two sociolinguistic models instructed to preserve every fact, with pre-registered hypotheses tested once on held-out complaints. At the group scale, older, college-educated and higher-SES styles receive slightly more generous remedies; the effects replicate but every monetary-remedy gap stays within 0.5 percentage points. At the individual scale, two style versions of the same complaint receive different monetary decisions 2.6-6.3% of the time; for Jev the mean total-variation distance between two scorings of the same text is 0.021 with tier flips in 2.5% of re-scores. Positive controls show all three systems respond 49-387 times more strongly to remedy-relevant facts than to style; standardising style cut GPT-4o-mini's education and SES gaps by 94% and 87% but reversed two of Jev's gaps and did not stabilise individual decisions, while independent LLM auditors flagged material fact changes in 3.3-11.7% of rewrites. Group disparities and individual instability are reported as separate fairness outcomes.
summary.zh: 审计三个救济决定系统——返回单标签的 GPT-4o-mini 与 GPT-5-mini、输出救济分布的 Jev 1.13.0——语料为美国消费者金融投诉，经两个被指示「保全所有事实」的社会语言学模型改写，预注册假设在留出集上一次性检验。群体层面，年长、高教育与高 SES 文风获得的救济略更慷慨；效应可复现但货币救济差距全部在 0.5 个百分点内。个体层面，同一投诉的两种文风有 2.6-6.3% 的概率得到不同货币决定；Jev 对同一文本两次评分的平均 TV 距离 0.021，2.5% 的重评发生档位翻转。阳性对照显示三个系统对救济相关事实的响应是任何人设差距的 49-387 倍；统一文风使 GPT-4o-mini 的教育与 SES 差距降 94%/87%，却反转 Jev 的两个差距且未提升个体稳定性；独立 LLM 审计员在 3.3-11.7% 的改写中标记出事实变化。群体差距与个体不稳定被拆为两种独立的公平性结果。

papers.title: GeoJeV: Unified Spatial Probability for Training-Free Efficient Evidence Acquisition in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing

summary.en: A training-free evidence-acquisition method for UHR remote sensing that replaces generative MLLM search control with a frozen open Jev-style model: metask-jev-4b-policy-mix1 produces a probability distribution over candidate regions at each step, and Region Rank, Sparse Branch and Depth Gate turn that one distribution into search priority, branching width and refinement depth, eliminating intermediate decoding. On LRS-GRO, MME-RealWorld-RS and LRS-VQA it lifts Qwen3-VL-8B's average accuracy by 5.32 points at 1.12 s extra per question, with a 7.8-fold speedup over the recent method it benchmarks against. Hosted Jev is only cited, not used or evaluated, and results rest on one answering backbone per benchmark with LLaVA-OV-7B as the only alternative.
summary.zh: 免训练的超高分遥感证据获取方法，用冻结的开放 Jev 风格模型替代生成式 MLLM 的搜索控制：每一步由 metask-jev-4b-policy-mix1 给出候选区域概率分布，Region Rank、Sparse Branch 与 Depth Gate 将同一分布转化为搜索优先级、分支宽度与细化深度，中间无需解码。在 LRS-GRO、MME-RealWorld-RS 与 LRS-VQA 上将 Qwen3-VL-8B 平均准确率提升 5.32 个百分点，每题仅多花 1.12 秒，较近期方法提速 7.8 倍。托管 Jev 仅被引用、未使用或评测；每个基准只有一个主回答骨干，备选仅 LLaVA-OV-7B。

papers.title: Jev as an LLM Safety Guardrail: An Empirical Study of Input Filtering, Selective Output Review, and Over-Refusal

summary.en: Evaluates Jev (jev-latest) end to end as a safety filter in front of a Qwen2.5-1.5B pipeline across 970 AdvBench/XSTest prompts. Input filtering cuts harmful-prompt answers from 527/720 (73.2%) to 17/720 (2.4%) but raises benign refusals from 1.2% to 10.8%; a tiered design with selective output review lands at 5.6% harmful answers and 4.0% benign refusals with 8.1% of prompts reviewed, and joint threshold tuning lifts macro-F1 from 0.9351 to 0.9512. Matched-budget gains over a retuned single gate are modest and not consistently observed on a held-out split, and the evidence covers three English safety sets only. Code and data are on GitHub.
summary.zh: 将 Jev（jev-latest）作为 Qwen2.5-1.5B 流水线的前置安全过滤器，在 970 条 AdvBench/XSTest 提示上端到端评测。输入过滤把有害提示的回答从 527/720（73.2%）降到 17/720（2.4%），但良性拒答从 1.2% 升到 10.8%；分层过滤加选择性输出复核落在 5.6% 有害回答、4.0% 良性拒答、8.1% 提示需复核，联合阈值调优将宏 F1 从 0.9351 提到 0.9512。与重新调参的单门在等预算下相比增益有限，且在留出集上不稳定；证据仅覆盖三个英文安全数据集。代码与数据在 GitHub。

papers.title: Label-Wording Augmentation in a Typed-Decision Encoder: Gains on Unfamiliar Words, Not on Abbreviations or Codes

summary.en: Compares two releases of Ru-Jev, an independent 307M multilingual cross-encoder trained on thirteen Russian tasks, isolating an augmentation that presents labels in several surface forms: questions held fixed, only the wording of eighteen routing labels varies across ten vocabularies. On held-out vocabularies of ordinary or borrowed words the augmented release is more accurate in every setting by up to 0.24 (11 of 14 gains survive Holm correction), but abbreviations gain nothing and opaque codes leave both releases at or below chance once training-related labels are removed; risk-coverage improves in most cells though confident errors rise with eighteen candidates on jargon and slang. Jev's API was not called - the name is homage only - and two unseen datasets move accuracy by -8.4 and +5.6 points, with four evaluation hazards documented.
summary.zh: 对比独立研发的 307M 多语交叉编码器 Ru-Jev 的两个版本，隔离出以多种表面形式呈现标签的增强：固定问题，仅改变十八个路由标签在十套词表中的措辞。在由常规词/外来词构成的留出词表上，增强版全部场景更准，最多高 0.24（14 项增益中 11 项通过 Holm 校正）；缩写无增益，不透明代码在剔除训练相关标签后两个版本都不高于随机；多数格子风险-覆盖面积改善，但十八候选下行话与俚语的自信错误增加。研究未调用 Jev API——名字仅为致敬；两个未见数据集上准确率分别变动 -8.4 与 +5.6 个百分点，并记录了四类评测隐患。

papers.title: Decision Models as Retrieval Gates Against Injection and Pollution

summary.en: Tests open-weight decision models as retrieval gates: a Kev-4B gate reads each passage's HTML and answers typed screening questions. On 1,000 questions over forum pages with hidden injected instructions, attack success falls from 27.9% with no defence to 13.6% with the published mitigations and 5.7% with the gate, at 76 ms per passage and 4 of 186 benign instruction-pages wrongly flagged; clean responsiveness stays within a point. On a 200-query pollution testbed with two thirds fake pages, pre-filtering the pool holds accuracy at 83% with 0.5% fake exposure versus 28% exposure unfiltered. Large-LLM judges rank attacks better (AUROC 0.99 versus 0.94) at ten times the cost; every model in the study is open-weight and hosted Jev is only cited.
summary.zh: 测试开放权重决策模型作为检索门控：Kev-4B 门读取每段的 HTML 并回答类型化筛查问题。在 1,000 个含隐藏注入指令的论坛页问题上，攻击成功率从无防御的 27.9% 降到已发表缓解措施的 13.6%、加门后 5.7%，单段 76 毫秒，186 个带人读指令的良性页误标 4 个；干净查询的响应率变化在一个点内。在三分之二页面为伪造的 200 查询污染测试台上，先过滤候选池使准确率保持 83%、伪造暴露仅 0.5%（无过滤为 28%）。大模型裁判排序更好（AUROC 0.99 对 0.94）但成本十倍；研究全部用开放权重模型，托管 Jev 仅被引用。

papers.title: Escalate or Close: How Fast-Tier Models Handle Held-Out Web Attack Families in Two-Tier Triage
affiliations: Wrocław University of Science and Technology

summary.en: Holds out each of seven web-attack families from training, recalibration and thresholds, splices the payloads into real browsing traffic, and compares zero-shot decision models with supervised detectors, a local language model, the OWASP Core Rule Set and an anomaly baseline. Supervised ModernBERT gives 37-60% of held-out path traversal a confident benign verdict, while hosted Jev and Clef escalate at least 97.6% of every family within a 5% benign budget (Jev 82-97% at 0.1%). The controls carry caveats: Jev escalates 37% of benign twins, its undisclosed training data may contain the public families, and a Jev-guided search pushes 43% of held-out attacks past Jev within 300 queries - re-asked, Jev escalates those same requests in 60% of its answers while Clef answers identically.
summary.zh: 把七个 Web 攻击族逐族从训练、再校准与阈值中留出，将载荷拼入真实浏览流量，比较零样本决策模型、监督检测器、本地语言模型、OWASP CRS 与异常基线。监督式 ModernBERT 给留出的路径穿越攻击 37-60% 的低危判定，而托管 Jev 与 Clef 在 5% 良性预算内对每个族至少上报 97.6%（0.1% 预算下 Jev 82-97%）。控制实验揭示了限制：Jev 会把 37% 的良性孪生请求上报，其未公开的训练数据可能已含这些公开攻击族，且 Jev 引导的搜索能在 300 次查询内让 43% 的留出攻击通过——重问时 Jev 对这些请求 60% 的答案又改为上报，Clef 则始终一致。

papers.title: RouteAlign: Aligning Task Requirements with Model Profiles for LLM Service Selection

summary.en: Structures LLM service selection around task requirements: historical requirements build global model profiles and local capability estimates, incoming requirements decide which measurements the current choice leans on, a shared scorer integrates the evidence and a generation-cost preference gates the final selection. Against established routers, direct candidate invocation and open Jev-style decision backends (Kev 0.8B-9B, Open-Jev 2B/9B, Decider, SemIf), RouteAlign pushes the quality-cost frontier outward, exceeding the strongest Jev-style configuration by 5.22 and 6.44 points on the two headline metrics at 9.7% lower generation cost. Hosted Jev is not used; results rest on the authors' heterogeneous service pool, and scorer reuse is validated only in catalog-update simulations.

papers.title: Probabilistic Relevance Decisions for Semantic Retrieval

summary.en: Compares dense-only BGE-M3 with TypeSafe Jev (Noul interface, jev-1.13.0) and OpenAI Decisions Predicate reranking on BEIR SciFact: 300 official queries over positive-enriched 100-document pools and full-corpus retrieval reranked at depths 50 and 100. At depth 50, full-corpus nDCG@10 rises from 0.6413 (dense) to 0.7545 (OpenAI) and 0.7805 (Jev), with Jev highest on observed Recall@5 and nDCG@10; unique-condition API scoring roughly doubles cost, Jev at 0.0016 USD per query with 3.13 s median rerank latency, partly offset by cached decisions. All four paired-bootstrap depth intervals include zero, OpenAI returns many exact-zero scores whose secondary tie randomization reveals ranking sensitivity, and the exploratory unadjusted analyses claim no general superiority, calibration or depth equivalence.

papers.title: The Blindfolded Controller: Decision Model-Guided Training for Reinforcement Learning

summary.en: Decision Model-Guided Training initialises an RL policy by querying d3-turbo, an open multimodal decision model, with a textual description of the environment and task; the agent reaches the goal and earns reward from its first episodes, then RL improves beyond what the DM alone achieves. Across seven sparse-reward tasks the combination beats pure RL in all seven and the DM-only baseline in five, and ablations distil guidelines for writing environment and task descriptions for a DM. Hosted Jev is cited only as an example decision model; gains are shown on the authors' own task suite, and the description guidelines are summarised from the same ablations that motivated them.

papers.title: AffordJEV: Affordance Grounding by Confirming Candidate Regions

summary.en: Replaces chain-of-thought affordance grounding with hierarchical confirmation: frozen segmenters propose object, part and sub-part regions, and a System One judge - a LoRA-tuned head on Qwen3.5-4B - scores all candidates of a level in one pass, with verdicts flowing both directions so later levels correct earlier ones. Trained only on InstructPart, it beats chain-of-thought methods in-domain and in zero-shot transfer to UMD and IIT-AFF, and runs better overall than the released judges Valen-4B, H2O-Lightning-4B and JevAny-4B-LoRA placed in the same framework, retrained variants included. Hosted Jev appears only as a cited API reference; operation-word alignment moves gains by 14.22 gIoU for their judge versus 6.39 for retrained JevAny, so wording sensitivity is not isolated from architecture.
summary.zh: 用层级确认替代思维链式可供性定位：冻结分割器提出物体/部件/子部件候选，System One 判别器（Qwen3.5-4B 上的 LoRA 调优头）单次前向为同层全部候选打分，判据双向流动、后层可纠正前层。仅用 InstructPart 训练，在域内与零样本迁移 UMD、IIT-AFF 上超过思维链方法，整体优于放入同一框架的已发布判别器 Valen-4B、H2O-Lightning-4B、JevAny-4B-LoRA（含各自重训版本）。托管 Jev 仅作为 API 文献被引用；操作词对齐使其判别器增益变动 14.22 gIoU、重训 JevAny 为 6.39，措辞敏感性与架构因素未被分离。

papers.title: Towards Foundation Decision Models: Drex

summary.en: A vendor technical report presenting Drex, four open decision models (8B DLM, 9B v1.5, 35B with 3B active v2.0, 27B Max) that follow the System One interface Jev introduced and build on the open Kev stack. Training combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning from adjusted feedback plus consistency losses (and vision tuning for Max); on Decision Index 0.4.1 Max scores 67.52 versus 60.70 for hosted Jev 1.14.0, and on Decision Bench v4 it beats Jev 1.14, ties statistically with d3-turbo and GPT-6 Sol, trails Claude Opus 5.5 by 1.6 points and answers in 183 ms. The numbers are self-reported by Nace.AI on benchmarks it also runs, the hosted-Jev comparison depends on API versions at test time, and option-reorder stability is reported for the Drex models rather than audited independently.
summary.zh: Nace.AI 技术报告，发布 Drex 四个开源决策模型（8B DLM、9B v1.5、35B/3B 激活 v2.0、27B Max），沿用 Jev 开创的 System One 接口并基于开源 Kev 栈构建。训练结合监督微调与调整反馈强化学习（RLAF）及一致性损失（Max 另加视觉调优）；Decision Index 0.4.1 上 Max 得 67.52，托管 Jev 1.14.0 为 60.70；Decision Bench v4 上超过 Jev 1.14，与 d3-turbo、GPT-6 Sol 统计打平，落后 Claude Opus 5.5 1.6 分，单次请求 183 毫秒。数字由 Nace.AI 在其自跑的基准上自行报告，托管 Jev 对比取决于测试时的 API 版本，选项重排稳定性也仅由 Drex 方面自报、未经独立审计。

papers.title: Extending Reasoning in Typed Decision Models via Looping
affiliations: Lamarr Institute for Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence

summary.en: Shows that looping a block of layers helps only when trained together with the decision model: RELOAD fine-tunes pretrained encoders and decoders with a damped loop over the middle block while a lightweight controller picks the number of passes per input. Across six models from 0.4B to 4B (decoders follow the open Kev reconstruction of Jev-style models), looping improves accuracy and calibration, with encoder gains up to 23 points on problems needing longer reasoning chains than any seen in training; neither matched training compute nor more data closes the gap, and separate per-pass layers come close only at nearly twice the parameters. The controller keeps most of the gain at about three quarters of the compute. Hosted Jev is not evaluated.
summary.zh: 证明循环层只有与决策模型共同训练才有收益：RELOAD 用中间块的阻尼循环微调预训练编码器/解码器，轻量控制器按输入自适应选择循环次数。在 0.4B-4B 的六个模型上（解码器遵循开源 Kev 的 Jev 风格重建），循环同时提升准确率与校准，在需要比训练时更长推理链的问题上编码器最高增益 23 个百分点；等量训练算力或更多数据都无法弥合差距，逐遍独立层要近两倍参数才接近。控制器以约四分之三算力保留大部分增益。未评测托管 Jev。

problem.zh: 类型化决策模型能否不靠生成 token 就为困难输入投入更多测试时算力？

papers.title: EarthJev: Efficient Visual Evidence Acquisition and Decision for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding
affiliations: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project

summary.en: Separates region scoring from answer generation for UHR remote-sensing VQA: a spatial pointer verifier uses visual and geometric cues to guide exploration or bypass search, an evidence-aware decision mechanism scores compact candidate views in batches with a lightweight head on frozen representations instead of generating textual region judgments, and format-specific confidence calibration selects between answers generated from memory and from overview presentations of the acquired evidence. Across five benchmarks with frozen Qwen3.5-9B it reaches 53.06% mean accuracy, beating ZoomSearch with the same answering model by 2.33-14.73 points per benchmark while cutting mean latency from 11.30 to 1.67 s per question; with four additional frozen answering models, model-specific fitting of the decision modules and calibration mappings adds 3.41-6.53 points over single-pass baselines. The Jev in the name follows the Jev-style scoring idea - hosted Jev is cited (TypeSafe blog) but not called - and the decision modules are fitted per answering model.
summary.zh: 面向超高分辨率遥感 VQA 把区域打分与答案生成分离：空间指针校验器用视觉与几何线索引导探索或跳过搜索；证据感知决策机制用冻结表征上的轻量头批量为紧凑候选视图打分，不再生成文字化的区域判断；格式特定的置信校准在记忆视图与全景证据生成的答案间做选择。冻结 Qwen3.5-9B 下五个基准平均准确率 53.06%，逐基准超过同回答模型的 ZoomSearch 2.33-14.73 个百分点，平均延迟从 11.30 秒降到 1.67 秒；再加四个冻结回答模型，按模型拟合决策模块与校准映射较单遍基线再增 3.41-6.53 个百分点。名称中的 Jev 沿用 Jev 式打分思想——托管 Jev 仅被引用（TypeSafe 博客）未被调用——决策模块按回答模型逐一拟合。

papers.title: Presentation Sensitivity in Typed Decision Models for Subjective Text Evaluation

summary.en: Audits Jev 1.13, Clef Flash and Perplexity Decider on 9,000 annotated items through 702,000 judgments, independently varying order, identifiers, endorsements, framing and rubrics. Controlled comparisons and repeated calls separate presentation effects from repeatability: Jev favors second-position summaries by 6.11 probability points. Findings cover three English subjective-evaluation tasks; human-reference choices and rubric wording limit generalization.
summary.zh: 在 9,000 个标注样本、702,000 次判断上审计 Jev 1.13、Clef Flash 与 Perplexity Decider，分别控制顺序、标识符、背书、提问框架及评分量表；通过受控比较和重复调用区分呈现敏感性与重复稳定性。Jev 在摘要任务中对第二位置的概率偏好达 6.11 个百分点。结论限于三类英文主观评测任务，受人工参考答案选择与量表措辞影响。

papers.title: Zuse: A Decision Model for European Languages

summary.en: Studies 4B, 9B and 27B decision models with low-rank adapters and pointer heads for 27 European languages. Task-dependent calibration and data-mixture pitfalls are analyzed; English comparisons use Jev results reported by the Kev project. The European suite also guided model selection, most runs use one seed, and the full training recipe and data are undisclosed. Treat the findings as exploratory, not an independent multilingual win over Jev.
summary.zh: 研究面向 27 种欧洲语言、采用低秩适配器与指针头的 4B、9B、27B 决策模型，分析任务相关校准误差及数据混合问题；英文对比引用 Kev 项目报告的 Jev 结果。欧洲评测集同时参与选模，多数实验仅单种子，完整训练配方与数据未公开；应视为探索性结果，不能据此声称多语言性能胜过 Jev。

papers.title: TandemBench: Benchmarking Decision Models for Multi-Agent Collaboration

summary.en: Asks whether decision models can choose team plans, not just single actions: TandemBench builds 1,200 questions in multi-agent cooking scenarios where a coordination choice determines how members divide work, exchange resources and act in parallel, with reference answers established by execution and exact search; 40 native decision models (best: KnowLine at 62.50% decision accuracy, Laya-421M at 25.88%) are compared with 10 general-purpose LLMs, and in paired variants that add or remove the optimal plan, models must judge whether better arrangements exist beyond the supplied options - verification accuracy stays near the 50% chance level for the native models while paired tests expose systematic reporters of better alternatives, showing that plan-choice accuracy alone can conceal such errors. Hosted Jev is not among the evaluated systems.
summary.zh: 追问决策模型能否不只选单个动作、还能选团队计划:TandemBench 构造多智能体做饭场景中的 1,200 个问题,协调选择决定成员如何分工、交换资源与并行行动,参考答案由执行与精确搜索确立;40 个原生决策模型(最优 KnowLine 决策准确率 62.50%,Laya-421M 仅 25.88%)与 10 个通用大模型对比,并在保留或移除最优计划的配对变体中判断给定选项之外是否存在更优安排——原生模型的验证准确率始终徘徊在 50% 随机水平附近,配对检验还暴露出一批无论最优计划是否在场都报告「有更好方案」的模型,说明仅看选计划的准确率会掩盖这类系统性错误。托管 Jev 不在被测系统之列。

problem.en: Can native decision models both select optimal multi-agent team plans and verify whether better arrangements exist?
problem.zh: 原生决策模型能否既选出多智能体最优团队计划,又判断选项之外是否存在更优安排?

papers.title: A Systematic Comparison of In-Context Learning Strategies for Peptide Property Prediction in Low-Data Regimes
affiliations: Institute for Molecules and Materials, Radboud University

summary.en: Systematically compares in-context learning strategies for peptide property prediction across five low-data tasks (pH-dependent surface activity, IR spectral signatures, self-assembly, two anti-cancer activities), benchmarking LLMs, tabular foundation models, XGBoost and typed decision models - hosted Jev 1.14 and GPT-6 Luna Decisions - as ICL predictors against the classical baseline. ICL is competitive but does not significantly outperform XGBoost, and performance varies between models and tasks; Jev 1.14 achieves a higher mean macro-F1 across the five tasks than DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash and Gemma-4 31B, with endpoint cost reporting that includes Jev 1.14 at USD 0.042 per 1M input tokens. Label-corruption ablations suggest models use both in-context examples and pretraining knowledge, which can bias predictions toward established sequence-property relationships. Datasets are small, so between-model differences lack statistical power, and the Jev results are zero-shot API calls on one peptide suite.
summary.zh: 在五个低数据多肽性质任务（pH 依赖表面活性、IR 光谱特征、自组装、两项抗癌活性）上系统比较上下文学习策略：LLM、表格基础模型（TabPFN v2、TabFM）、XGBoost 与类型化决策模型——托管 Jev 1.14 和 GPT-6 Luna Decisions——作为 ICL 预测器与经典基线对照。ICL 有竞争力但未显著超越 XGBoost，且随模型与任务波动；Jev 1.14 在五任务平均 macro-F1 高于 DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash 与 Gemma-4 31B，附终点成本对比（Jev 1.14 每百万输入 token 0.042 美元）。标签损坏消融显示模型同时利用上下文示例与预训练知识，可能使预测偏向既有构效关系。数据集小、模型间差异检验功效有限；Jev 结果为单一多肽套件上的零样本 API 调用。

problem.zh: 上下文学习（含托管决策模型）能否在低数据条件下预测多肽性质？

papers.title: TACT: A Pragmatic Approach to Qualitative Analysis with an AI Council

summary.en: Keeps humans in control of AI-assisted thematic analysis by bounding an AI council: TACT has AI coders from different model families assign codes, adversaries critique each coder's assignments, a reconciler merges them, and a decision model - TypeSafe's Jev 1.13, answering a yes/no question with a calibrated 0-1 score - surfaces high-uncertainty code assignments for human review; on 256 Stack Overflow threads coded by other researchers the candidate codebook reaches F1 0.75-0.77 and final coding F1 0.71-0.72, manual-versus-TACT agreement is Cohen's kappa 0.79-0.85 on a held-out sample, and model calls cost $13.77 (TACT-Lite) to $33.59 (TACT-Full) per 100 threads.
summary.zh: 用有边界的「AI 议会」把解释权留在人手里:不同模型家族的 AI 编码员各自赋码,对抗者逐一批评其他编码员的赋码,再由调和者合并;决策模型——TypeSafe 的 Jev 1.13,以 0~1 校准分数回答一个是/否问题——负责把高不确定性的赋码挑出来交人复核;在他人标注的 256 个 Stack Overflow 帖子上,候选码本 F1 0.75~0.77、最终编码 F1 0.71~0.72,保留样本上人工与 TACT 编码的一致性 Cohen's kappa 0.79~0.85,每 100 个帖子的模型调用成本 13.77 美元(TACT-Lite)至 33.59 美元(TACT-Full)。

problem.zh: AI 辅助的主题分析能否规模化,同时让人类保留解释与判断权?

papers.title: Decision Models as Scalable Economic Surrogates that Capture Human Variation
affiliations: London School of Economics and Political Science

summary.en: Tests decision models as human surrogates in economics, a role increasingly filled by costly LLMs that under-represent variation in human behaviour: 10 DMs (including Jev jev-1.13.0, one of the four frontier DMs by Artificial Analysis Decision Index, alongside D1 Ultra, Mammoth and Perplexity) are compared with 8 LLMs in a household spending survey, classic economic games and a labour-market field experiment; frontier DMs reproduce the variation in human responses more closely than LLMs in all three settings, match LLMs on the modal human response in the spending survey but less well in the games, and run roughly ten times faster than the fastest LLM at potentially over a hundred times lower cost, while non-frontier DMs such as Laya and AnyJev sit near a uniform-response benchmark.
summary.zh: 检验决策模型能否充当经济学中的人类代理——这个角色目前多由昂贵且低估人群行为差异的 LLM 担任:在家庭消费调查、经典经济博弈与劳动力市场现场实验三个场景中,10 个决策模型(含 jev-1.13.0 版 Jev,按 Artificial Analysis 决策指数与 D1 Ultra、Mammoth、Perplexity 并列四个前沿 DM)与 8 个 LLM 对比;前沿 DM 在全部三个场景中都比 LLM 更贴近人类应答的变异分布,在消费调查中捕捉众数应答的能力与 LLM 持平、在博弈中稍逊,速度约为最快 LLM 的十倍、成本可低两个数量级以上;Laya、AnyJev 等非前沿 DM 则接近均匀响应基线。

papers.title: Jev with Foresight: Safe Language-Guided Autonomous Driving via a Language World Model
affiliations: Lyles School of Civil and Construction Engineering, Purdue University

summary.en: Closes the safety gap between language-guided driving agents and world-model agents by pairing the two: Jev-AD grounds the passenger's free-form command once with four typed questions answered by Jev (jev-1.13.0 through its HTTP API, about 870 input tokens per decision state), then a language world model predicts for every candidate action how up to nine nearby vehicles move over the next two seconds, and code turns those predictions into foreseen consequences that Jev compares instead of inferring them from coordinates; in 500 simulated highway-merging episodes this foresight lowers the same decision model's collision rate from 26.0% to 2.4% at 0.25 seconds per decision, achieves the passenger's intent in 93% of command trials, and in 500 replayed real-world NGSIM episodes cuts collisions from 48.2% to 2.8% while the world model foresees 93% of dangerous actions.
summary.zh: 把语言驾驶智能体与世界模型智能体的长处拼在一起:Jev-AD 先用四个类型化问题让 Jev(经 HTTP API 调用 jev-1.13.0,每个决策状态约 870 输入 token)一次性理解乘客的自由格式指令,再由语言世界模型为每个候选动作预测未来两秒内至多九辆近旁车辆的运动,代码把这些预测转写成「可预见的后果」交给 Jev 比较,而不必从坐标里隐式推断;在 500 段仿真高速汇入场景中,该预见把同一决策模型的碰撞率从 26.0% 降到 2.4%,每次决策仅 0.25 秒,93% 的指令试验达成乘客意图;在 500 段真实 NGSIM 复放中碰撞率从 48.2% 降至 2.8%,世界模型预见 93% 的危险动作。

problem.zh: 若由代码提供可预见的后果,类型化决策模型能否依自然语言指令安全驾驶?

papers.title: Fast, Cheap, and Fair? Evaluating Decision Models

summary.en: Runs the first systematic bias and fairness audit of JEV (jev-1.13.0) as a recruitment screener, an EU AI Act high-risk use: counterfactual CV datasets vary explicit demographic attributes and implicit cues, effects are measured on screening scores, rankings and shortlists against a noise floor from name substitutions and typos, and JEV is compared with the open-weight Laya and generative GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6.1 Sol; JEV is nearly deterministic (Excl@5 run-to-run 2.9% versus 29.6% for GPT-6 Luna), its statistically significant biases remain small - score shifts peak at 0.37 points, rank shifts stay below 0.4 positions in pools of 41-65 CVs, exclusion of shortlisted candidates peaks at 8.2% - and names rather than explicitly stated attributes drive the remaining effects, while shortlist validity stays comparable to the generative models.
summary.zh: 对 JEV(jev-1.13.0)做首个系统性的招聘场景偏见与公平性审计——EU AI Act 定性的高风险用途:反事实简历数据集同时改变显式人口属性与隐性线索,对筛选得分、排名与短名单的影响都以姓名替换和错别字构成的噪声下限为参照,并将 JEV 与开源 Laya、生成式 GPT-6 Luna、GPT-6.1 Sol 对比;JEV 几乎是确定性的(短名单变动 Excl@5 重复运行 2.9%,GPT-6 Luna 为 29.6%),统计显著的偏见幅度很小——得分变化峰值 0.37 分,41~65 份简历池中排名变化不超过 0.4 位,短名单排除率峰值 8.2%——且残余效应主要由姓名而非显式属性驱动,短名单效度与生成式模型相当。

papers.title: ReListen: Training-Free Evidence Localization in Hour-Long Audio with Frozen Audio Language Models
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

summary.en: Lets a frozen audio language model find its own evidence in hour-long recordings using the Jev decision interface: in a Jev-style scan (TypeSafe AI, 2026), each 20-second window receives a yes/no decision read as a probability rather than generated text, and the model then answers from the highest-scoring minute; the selected minute overlaps the annotated evidence for 88.5% of VoiceGiraffe questions versus 58.8% for transcript retrieval, the same scan grounds events on LAT-Bench (temporal IoU 47.7) as well as a model trained for temporal grounding, answering from it beats uniformly sampled audio by 8.5-21.3 points and the whole-recording transcript by 9.2 points on VoiceGiraffe, with constant memory and no training.
summary.zh: 让冻结的音频语言模型用 Jev 的决策接口在小时级录音里自己找证据:在 Jev 式扫描(TypeSafe AI, 2026)中,每个 20 秒窗口得到的是一个作为概率读取的是/否决策而非生成文本,模型随后只「重听」得分最高的一分钟再作答;所选分钟与人工标注证据的重叠率在 VoiceGiraffe 上达 88.5%,转录检索仅 58.8%;同一扫描在 LAT-Bench 上的时间 IoU(47.7)与专门训练的时序定位模型相当;从所选证据作答比均匀采样音频高 8.5~21.3 个点,在 VoiceGiraffe 上比整段录音的转录高 9.2 个点,且全程无需训练、显存恒定。

problem.en: Can a frozen audio language model locate its own evidence in hour-long recordings without training?
problem.zh: 冻结的音频语言模型能否不经训练,自行定位小时级录音中回答所需的证据?

papers.title: Structured Clinical Memory as Context for Probabilistic Decision Models: A Synthetic Evaluation with Jev

summary.en: Asks whether a compact structured memory helps a probabilistic decision model when the patient vignette is already available: 30 fully synthetic cases across twelve clinical domains are paired with synthetically generated structured memory and 120 typed questions are evaluated with Jev; the raw-vignette arm reaches 90.0% accuracy (95% CI 84.6-95.4) and adding memory 93.3% (88.9-97.8), with five questions flipping incorrect-to-correct and one the other way (McNemar p=0.219), a gain the authors themselves flag as not statistically significant.
summary.zh: 追问在患者病史原文已经可用时,紧凑的结构化记忆还能否帮助概率决策模型:构造覆盖 12 个临床领域的 30 个全合成病例,配以合成生成的结构化记忆,用 Jev 评测 120 个类型化问题;仅用原始病史文本准确率 90.0%(95% CI 84.6~95.4),加入结构化记忆后为 93.3%(88.9~97.8),5 题由错转对、1 题由对转错(McNemar p=0.219),作者明确指出该提升未达统计显著。

problem.en: Does a structured memory added to the raw patient vignette improve Jev's typed clinical answers?
problem.zh: 在原始病史文本之上加入结构化记忆,能否提升 Jev 的类型化临床作答?

papers.title: Thinking Fast, Trading Late: System One Decision Models vs the Market

summary.en: Tests how much of the reported news-reading predictability of LLMs survives a look-ahead-free protocol, applied to System One decision models reading S&P 500 company news: OLIVIA uses point-in-time inputs with company identities masked, selects on validation data only, freezes the analysis plan by cryptographic hash, and unblinds the test period once through a logged lock; the readers are an open-weights model fine-tuned on 2024-2025 data plus three commercial decision models (Laya as the workhorse, with d3 among the systems), and the pre-registered evaluation reports what edge, if any, survives memorization and selection effects - code is released while the private data are not.
summary.zh: 检验 LLM「读新闻预测股价」的能力在排除前视偏差的协议下还剩多少,并把被测对象换成阅读标普 500 公司新闻的系统一决策模型:OLIVIA 用时点数据并掩去公司身份、只在验证集上做选择、以密码学哈希冻结分析计划、经留痕解锁一次性揭开测试期;读新闻的是在 2024—2025 数据上微调的开源权重模型加三个商用决策模型(以 Laya 为主力,d3 亦在列);预注册评估报告剔除记忆与选择效应后(若有)剩余的优势——代码已开源,数据不公开。

problem.en: Does decision-model news reading still predict stock returns under a pre-registered, look-ahead-free test?
problem.zh: 在预注册、无前视的测试下,决策模型读新闻还能预测股票收益吗?

papers.title: SLATE: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Long-Horizon API Selection in E-commerce Tool Use

summary.en: Benchmarks long-horizon API selection for e-commerce agents that must map each step of a standard operating procedure to one call among thousands of internal APIs, judged only by overall task success: SLATE (camera-ready for the NeurIPS 2026 AABA4ET workshop) exposes thousands of tools, evaluates multi-step behavior objectively instead of via LLM-as-judge scores that penalize valid alternative trajectories, and compares backbone LLMs against open decision models fine-tuned for the same choice (Jevify, AgentDecision, Strands-Decider, OpenJev-Flash-9B); decision models sharply raise step-wise accuracy over their backbones (e.g. 72.3% vs 65.7% at 4B, 74.8% vs 67.7% at 9B) while end-to-end task success stays in single digits for every system, locating the open problem.
summary.zh: 为电商智能体的长程 API 选择建基准:须把标准作业流程的每一步映射到数千个内部 API 中的正确调用,且只以整任务成败论英雄;SLATE(NeurIPS 2026 AABA4ET 工作坊 camera-ready)提供数千工具,以客观标准而非惩罚合法替代路径的 LLM-as-judge 评分多步行为,并对比骨干 LLM 与为同一选择微调的开源决策模型(Jevify、AgentDecision、Strands-Decider、OpenJev-Flash-9B);决策模型显著提升逐步准确率(如 4B 时 72.3% 对 65.7%,9B 时 74.8% 对 67.7%),但所有系统的端到端任务成功率仍是个位数,开放问题由此定位。

problem.en: Can agents pick the right API call among thousands, over long horizons, judged only by task success?
problem.zh: 智能体能否在数千个 API 中做对长程选择,且只以任务成败论定?

papers.title: JevBreak: Your Model, Their Decision

summary.en: Shows that restricting a decision model's vocabulary does not restrict an attacker's influence: the Slot Attack appends text assembled from named components to steer predictions toward an attacker-chosen wrong option that is still in the allowed set, using only the returned label probabilities; across seven decision models spanning hosted APIs, open weights and an encoder, evaluated on 16 tasks from seven Decision Bench domains (240 examples, 990 targets per model), it flips 32-99% of initially correct decisions with a median of 17-72 queries per success, near-identical-accuracy models differ by about 20 points in attack success, and on roughly 20% of correct JEV decisions the attacker can force every available wrong answer in turn.
summary.zh: 证明限制模型能说什么并不等于限制攻击者对其决策的影响:Slot Attack 仅凭返回的标签概率,在证据中拼入由命名组件构成的文本,把预测推向仍在合法选项集内的攻击者指定错误答案;在来自 Decision Bench 七个领域 16 个任务的 240 个例子上评测七个决策模型(托管 API、开源权重与编码器,每模型 990 个目标),对初始正确决策的成功率 32%~99%,每次成功平均只需 17~72 次查询;准确率几乎相同的模型攻击成功率可差约 20 个百分点;对 JEV 模型约 20% 的正确决策,攻击者能依次 forcing 全部错误选项。

problem.en: Can a black-box attacker steer typed decision models to any chosen wrong option using only returned probabilities?
problem.zh: 黑盒攻击者能否仅凭返回的概率,把类型化决策模型导向任意指定的错误选项?

papers.title: Honest Small Decision Models for Finance: Scale, Specialization Collapse, and Mixed-Corpus Remediation

summary.en: Trains System-1 decision models for finance and audits what specialization costs: small LLMs (two families, K2-Horizon and Qwen3.5/3.8, nine rungs from 0.8B to 32B) are fine-tuned with one frozen LoRA recipe to answer choice/score/noul questions in a single pass - the primitive set TypeSafe's Jev established - on a public decision benchmark plus two new finance corpora (a programmatic-gold policy corpus and a reality-labeled outcome corpus with 19,640 realized forward-return questions in walk-forward splits and a sealed 2026 test); narrow fine-tuning costs 9-45 points of general decision competence, a gap that shrinks with scale, and on reality-labeled questions every rung lands at the horizon-conditioned prior (accuracy 0.37-0.38) with flat, well-calibrated probabilities - naturally honest uncertainty, sweet-spot ECE 0.026 at 2B - while mixed-corpus training remediates the collapse.
summary.zh: 为金融训练系统一决策模型并审计专业化的代价:用同一冻结 LoRA 配方,在 0.8B~32B 的九档小模型(K2-Horizon 与 Qwen3.5/3.8 两族)上单次前向回答 choice/score/noul——即 TypeSafe Jev 确立的原语集——训练数据为公开决策基准加两个新金融语料(程序化金标准的政策语料,以及含 19,640 个实盘前瞻收益问题、滚动划分并封存 2026 测试集的现实标注语料);窄域微调使通用决策能力损失 9~45 个点,差距随规模缩小;在现实标注问题上,所有档位都落在按期限条件化的先验(准确率 0.37~0.38),概率平坦而校准良好——天然诚实的未知,2B 处 ECE 0.026 最佳——混合语料训练可修复专业坍缩。

problem.en: What does finance-specific fine-tuning cost general decision competence, and can models be honest about unpredictable returns?
problem.zh: 金融微调要付出多少通用决策能力?模型能否对不可预测的收益保持诚实?

papers.title: EO-Jev: Decision Model for Earth Observation
affiliations: Mohamed Bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

summary.en: Brings decision models to earth observation, where workflows must select among known outcomes, estimate confidence and process large imagery volumes without autoregressive costs: a diagnostic study of the open 8.4B d3-flash across 30 settings from 23 public EO benchmarks finds that compositional reasoning transfers well while quantitative perception, option-order consistency and calibration under distribution shift remain weak; low-rank fine-tuning on public EO training splits produces EO-Jev, which improves over d3-flash on 26 of 30 settings and matches or exceeds specialist reference models, with training code released (hosted Jev appears as the paradigm's origin, not an evaluated system).
summary.zh: 把决策模型引入对地观测:此类工作流要在已知结果中做选择、估计置信度并处理海量影像,且不能承受自回归解码的成本;对开源 8.4B d3-flash 在 23 个公开 EO 基准的 30 个设定上的诊断发现,组合推理迁移良好,但定量感知、选项顺序一致性与分布漂移下的校准仍是短板;在公开 EO 训练集上做低秩微调得到 EO-Jev,在 30 个设定中的 26 个超过 d3-flash,并追平或超过专用参照模型;训练代码已开源(托管 Jev 仅作为范式来源出现,未被评测)。

problem.en: How far does a general decision model reach on earth-observation tasks, and what does EO fine-tuning fix?
problem.zh: 通用决策模型在对地观测任务上能走多远?领域微调能修复什么?

papers.title: Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry

summary.en: Guides ultrasound landmark detection with clinical measurement questions instead of task-specific heads: inspired by System One decision models, Kev-Bio uses decision representations of the language model to generate a query for each caliper endpoint, matches the queries against shared dense ultrasound features to produce spatial probability maps, and derives landmark coordinates and clinical measurements from them, trained end-to-end with both localization and measurement losses; on the nine-view FU/GU Biometry 2026 dataset it reaches a mean radial error of 22.50 pixels and a clinical-measurement MAE of 15.38, outperforming compared baselines and attacking the inter-operator variability of manual caliper placement.
summary.zh: 用临床测量问题而非任务专用头来引导超声 landmark 检测:受系统一决策模型启发,Kev-Bio 利用 language model 的决策表示为每个卡尺端点生成查询,将其与共享的稠密超声特征匹配得到空间概率图,再由图导出 landmark 坐标与临床测量值,并以定位与测量两类损失端到端训练;在九视角的 FU/GU Biometry 2026 数据集上,平均径向误差 22.50 像素、临床测量 MAE 15.38,总体优于对比基线,直面手工放置卡尺带来的操作者间差异。

problem.en: Can measurement questions and spatial probability maps replace manual caliper placement in ultrasound biometry?
problem.zh: 测量问题加空间概率图,能否替代超声测量中的人工卡尺放置?

papers.title: Every Clause Counts: Instruction-Following Reranking by Multiplying Small, Answerable Questions

summary.en: Makes search rerankers follow the instructions attached to queries - beginner-level pages, a specific language, official sources only - which topical rerankers treat as a few extra words (on InfoSearch even GPT-4o as a list-wise reranker averages only 33.5 WISE): DMReranker splits an instructed query into a topic plus a short list of typed clauses, has a small judge decision model (open Clef) answer one narrow question per clause, and multiplies the answer probabilities into a single score; the zero-shot pipeline needs no reranking-specific training and reaches a macro WISE of 50.9 over all six InfoSearch dimensions while keeping original-mode nDCG@10 at 82.9, trails GPT-4o only on the stricter SICR metric (19.2 vs 32.1 raw, 67.0 when computed from ranks), and costs about $10 at list price to score all six dimensions.
summary.zh: 让搜索重排器听懂查询附带的要求——面向初学者的页面、指定语言、仅官方来源——这些要求在主题重排器眼里只是几个多余的词(InfoSearch 上连 GPT-4o 列表式重排的 WISE 也只有 33.5):DMReranker 把带要求的查询拆成主题加一组类型化子句,由小型裁判决策模型(开源 Clef)对每条子句回答一个窄问题,再把答案概率相乘为单一分数;该零样本流水线无需重排专用训练,在 InfoSearch 全部六个维度上取得宏平均 WISE 50.9,同时原始模式 nDCG@10 保持 82.9;仅在更严格的 SICR 指标上落后 GPT-4o(原始分 19.2 对 32.1,按排名计算则为 67.0),按牌价给全部六个维度打分仅花约 10 美元。

problem.en: Can multiplying narrow typed-question probabilities teach rerankers to obey query instructions zero-shot?
problem.zh: 把窄问题概率相乘,能否让重排器零样本地服从查询中的要求?

papers.title: Cyber-JEV: Matched Contrastive Fine-Tuning of Language Models for Fast Source-Code Vulnerability Triage

summary.en: Trains open-weight models to rank source-code functions for vulnerability review in Jev's single-pass style: because public vulnerable-plus-clean benchmarks keep few vulnerable functions once test-related examples are removed while large vulnerability records hold almost only vulnerable code (mixing them lets the data source predict the label), Cyber-JEV uses fix commits to build matched comparison groups and applies contrastive fine-tuning so a function no longer scores above its own fixed original; an ensemble of five fine-tuned Qwen3.5-4B models reaches AUROC 0.814 versus 0.743 for Jev 1.13, and with Jev's 4,031 alerts as the review budget it misses 16 of 322 vulnerable functions where Jev misses 39.
summary.zh: 训练开源权重模型以 Jev 式单次前向为代码函数输出漏洞概率:由于同时含漏洞与无漏洞标签的公开基准在剔除与测试相关的样本后所剩漏洞函数寥寥,而更大的公开漏洞库几乎只有漏洞代码(直接混合会让数据来源泄露标签),Cyber-JEV 用修复提交构造匹配对照组并做对比微调,使模型不再把修复后的函数打得比原漏洞函数还高;五个微调 Qwen3.5-4B 组成的集成 AUROC 0.814,对比 Jev 1.13 的 0.743;以 Jev 的 4,031 条告警为审查预算时,322 个漏洞函数仅漏掉 16 个,而 Jev 漏掉 39 个。

problem.en: How can open-weight models learn fast source-code vulnerability triage when public labeled data is skewed?
problem.zh: 公开标注数据严重偏斜时,开源模型如何学会快速的源代码漏洞分诊?

papers.title: VerdictAD: Few-Shot Anomaly Detection via Decision-Guided Refinement

summary.en: Refines few-shot industrial anomaly detection with typed decisions instead of replacing the detector: visual differences do not always mean genuine defects (normal appearance variation inflates scores) and structural or logical anomalies may not move local features at all, so VerdictAD - a training-free framework - has a frozen open decision model (Clef-Flash, using the Noul yes/no primitive) answer a reference-free and a reference-conditioned question about the whole image and about local windows, then gates the base detector's score by the decision probability; global and local verdict refinement run on top of existing few-shot detectors, and code plus experimental logs are released (hosted Jev is cited for the interface, not evaluated).
summary.zh: 用类型化决策「精修」而非取代少样本工业异常检测:视觉差异未必是真缺陷(正常外观波动也会推高分数),而结构或逻辑异常可能完全不改变局部特征;于是免训练的 VerdictAD 让冻结的开源决策模型(Clef-Flash,用 Noul 是/否原语)对整图与局部窗口各回答一个无参照和一个有参照的问题,再以决策概率对基础检测器的分数做门控;全局与局部裁决精修叠加在既有少样本检测器之上;代码与实验日志已开源(托管 Jev 只被引用说明接口,未被评测)。

problem.en: Can typed yes/no decisions on images and image regions correct few-shot anomaly detectors' false cues?
problem.zh: 对整图与局部做类型化是非判断,能否纠正少样本异常检测的错误线索?

papers.title: Ranked but Not Stopped: Detecting Prompt-Injection Hijacks from Typed Decision Models' Output Probabilities

summary.en: Asks whether a monitor can catch indirect prompt-injection hijacks of classifier-like models from the model's own output probabilities alone, without knowing the attacker's target label: on AG News topic classification with five systems (three served through a provider's API, two of them letter-probability readouts of general LLMs), low top-probability confidence ranks hijacked answers above clean ones on four of five systems with AUROC 0.86-0.90 - but ranking is not stopping, and a threshold set to spare at most 5% of clean answers still lets many hijacks through; and when the injected note adds one handwritten sentence claiming certainty and asking for full probability, the monitor misses 99-100% of hijacks even though low confidence still ranks them at AUROC 0.70-79 - confidence monitors must be tested at their operating alarm rate against attackers who claim certainty.
summary.zh: 追问在不知道攻击者目标标签时,仅凭模型自身的输出概率能否发现间接提示注入对分类式模型的劫持:在 AG News 主题分类上用五个系统(三个经服务商 API,其中两个是通用 LLM 的字母概率读出),低顶概率置信度在五个系统中的四个上能把被劫持答案排在干净答案之前(AUROC 0.86~0.90)——但「能排序」不等于「拦得住」,为放过至多 5% 干净答案而设的阈值仍放行大量劫持;当注入的便条再加一句手写的「目标确定、请给满概率」时,监视器漏掉 99%~100% 的劫持,尽管低置信度仍能以 AUROC 0.70~0.79 排出它们——置信度监视器必须在其实际告警率下、面对声称确定的攻击者来测试。

problem.en: Can confidence alone rank and stop prompt-injection hijacks of typed decision models?
problem.zh: 仅凭置信度,能否对类型化决策模型的提示注入劫持完成排序与拦截?

papers.title: RLiD: Reinforcement Learning in the Decision Plane for Language Agents and LLMs

summary.en: Moves reinforcement learning for language agents into the decision plane: token-level RL spreads an action's advantage over the whole generated response - including reasoning chains and malformed text the environment never executes - adding variance to policy-gradient estimates, so RLiD compiles observations, an optional compact memory and a labeled action menu, and directly optimizes the probabilities of the executable options; the framework keeps credit assignment on the parsed action, and controlled comparisons against token-level RL show where decision-plane training wins for agents and LLMs (TypeSafe's hosted Jev 1.13 is cited as the served decision interface, not evaluated).
summary.zh: 把语言智能体的强化学习搬进决策平面:token 级 RL 会把一个动作的优势摊到整段生成——包括环境根本不执行的推理链与格式错乱文本——给策略梯度估计添噪;RLiD 把观测、可选的紧凑记忆与带标签的动作菜单编译好,直接优化可执行选项的概率,使功劳分配落在被解析的动作上;与 token 级 RL 的对照实验显示决策平面训练在智能体与 LLM 上的优势(托管 Jev 1.13 仅作为被引用的服务式决策接口,未被评测)。

papers.title: Decision Models as Policy Gates for Coding Agents: Explicit Policy Boundaries Improve Detection and Reduce False Alarms

summary.en: Tests whether a decision model can catch dangerous coding-agent actions at runtime: 22 hosted decision models and two prompted general models classify 2,643 synthetic tool calls (labeled blind against 28 rules, sealed holdout) in a multi-rule policy engine, with and without explicit policy boundaries written as examples and counterexamples; boundaries raise recall by 5.5-26.1 points on all 23 available models and cut false positives on 21 - Jev 1.14 goes from 89.3% to 98.2% recall while unnecessary interruptions fall from 30.6% to 4.8% - and with examples Jev's median latency is 120 ms at $0.46 per thousand requests; a follow-up on 16 scenarios written after the studies improves recall on 22 of 23 models.
summary.zh: 检验决策模型能否在运行时拦住危险编程智能体动作:让 22 个托管决策模型与两个提示型通用模型在多规则策略引擎中分类 2,643 条合成工具调用(盲标 28 条规则并设封存保留集),比较有无以示例与反例写成的显式策略边界;边界使全部 23 个可用模型召回率提升 5.5~26.1 个点、21 个模型误报下降——Jev 1.14 召回从 89.3% 升至 98.2%,不必要的打断从 30.6% 降到 4.8%——加示例后 Jev 中位延迟 120 毫秒、每千次请求 0.46 美元;在研究完成后新写的 16 个场景上,跟进实验使 22/23 个模型召回再升。

papers.title: EarthJev: Calibrated, Non-Generative Answers to Natural-Language Questions about Sentinel-2 Land Cover
affiliations: DIETI, University of Naples Federico II

summary.en: A 0.8B model that answers typed questions about 12-band Sentinel-2 patches without generating any token, following the open OneJev recipe (option-letter logits at one position, cross-entropy plus Brier). Trained on 70,890 questions from 5% of BigEarthNet v2.0, it reaches 86.0% accuracy on 36,028 test questions (three seeds) with ECE 0.006 at 19.9 ms per question; training the whole vision encoder raises accuracy to 88.4% at the same cost. Hosted Jev is neither used nor evaluated; multimodal baselines saw only RGB composites and the data cover ten European countries.

papers.title: Zero-shot evaluation of open vision-language models as System 1 decision models on radiology tasks

summary.en: Compares two open multimodal System 1 decision models - Clef 27B and d1 3B - with Clef's generative backbone (Qwen 3.8-27B) forced to single-token output, all run locally on one NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10), on seven radiology tasks spanning text, radiographs, CT and MRI: three text-interpretation tasks (findings in CT-RATE reports, PadChest reports) and four image-detection tasks (3D CT volumes, MR device safety from AccessGUDID, line-and-tube position on RANZCR CLiP, motion-artifact severity on MR-ART), with Clef and d1 returning a probability for every option in one non-autoregressive pass.

papers.title: DIMWIT: Directly Invoking Models Without Intensive Tuning
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin

summary.en: Asks pretrained models to make resource-management decisions directly instead of developing task-specific policies: on microservice autoscaling, DRAM sizing and video encoding, DIMWIT compares a frontier LLM (Claude Opus 5.5) with two small decision models - proprietary Jev and the open-weight 421M Laya - given the current system state, desired outcome and available choices; a small decision model meets latency targets on two microservice applications while using within 10% of the replicas allocated by a tuned controller, and Jev or Laya answer each decision in 0.1-0.2 s (Laya 2-3 s on CPU) against 3-4 s for Opus, keeping both well inside a 95% performance target on the DRAM-sizing use case.
summary.zh: 让预训练模型直接做资源管理决策,而非先开发任务专用策略:在微服务自动扩缩、DRAM 容量规划与视频编码三类任务上,DIMWIT 让前沿大模型(Claude Opus 5.5)与两个小型决策模型——专有 Jev 与开源 421M 的 Laya——依据当前系统状态、目标与候选动作直接选择;在两个微服务应用上,小决策模型在延迟达标的同时,副本数只比调优控制器多用不到 10%;Jev 与 Laya 每次决策 0.1~0.2 秒(Laya 在 CPU 上 2~3 秒),Opus 需 3~4 秒,且在 DRAM 规划用例中两者都稳守 95% 性能目标。

papers.title: XDecideBench: Evaluating Typed Decision Models and Confidence Policies Across Languages

summary.en: Benchmarks typed decision models and confidence policies across languages: XDecideBench covers nine suites, 122 languages, 88,425 texts and 153,875 typed questions under one scoring contract, reporting aligned, locally labelled and native items separately; model rankings change from suite to suite - the model best in English, chosen in hindsight, loses significantly in about a quarter of suite-language cells and falls far behind on Burmese Belebele - and three open models fine-tuned for typed decisions beat the Qwen models they were built from; hosted Jev is among the evaluated systems and the release includes pinned manifests, scorer and run receipts after pre-registration.

papers.title: Do GEO Gains Survive the Live Web? Evaluating In-the-Wild Visibility Gains of Generative Engine Optimization via LIVE-GEO
affiliations: School of Information Sciences, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign

summary.en: Asks whether generative-engine-optimization (GEO) visibility gains survive the live web, by publishing GEO-rewritten products as real webpages (LIVE-GEO) and evaluating five strategies on three generative engines (ChatGPT with GPT-6, Gemini 3.6 Thinking, Grok in Expert mode) against direct-text evaluators; the pipeline leans on typed decision models twice - a JEV safety screen rejects potentially malicious submissions, and a JEV verifier checks each description against its product specifications before publication, agreeing with reference labels on 90.7% of 194 numerical benchmark cases and with two-of-three human majorities on all 50 sampled descriptions, flagging 86 of 400 rewritten descriptions.

papers.title: IJev: Order-Invariant Decisions via Iterated Cyclic Reordering
affiliations: Hong Kong Institute of Science and Innovation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

summary.en: Removes the residual order bias left in System One choice decisions: averaging a listwise readout over the K cyclic shifts of one invariant order kills input-order dependence but still depends on which of the (K-1)! cyclic classes the operator picked, and the probabilities carry a label prior; IJev iterates - reorder the options by the cyclic-averaged, label-prior-corrected distribution, then run another cyclic average - so every iterate is exactly input-order-invariant, and when the iteration does not converge the round distributions are averaged instead; on five benchmarks and five instruction-tuned models (Qwen3 1.7B/4B/8B, Mistral-7B, Phi-3.5-mini), IJev has flip rate zero in every cell and the uniform average over T=20 rounds substantially improves calibration at comparable accuracy.
summary.zh: 消除系统一选择题残余的顺序偏差:把列表式读出在某个不变序的 K 个循环移位上平均,固然去掉了输入顺序依赖,却仍取决于算子选中了 (K-1)! 个循环类中的哪一个,且概率自带标签先验;IJev 迭代进行——按循环平均并校正标签先验后的分布重排选项,再做一轮循环平均——每一步迭代都严格输入序不变,不收敛时改为对各轮分布取平均;在五个基准与五个指令微调模型(Qwen3 1.7B/4B/8B、Mistral-7B、Phi-3.5-mini)上,IJev 每格翻转率均为零,T=20 轮均匀平均在准确率相近的同时大幅改善校准。

problem.en: Can option-order bias in single-pass choice decisions be eliminated exactly, at bounded cost, without training?
problem.zh: 单次前向选择题的选项顺序偏差,能否被精确消除、成本有界且无需训练?

papers.title: S1CogBench: What System One Decision Models Can and Cannot Do on Cognitive Experiments

summary.en: Argues that a fast, well-formed decision does not show the model used the evidence, and tests it with cognitive experiments: S1CogBench evaluates what System One decision models such as Jev and Laya can and cannot do on 24 cognitive tasks - varying task demands and measuring how behaviour changes the way cognitive science does - across five open models plus Jev, since software increasingly asks models for decisions in routing, guardrails and automated gates while leaving no text to inspect; the benchmark and analysis code are released.
summary.zh: 指出「答得快且格式正确」并不代表模型真的用了证据,并用认知实验加以检验:S1CogBench 在 24 个认知任务上考察 Jev、Laya 等系统一决策模型能与不能——像认知科学那样改变任务需求、观察行为如何随之变化——覆盖五个开源模型与 Jev;软件如今在路由、护栏与自动闸门中越来越多地要模型做决策且不留可检查的文本,这一盲区正是基准的动机;基准与分析代码已开源。

papers.title: Decision-Centric Research: A Calibrated Decision Model and Benchmark for Scientific Agents

summary.en: Makes individual choices the unit of supervision, prediction and evaluation for scientific agents: Decision-Centric Research (DCR) defines 24 decision types over an explicit Research State, instantiates ten of them in the Research Decision Benchmark (RD-Bench) of 2,000 rule-generated cases, and trains the Decision-Centric Research Model (DCRM), whose candidate-token readout is shared across types to emit answers and option probabilities in one forward pass; under a held-out research-domain split a 0.6B state-aware DCRM reaches 89.4% Top-1 versus 27.8% for its question-only twin and 36.4% for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and after held-out calibration its prediction sets average 1.515 candidates at 97.1% empirical coverage (57.4% smaller sets at similar coverage).
summary.zh: 让「单个选择」成为科学智能体的监督、预测与评估单元:决策中心研究(DCR)在显式研究状态上定义 24 种决策类型,把其中十种实例化为 2,000 条规则生成案例的研究决策基准 RD-Bench,并训练决策中心研究模型 DCRM——其候选 token 读出跨类型共享,一次前向同时给出答案与选项概率;在留出研究域划分下,0.6B 的状态感知 DCRM Top-1 准确率 89.4%,而仅见问题的孪生模型为 27.8%、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 为 36.4%;经留出域校准后,预测集平均 1.515 个候选即达 97.1% 经验覆盖(相近覆盖下集大小缩小 57.4%)。

papers.title: Trail: Accurate Local Smart Home Control Using Decision Models

summary.en: Replaces open-ended command generation in smart-home control with hierarchical typed decisions that run fully locally: Trail (Typed Registry-Anchored Inference) exploits the natural structure of a home's action space - selecting a room, then a device, then an operation from candidates derived from the runtime device registry - which keeps every action valid and enables confidence-based abstention when a request cannot be reliably resolved; the selector is JevK5, an open-source decision model built on Qwen3.5-4B (of the Jev and Microsoft-Decision-1 generation), fine-tuned once on action-resolution and argument decisions and reused for memory decisions, evaluated on Trek-Base/Trek-Robust suites against prompted and fine-tuned baselines.
summary.zh: 把智能家居控制的开放式指令生成换成完全本地运行的层次化类型化决策:Trail(类型化注册表锚定推理)利用家庭动作空间的天然结构——先选房间、再选设备、再选操作,候选全部来自运行时设备注册表——既保证动作恒为合法,又支持在请求无法可靠解析时基于置信度弃答;选择器为基于 Qwen3.5-4B 的开源决策模型 JevK5(与 Jev、Microsoft-Decision-1 同代),只在动作解析与参数决策上微调一次即复用于记忆决策,并在 Trek-Base/Trek-Robust 套件上与提示及微调基线对比。

papers.title: To Jev or Not to Jev: When Can System-1 Decision Models Replace LLM Judges?

summary.en: Asks when System-1 decision models can replace generative LLM judges: 14 System-1 decision models, selected by a pre-stated protocol from an independent leaderboard and every entry of a public decision-model catalog, are compared with four generative judges (Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-5.6 with and without reasoning, Claude Opus 5.5 with thinking) on eleven established judge benchmarks; five of the 14 are statistically indistinguishable from GPT-5.6 without reasoning on all pairwise and best-of-4 benchmarks, the two strongest (DReX-Max, d1-ultra) beat Haiku by 10.5-14.4 points, and with a once-generated reference answer eleven models reach 90.3-93.4% on JudgeBench - level with Opus 5.5 and GPT-5.6-with-reasoning - while Jev costs about one-sixteenth of GPT-5.6's price per prompt.
summary.zh: 追问系统一决策模型何时能替代生成式 LLM 裁判:按预先声明的协议从独立榜单与公开决策模型目录选出 14 个系统一决策模型,在 11 个成熟裁判基准上与四个生成式裁判(Claude Haiku 5.5、GPT-5.6 开/关推理、Claude Opus 5.5 thinking)对比;14 个中有 5 个在全部成对与四选一基准上与不开推理的 GPT-5.6 统计不可区分,最强的两个(DReX-Max、d1-ultra)超 Haiku 10.5~14.4 个点;给定一次性生成的参考答案后,11 个模型在 JudgeBench 上达 90.3%~93.4%,与 Opus 5.5 和开推理 GPT-5.6 持平,而 Jev 每条提示的成本约为 GPT-5.6 的十六分之一。

problem.en: When can System-1 decision models substitute for generative LLM judges, and at what accuracy and cost?
problem.zh: 系统一决策模型何时能替代生成式 LLM 裁判,准确率与成本如何?

papers.title: Swap, Replicate, Read the Mass: A Protocol for Auditing Demographic Bias in System One Decision Models

summary.en: Provides the first multi-model demographic-bias audit of System One decision models on established benchmarks: BBQ across all eleven categories, CrowS-Pairs and SilverSpoon are adapted to the typed interface; twelve models plus a no-thinking ablation make 1,638,000 decisions, with every order-sensitive item run twice under swapped options and native typed models additionally swapping labels; the audit finds widespread stereotype alignment, order-dependent answers, and confidence that tracks instability rather than error, with extra seeds and batch-16 repetitions for robustness - Jev, which ships only as an API, is audited through its hosted route.
summary.zh: 给出首个在成熟基准上的系统一决策模型多人种人口统计学偏差审计:把覆盖全部 11 个类别的 BBQ、CrowS-Pairs 与 SilverSpoon 适配到类型化接口;12 个模型加一个去思考消融共做出 1,638,000 次决策,每个顺序敏感条目都以交换选项跑两遍,原生类型化模型还额外交换标签,并以多种子与 batch-16 复测保证稳健;结果发现刻板印象倾向普遍存在、答案随选项顺序改变、置信度追踪的是不稳定而非错误;只以 API 形式提供的 Jev 通过其托管通道接受审计。

problem.en: How much demographic bias, order sensitivity and misplaced confidence do System One decision models carry into production decisions?
problem.zh: 系统一决策模型带入生产决策的群体偏差、顺序敏感与错位置信度有多重?

papers.title: Do Multimodal Models Decide Consistently on Equivalent Optical Spectra?

summary.en: Tests whether multimodal decision models decide consistently when the same optical spectrum is presented in equivalent forms: measured spectra of silicon metasurfaces (MOCLIP) and gold nanoparticles are shown as four tables (nm, um, scientific notation, eV) and two plots, with partial spectra removing data inside or outside the queried range, to the decision models d3-nano and Jev 1.13, three GPT-6 Luna configurations and the Qwen3.5-2B base model; the audit measures representation invariance (the decision should not depend on which equivalent form the model sees) and abstention when the data needed for an answer is missing.
summary.zh: 检验多模态决策模型对同一光学光谱的不同等价呈现是否给出一致决策:把硅超表面(MOCLIP)与金纳米颗粒的实测光谱分别以四种表格(纳米、微米、科学计数、电子伏特)与两种图呈现,并以部分光谱删去查询区间内外的数据,评测决策模型 d3-nano 与 Jev 1.13、三种 GPT-6 Luna 配置及 Qwen3.5-2B 基座;审计度量表征不变性(等价形式不应改变决策)与数据缺失时的弃答行为。

problem.en: Do decision models give the same answer for equivalent table and plot representations of a spectrum, and abstain when data is missing?
problem.zh: 对光谱的等价表格与图像呈现,决策模型会给出相同答案吗?数据缺失时会弃答吗?

papers.title: Humanized but Still True? Auditing Facts and Detection in AI-Text Humanizers

summary.en: Audits AI-text humanizers on two axes - do facts survive the rewrite, and can the output be detected: on the October 2026 cycle of a public humanizer leaderboard, all 11 commercial tools change or drop at least one checkable unit (numbers, dates, names, quoted spans) in 35-65% of the documents containing one, most often quoted spans; and on federal texts where human originals, AI-styled rewrites and humanized versions cover the same content, a single zero-shot choice question to Jev (typesafe/jev-1.13 via OpenRouter) separates human originals from humanized rewrites with AUROC 0.864 (0.827-0.902), a signal four other detectors miss.
summary.zh: 从两个维度审计 AI 文本人性化工具——事实是否在改写中幸存、产物能否被识别:在公开人性化榜单 2026 年 10 月周期中,全部 11 款商业工具都会在 35%~65% 的含可核查单元(数字、日期、人名、引文片段)文档中改动或丢失至少一个单元,引文片段受损最多;在人类原文、AI 风格改写与人性化产物覆盖相同内容的联邦文本上,向 Jev(经 OpenRouter 调用 typesafe/jev-1.13)仅问一个零样本选择题,即可区分人类原文与人性化文本,AUROC 0.864(0.827~0.902),而其余四个检测器均无此信号。

problem.en: Do AI-text humanizers preserve checkable facts, and can a decision model catch their outputs zero-shot?
problem.zh: AI 文本人性化工具会保留可核查事实吗?决策模型能否零样本识破其产物?

papers.title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking

summary.en: Builds an inference engine for decision-model workloads instead of borrowing generation-oriented ones, which suffer severe prefix recomputation or distorted output probabilities: Flide decouples the logical tree structure of a decision request from its physical execution in a single flattened token stream; ForkAttention navigates request dependencies through GPU-resident indices across standard attention and recurrent Gated DeltaNet layers, guaranteeing in exact arithmetic that every query branch evaluates identically to an isolated forward pass, while branch topologies expressed as GPU metadata let expanding agent histories resume from earlier checkpoints; on public hybrid and decision models Flide answers queries up to 9.5 times faster than vLLM and SGLang while staying closest to a float32 reference in total variation distance.
summary.zh: 为决策模型负载专门打造推理引擎,而不再借用生成式引擎——后者有严重的前缀重算开销或输出概率失真:Flide 把决策请求的逻辑树结构与单条扁平 token 流中的物理执行解耦;ForkAttention 以常驻 GPU 的索引在标准注意力与循环 Gated DeltaNet 层上导航请求依赖,以精确算术保证每个查询分支与孤立前向完全一致;以 GPU 元数据表达分支拓扑,还可让不断增长的智能体历史从早前检查点恢复;在公开混合与决策模型上,Flide 比 vLLM 与 SGLang 最快快 9.5 倍,且总变差距离最贴近 float32 参照。

problem.en: Can a decision request's branch tree execute exactly, once, inside a single inference stream?
problem.zh: 决策请求的分支树能否在单条推理流中被精确地一次执行?

papers.title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers

summary.en: Distills a generative LLM's ranking knowledge into a decision model whose student reads scores from the first-token position: the teacher expresses preferences only through ranked lists of document IDs, so DecisionRank trains with item-space on-policy distillation - the student's document scores are sorted into a ranked sequence that the generative teacher takes as input, and its conditional feedback directly supervises those scores - combined with offline ranking supervision; the result is state of the art on general and reasoning-intensive retrieval (TREC DL, BEIR, BRIGHT), item-space OPD consistently beats alternative objectives across four benchmarks, a 1.7B student surpasses its 27B generative teacher on TREC DL19-23, and the 8B model beats its generative listwise counterpart while running 24.5x faster on TREC DL and 16.7x faster on BRIGHT.
summary.zh: 把生成式 LLM 的排序知识蒸馏进以首 token 位置读分数的决策模型:教师只能用文档 ID 序列的排名表表达偏好,于是 DecisionRank 采用物品空间在线策略蒸馏——把学生的文档分数排序成列表交给生成式教师,其条件反馈直接监督这些分数——再叠加离线排序监督;成果在通用与推理密集型检索(TREC DL、BEIR、BRIGHT)上均为最优,物品空间 OPD 在四个基准上稳定胜过其他训练目标;1.7B 学生在 TREC DL19-23 上超过 27B 生成式教师,8B 模型胜过其生成式列表对应物,且在 TREC DL 上快 24.5 倍、BRIGHT 上快 16.7 倍。

problem.en: Can a first-token decision model inherit a generative teacher's ranking skill without decoding lists?
problem.zh: 首 token 决策模型能否不解码列表就继承生成式教师的排序能力?

papers.title: Operon-S1: a fast decision controller for long-horizon biomedical agents

summary.en: Separates judging from doing for long-horizon biomedical agents: a decision harness poses the agent's recurring judgements (conventions, skills, errors, evidence, stopping) as closed questions at 13 decision points and acts only through fixed messages that never contain an answer, so any model can serve as the judge; across seven life-science benchmarks a local 322M decision model (LAYA) takes over the judgements with a 0.6 s median in-loop request on CPU at no request cost and no measurable score change on five of six benchmarks, while the general LLM asked the same questions accounts for 8.0-35.2% of task cost, a hosted JEV serves as a comparator under equal time budgets, and retraining on labels from task construction, verifiers or execution raises decision accuracy at every question, with a promotion gate for new versions.
summary.zh: 为长程生物医学智能体把「判断」从「执行」中剥离:决策挽具把智能体反复出现的判断(规范、技能、错误、证据、停止)在 13 个决策点写成封闭问题,且只通过绝不含答案的固定消息起作用,因此任何模型都能担任裁判;在七个生命科学基准上,本地 322M 决策模型(LAYA)接管判断后,CPU 上单次环内请求中位 0.6 秒、零请求成本,六个基准中五个分数无可测变化,而让通用大模型回答同样问题要占任务成本的 8.0%~35.2%;托管 JEV 作为等时预算下的对照;用任务构造、校验器或执行产生的标签重训可提升每个问题的决策准确率,新版本须经晋升闸门上线。

problem.en: Can a fast decision controller take over an agent's recurring judgements without hurting task outcomes?
problem.zh: 快速的决策控制器能否接管智能体反复出现的判断而不损害任务结果?
