papers.title: Beyond CLIP: Calibrated (Few-Shot) Defect Detection With System One Decision Models
affiliations: Farmer School of Business, Miami University
College of Arts and Sciences, University of Dayton

summary.en: Asks whether structured decision models can replace CLIP for industrial defect detection when only two reference images per class exist: with API-based TypeSafe Jev 1.13.0 and the open-weight Cloudflare Clef-Flash (run locally on SGLang) across five manufacturing case studies (metallic surfaces, 3D-printing extrusion profiles, stochastic textures, automotive assemblies, microstructures), both beat CLIP at k=2 (test accuracy 0.75-1.00 for Jev and 0.71-0.99 for Clef-Flash versus 0.67-0.84), an agentic loop that rewrites the guiding text descriptions significantly improves accuracy in 6 of 8 model-application pairs, and a calibration step lowers the Brier score in 13 of 15 configurations; ships replication code, the "decisions" package and a no-code web app.
summary.zh: 追问在每类仅有两张参考图时,结构化决策模型能否取代 CLIP 做工业缺陷检测:以 API 调用的 TypeSafe Jev 1.13.0 与本地 SGLang 运行的开源 Cloudflare Clef-Flash,在五个制造案例(金属表面、3D 打印挤出轮廓、随机纹理、汽车装配、微观组织)上,k=2 时两者均胜过 CLIP(测试准确率 Jev 0.75~1.00、Clef-Flash 0.71~0.99,CLIP 0.67~0.84);让智能体循环改写引导文本描述在 8 个模型—应用组合中的 6 个显著提升准确率,校准步骤在 15 个配置中的 13 个降低 Brier 分数;附复现代码、"decisions" 软件包与无代码网页应用。

problem.en: Can System One decision models detect manufacturing defects reliably from just two reference images per class?
problem.zh: 系统一决策模型能否仅凭每类两张参考图可靠检测制造缺陷?

papers.title: When Disclosure Is Compulsory: Evaluating Ride-Hailing Rebalancing Policies with Self-Interested LLM Driver Agents
affiliations: School of Civil Engineering, The University of Sydney

summary.en: Simulates what happens when the EU Platform Work Directive forces ride-hailing platforms to disclose their rebalancing rules and drivers let a model decide for them: every driver is an LLM agent maximizing its own net income, with hosted Jev 1.13.0 (option of highest probability) as the main agent across 500 Manhattan drivers and 52,461 requests and Claude Haiku 5.5 as the reasoning control, both answering the rule-comprehension quiz perfectly; once rules are disclosed, declined relocation offers fall from about four in five to one in four, the reactive policy loses 3.7% of its profit while the anticipatory policy's is unchanged (the two end 6.1% apart), and self-interested drivers turn the anticipatory policy into a win-win-win, lifting driver income, platform profit and service rate by 10-12% each; the small-model Jev runs cost USD 2.43 for 20,396 calls.
summary.zh: 模拟欧盟平台工作指令强制网约车平台公开调度规则、司机把决策交给模型后会发生什么:每位司机都是最大化自身净收入的 LLM 智能体,主智能体为托管 Jev 1.13.0(取最高概率选项),在曼哈顿 500 名司机、52,461 次请求上运行,并以 Claude Haiku 5.5 作为推理模型对照,二者均满分通过规则理解测验;规则公开后,司机拒绝调度的比例从约五分之四降到四分之一,被动策略利润损失 3.7% 而前瞻策略不变(两者相差 6.1%),自利司机使前瞻策略成为三赢——司机收入、平台利润与服务率各提升 10%~12%;小模型上的 Jev 运行 20,396 次调用仅花费 2.43 美元。

problem.en: How do ride-hailing rebalancing policies fare once rules are disclosed and self-interested drivers let Jev decide for them?
problem.zh: 规则公开、自利司机让 Jev 代为决策后,网约车调度策略表现如何?

papers.title: EDU-Jev Training System-One Decision Models for Education

summary.en: Trains EDU-Jev, single-pass System One decision models at 0.8B, 2B and 4B for educational assessment (rubric scores, marking criteria, the first wrong step in a solution): a pointer head scores a marker per option so predictions stay within the allowed choices, one supervised stage fits soft cross-entropy to rater label distributions, and weight averaging finishes the recipe; across twelve education benchmarks the 4B model reaches 67.6% average accuracy, 9.4 points above the strongest of five commercial decision APIs (hosted Jev 1.14, Microsoft Decision-1 and Cloudflare Clef among them, queried through a zero-retention routing service) and 18.7 above the best open 4B decision model, matches the strongest API on four cross-domain education sets while trailing it on general decisions and reasoning, and the 2B model handles about 150 decisions per second on one H100.
summary.zh: 训练面向教育评估(量规打分、评分点判定、找出解答中的首个错误步骤)的单次前向系统一决策模型 EDU-Jev(0.8B/2B/4B):指针头为每个选项的标记打分,使预测限定在允许选项内;单阶段监督训练以软交叉熵拟合评分者标签分布,再以权重平均收尾;在十二个教育基准上 4B 模型平均准确率 67.6%,比五个商业决策 API(含经零留存路由服务调用的托管 Jev 1.14、Microsoft Decision-1 与 Cloudflare Clef)中最强者高 9.4 个百分点、比最佳开源 4B 决策模型高 18.7 个点,在四个跨域教育集上与最强 API 持平但在通用决策与推理上落后;2B 模型在单张 H100 上每秒约处理 150 个决策。

papers.title: PathoJev: Efficient Pathology Decisions from Shared Visual Context
affiliations: College of Computer Science, Sichuan University
Department of Pathology and Institute of Clinical Pathology, West China Hospital, Sichuan University
Department of Computer Science, School of Computing, National University of Singapore
School of Intelligent Systems Engineering, Sun Yat-sen University

summary.en: Brings the System One paradigm to pathology: PathoJev encodes a whole slide once into a shared visual prefix, then scores independent question suffixes in batches with a typed head that returns answer probabilities directly, reusing the hybrid backbone's recurrent states so that per-question cost grows less with slide-context length; starting from the open JEV-9B and trained on whole-slide plus region-of-interest supervision, the 9B and 27B models reach mean accuracies of 77.2% and 78.1% on three whole-slide benchmarks (5.4 and 6.3 points above SlideChat), stay competitive on five ROI benchmarks, run 9.1x faster than SlideChat on WSI-Bench, and shared context speeds eight-question workloads 6.9x/5.9x over separate prefix encoding (11.2x/8.9x at 64 questions); hosted Jev is cited only as the paradigm's origin and is not evaluated.
summary.zh: 把系统一范式引入病理学:PathoJev 将整张切片一次性编码为共享视觉前缀,再以类型化头对独立的问题后缀批量打分、直接返回答案概率,并复用混合骨干的循环状态,使每多一个问题随切片上下文长度增长的计算更少;从开源 JEV-9B 出发、以整片与感兴趣区域双重监督训练的 9B 与 27B 模型在三个整片基准上平均准确率 77.2% 与 78.1%(高于 SlideChat 5.4 与 6.3 个百分点),在五个 ROI 基准上保持竞争力,WSI-Bench 上 9B 比 SlideChat 快 9.1 倍;共享上下文使八问工作负载比分别编码前缀快 6.9/5.9 倍,64 问时达 11.2/8.9 倍;托管 Jev 仅作为范式来源被引用,未被评测。

problem.en: How can one slide encoding answer many pathology questions with direct probabilities instead of generated text?
problem.zh: 如何让一次切片编码直接以概率回答多个病理问题,而非逐题生成文本?

papers.title: When the Top Answer Decides: Gender Bias in Decision Models

summary.en: Tests TypeSafe's closed Jev (1.14/1.13) and five open decision models (pplx-decider, clef-flash, granite-switch, Kev 4B, d1 3B) on gender-swapped yes/no decisions, BBQ, StereoSet and the Fulgu-Capraro studies: five of six give women significantly more favourable answers (+0.05 to +0.10 in log-odds), a gender swap changes 1-3.5% of top answers (Jev's partly through call-to-call variation), and the makers' recommended confidence gate removes many biased commitments but raises the stereotyped share of those it keeps in ambiguous BBQ gender questions.

papers.title: CausalGrade: Evidence-Guided Causal Graph Scoring with Jev

summary.en: Scores candidate causal graphs by giving Jev 1.13.0 evidence of association, conditional dependence and directionality from observational data plus CDFM edge probabilities, then measuring adjacency agreement with Jev's edge-level judgments. Across 300 synthetic datasets the score tracks structural error (Spearman -0.52 to -0.76 over four discovery algorithms), and on 500 graph-selection tasks it reaches a 54.4% best-candidate hit rate versus 48.4% for self-compatibility. Candidates come from thresholding the same CDFM output, so sparsification and discrimination gains are partly confounded; no author code was located.
summary.zh: 将关联、条件依赖与方向性证据连同 CDFM 边概率交给 Jev 1.13.0，再用邻接结构与 Jev 边级判断的一致度为候选因果图打分。300 个合成数据集上得分与结构误差呈较强负相关（四种发现算法 Spearman -0.52 至 -0.76）；500 个图选择任务最佳候选命中 54.4%，高于自兼容基线 48.4%。候选图由同一 CDFM 输出阈值化得到，稀疏化与判别增益部分混淆；未找到作者代码。

problem.en: How can candidate causal graphs be scored when the true causal structure is unknown?
problem.zh: 真因果结构未知时，如何为候选因果图的结构质量打分？

papers.title: Lev-3B: A Data Recipe for Compact Probabilistic Log Decision Models

summary.en: Trains Lev-3B, an open 3B-parameter decision model built on Granite-4.1-3B-Base with a shared pointer readout, with a two-stage curriculum - bounded natural-language decisions before any log data, then the target tasks mixed with general log data across 35 auxiliary tasks: the recipe transfers substantially better than training on log data alone, general log data improves excluded sources, and at a fraction of serving cost Lev-3B outperforms prompted frontier models; hosted Jev (version-pinned 1.13.0) is evaluated zero-shot and 5-shot as a baseline throughout.

papers.title: FlipJev: Fast Black-Box Red Teaming Finds Universal Adversarial Suffixes for Typed Decision Models

summary.en: Red-teams hosted Jev with a fast black-box query-based attack that exploits the model's own speed and calls no attacker language model: across 12 datasets no common prompt-injection strategy changes a correct answer in 10,240 paired tests, but short suffixes found within minutes flip confident answers and transfer widely - one suffix per dataset flips 43% of unseen documents, and a suffix generated from one task flips 90-100% of samples in other tasks.

papers.title: PsyJev: Psychological Analysis via System-1 Judgment
affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Cognitive Intelligence, University of Science and Technology of China
School of Information Science and Technology, University of Science and Technology of China

summary.en: Builds a shared question-conditioned decision interface for psychological content analysis: PsyJudgeBench organizes 13 annotated datasets and 82 questions across six psychological areas (preserving source-specific criteria and masks for unobserved labels), and PsyJev is a System-1 model that directly produces distributions over the question-defined answers - joint supervised training establishes the shared judgment function, then Judgment-Anchored RLCD adapts logit-space perturbations with a Brier-based question-group reward; across 2B, 4B and 9B scales PsyJev outperforms same-backbone answer-SFT baselines, and the general-purpose Jev API achieves 52.91 average F1 zero-shot as the reference.
summary.zh: 为心理内容分析构建共享的按问题条件化的决策接口:PsyJudgeBench 整理 13 个标注数据集、覆盖六个心理领域的 82 个问题(保留各数据集专属标准并遮蔽未观测标签);PsyJev 是直接对请求中定义的答案输出分布的系统一模型——先以联合监督训练建立共享判断函数,再以锚定判断的 RLCD(JA-RLCD)借助基于 Brier 的问题组奖励在 logit 空间微调;在 2B/4B/9B 三个规模上 PsyJev 均胜过同骨干的答案-SFT 基线,通用 Jev API 以零样本平均 F1 52.91 作为参照。

papers.title: Confidence Is Not a Promise: A Reference Audit of Typed Decision Models
affiliations: Department of Mathematics, Federal Institute of Brasília, Brasília, Brazil

summary.en: Audits what a decision model's probability actually licenses, comparing open-weight Laya (five checkpoints) with Jev 1.13 through its API: across 190 exchangeable evaluations a threshold chosen by point estimate breaks its accuracy promise in 147 while Learn-then-Test keeps it in all, and a Beta lower-bound rule decides more items on average in 128 without that guarantee; calibrated in English, Jev keeps a 95% promise in only 8 of 51 locales; ordinary typing noise breaks a promise calibrated on clean text; a fine-tuned Laya needs 250-8,000 labels to be non-inferior to Jev in four further domains and never gets there on LIAR2; confidence separates right from wrong answers (AUROC 0.80-0.96) but does not select faithful explanations.
summary.zh: 审计决策模型概率究竟担保了什么:在 190 次可交换评测中对比开源 Laya(五个检查点)与经 API 调用的 Jev 1.13——按点估计选阈值会在 147 次中违背精度承诺,Learn-then-Test 全部守住;Beta 下界规则在 128 次中平均裁定更多条目且无需该保证;英语校准的 Jev 仅在 51 个语言区域中的 8 个保住 95% 承诺;普通打字噪声即可打破干净文本上校准的承诺;微调 Laya 在另外四个领域需 250~8000 条标注才能不劣于 Jev,LIAR2 上始终做不到;置信度能区分对错答案(AUROC 0.80~0.96)却挑不出忠实的解释。

problem.en: What does a decision model's probability actually license, and when does a threshold keep its accuracy promise?
problem.zh: 决策模型输出的概率到底担保了什么?阈值何时能兑现精度承诺?

summary.en: Drops the first-stage retriever: DecisionRAG has a pretrained decision model jointly evaluate candidate branches in a single forward pass and navigate the corpus's inherent structure from broad topics down to passages, like a person browsing a library. papers.title: Understanding Jev-Style System One Models: Does Structure Reduce Selection Bias?

summary.en: Shuffles option order while fixing question content to ask whether Jev-style decision structure reduces selection bias: across two hosted Jev versions (1.13 and 1.14), twelve Jev reproductions, and six generative LLMs on 1,700 questions, Jev's accuracy varies by less than two points yet its cumulative failure set expands 27.3-28.5% over eight presentations, with first failures continuing into the final one; reordering loses substantially more initial successes than fixed-order repetition (a gap that also appears in highly repeatable reproductions), Jev shows no general advantage over the LLM baselines in preserving correct choices, and voting offers limited protection - even unanimous answers are frequently wrong.
summary.zh: 固定题目内容、只打乱选项顺序,检验 Jev 式决策结构能否减少选择偏差:在两版托管 Jev(1.13 与 1.14)、十二个 Jev 复现模型与六个生成式大模型、1700 道题上,Jev 的准确率波动不足两个百分点,但八次呈现间累计失败集合扩张 27.3%~28.5%,首次失败一直延续到最后一次;重排比固定顺序重复损失明显更多初始正确答案(高复现性的复现模型同样如此),Jev 在保住正确选择上并不普遍优于大模型基线,投票保护也有限——全票一致的答案仍常出错。

problem.en: Does Jev-style System One structure reduce selection bias across equivalent presentations?
problem.zh: Jev 式系统一结构能否减少等价呈现下的选择偏差?

papers.title: Can JEV Support Clinical Trial Criteria Assessment?
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

summary.en: Retrospectively compares JEV (fixed jev-1.14.0 via TypeSafe's text Choice API) with schema-constrained Qwen Flash on clinical-trial prescreening across 2,048 patient-condition pairs from TrialGPT and MIMIC-III/IV-derived question sets, all under strict zero-data-retention policies: batch-mode macro-F1 is similar on TrialGAT (0.652 vs 0.660) and MIMIC-IV (0.807 vs 0.814), while JEV clearly leads on MIMIC-III (0.768 vs 0.534), largely through recall for conditions with insufficient information (56.3% vs 9.9%); JEV's median latency is 1.18-1.40 s (vs 2.80-8.90 s) with 53-74% lower estimated cost per condition, though its reading errors mean outputs must still be verified against records before eligibility decisions.
summary.zh: 在严格的零数据留存政策下,以固定版本 jev-1.14.0(经 TypeSafe text Choice API)的 JEV 对比受 schema 约束的 Qwen Flash,回溯评估来自 TrialGPT 与 MIMIC-III/IV 衍生问答的 2048 组患者—条件对:批处理宏观 F1 在 TrialGAT(0.652 对 0.660)与 MIMIC-IV(0.807 对 0.814)上相当,但 MIMIC-III 上 JEV 明显领先(0.768 对 0.534),主要来自对信息不足条件更高的召回(56.3% 对 9.9%);JEV 中位延迟 1.18~1.40 秒(对比 2.80~8.90 秒),每条件成本低 53%~74%;其解读错误也提醒在用于入组决策前仍须对照病历核验输出。

papers.title: Improving JEV Entailment Reranking with Span Readouts and Selective Adaptation

summary.en: Asks whether readout and adaptation choices proven for direct selection transfer to cross-request NLI reranking in JEV-style decision models: on NeoHorse-1-4B (a post-trained, text-only repackaging of Qwen3.5-4B with attention and gated DeltaNet layers), mean-span pooling replaces the option-ending pointer with the average of contextualized states inside each NLI option without adding head parameters, and selective adaptation keeps low-rank updates in attention and gated DeltaNet projections while removing feed-forward adapters - on MC11 (eleven reranking configurations from seven sources) selective adaptation improves accuracy from 50.28% to 52.49% and adding mean-span pooling reaches 53.39%, both positive in all four fold-seed settings at over half the trainable parameters cut.
summary.zh: 追问在直接选择上有效的读出与适配方案能否迁移到跨请求的 NLI 重排:在 NeoHorse-1-4B(Qwen3.5-4B 后训练的纯文本 JEV 式复现,含注意力与门控 DeltaNet 层)上,均值跨度池化用选项内上下文状态的平均替代选项末指针且不增头部参数,选择性适配保留注意力与门控 DeltaNet 投影的低秩更新、移除前馈适配器——在 MC11(七个来源、十一种重排配置)上,选择性适配把准确率从 50.28% 提到 52.49%,加均值跨度池化达 53.39%,四个折-种子组合全为正,可训练参数削减过半。

problem.zh: 哪些读出与适配方案能让 JEV 式模型成为更好的蕴含重排器?

papers.title: The Value of System 1 Models in Medicine
affiliations: National Center for Tumor Diseases West, Essen

summary.en: Evaluates four System 1 models zero-shot - hosted Jev 1.14 and GPT-6 Luna Decisions plus open-weight Clef (27B) and Clef-flash (9.5B), all through the OpenRouter decision interface - on 86 public tasks from 14 clinical domains in 20 languages spanning examination questions and medical imaging (2.4 million answers over 179,111 cases): the best model per task reaches mean AUROC 0.94 for medical knowledge, 0.93 for text understanding, 0.83 for clinical judgement from text, 0.89 for image perception, 0.84 for 2D findings and 0.69 for volumetric findings, imaging 0.09 below text; Jev 1.14 answered every question (GPT-6 Luna Decisions refused 1.3%) and was the best model on 45 of 78 primary tasks, the best model matched or beat the best published result on 13 of 26 text and 8 of 35 imaging tasks yet triage nurses still won (accuracy 0.85 vs 0.56), local open-weight decisions took 0.34-0.44 s and 24-81 J, accuracy fell up to 39 points from English to Yoruba (20.1 for Jev), and same-family generative models were 11-76x slower for 3-5 points more balanced accuracy.

papers.title: VX-One: Typed, Calibrated Decision Heads for Real-Time Perimeter Triage

summary.en: Implements the commercial System One primitive triad (TypeSafe Jev; Microsoft Decision-1) as a small multi-head network (100K-10M parameters) for real-time network-perimeter triage: a calibrated binary gate, a closed-set choice with an explicit unknown option where the benchmark supports it, and an ordinal score, temperature-calibrated per head at 0.7-1.7 ms single-event CPU p50. On UNSW-NB15, CIC-IDS2017 and EMBER2024 against calibrated XGBoost, Random Forest, MLP and Kitsune baselines the results are deliberately double-sided: the gate ties the best baseline on UNSW, wins temporal CIC detection (0.734 vs 0.639) but loses multi-class attribution; leave-one-family-out transfer is mixed, and calibration collapses under temporal drift (ECE 0.04 to 0.40) for every method while ranking partly survives. A five-day Suricata-to-VX-One cascade is measured end to end.
summary.zh: 把商业 System One 原语三元组(TypeSafe Jev;Microsoft Decision-1)实现为小型多头网络(100K-10M 参数)用于实时网络边界分诊:校准二分类门、带显式 unknown 选项的闭集选择(基准支持处)与序数分,逐头温度校准,CPU 单事件 p50 0.7-1.7 毫秒。在 UNSW-NB15、CIC-IDS2017、EMBER2024 上对照校准 XGBoost、RF、MLP、Kitsune,结果刻意两面呈现:UNSW 门控持平最强基线,时序 CIC 检测胜出(0.734 对 0.639)但多类归因落败;留一族迁移好坏参半,时间漂移下所有方法校准崩溃(ECE 0.04 升至 0.40)而排序部分保留;并端到端测量五天 Suricata 到 VX-One 级联。

papers.title: Beveridge: Open Weight System One Decision Models with Calibrated Probabilities
affiliations: BDST: Big Data Science & Technology Ltd, United Kingdom

summary.en: A family of open-weight (Apache 2.0) System One decision models taking a document plus up to 15 typed questions (yes/no, choice among described options, ordered level) and returning a calibrated probability per option in one forward pass. Beveridge-Large-C (398M: ModernBERT-large plus a 3.5M decision network with typed number/date features, rule-engine facts, evidence attention and learned halting) reaches 93.0% on an operations-document benchmark against 91.1% for the best of five 31B-675B general LLMs and 87.9% for hosted Jev, evaluated through its API on identical requests; with ECE 0.029 it hands over 76% of decisions automatically at 95% accuracy, at 4.9 ms per decision on one H200. Pro variants LoRA-adapt Gemma 4 26B-A4B, raising next-step accuracy on unseen web sites from 49.4% to 98.2%.

papers.title: TUPLE-Bench: Evaluating and Mitigating Privacy-Utility Trade-offs in Typed Decision Models

summary.en: Shows that typed decision models leak more than the selected category: besides the chosen label they expose per-candidate probabilities and sometimes a separate confidence score, which downstream decisions use but which can reveal information beyond a recipient's authorization; TUPLE-Bench builds paired synthetic cases where a recipient may learn a coarse operational category but not its fine-grained cause, and across nine models instructions to withhold the cause fail - 91.88-99.93% of responses reveal it through direct selection or residual score patterns - even when the causes are excluded from the candidate list; the benchmark ships with evaluation APIs and paired privacy-utility audits.
summary.zh: 揭示类型化决策模型的泄露不止于所选类别:除选中标签外还暴露每个候选的概率、有时另有独立置信度,这些字段服务于下游决策,却可能泄露超出接收方授权的信息;TUPLE-Bench 构造成对合成案例,允许接收方得知粗粒度业务类别、不允许得知细粒度成因;九个模型上「隐瞒成因」的指令全部失效——91.88%~99.93% 的响应通过直接选择或残差分数模式暴露成因,即便把成因从候选列表中剔除也无效;基准附评估 API 与隐私—效用成对审计。

papers.title: Literal Lock-In: How Test Language Shifts Literal Attraction in Typed Decision Models on Bengali Idioms
affiliations: Systems and Software Lab (SSL), Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Islamic University of Technology

summary.en: Audits three decision models - an encoder scorer, a decoder scorer and a closed API (Jev-1.13) - entirely through input interventions, using expert-annotated Bengali idioms that carry a gold figurative and a gold literal gloss: dropping the idiom's own literal gloss into the option list draws every arm toward it, accounting for 65% to 96% of each arm's remaining Bengali errors, while a model-by-language matrix over one shared item set shows how strongly the effect depends on the test language; because decision models generate nothing, rationales and chain-of-thought do not apply, so literal-attraction probes are the usable lens.
summary.zh: 完全通过输入干预审计三个决策模型——编码器打分器、解码器打分器与闭源 API(Jev-1.13)——所用材料是带有金标准比喻义与字面义释义的专家标注孟加拉语习语:把习语自带的字面释义混入选项列表,会把每个模型都拉向字面义,占各模型剩余孟加拉语错误的 65%~96%;跨语言矩阵(同一组条目)显示该效应高度依赖测试语言;由于决策模型不生成任何文本,无法用理由或思维链审视,字面吸引因此成为可用的透镜。

papers.title: PremiseCheck: Efficient Fact-Checking of Human and AI Peer Reviews

summary.en: Fact-checks peer-review comments (human or AI written) that misstate what a paper says: the ReviewFact benchmark labels such factual errors under three parts; on whole comments Jev performs at chance on the NLP reviews and below an LLM elsewhere, but on single premises that annotators wrote out from the comments Jev is as accurate as GPT-5.5, so PremiseCheck splits the work - an LLM decomposes each comment into self-contained premises without reading the paper, and the decision model checks each premise against the paper - reaching the strongest configuration's F1 on three fields at about half its cost, and on NLP reviews at a quarter of the cost and under half the latency (a Jev-to-GPT-5.5 cascade covers the rest).
summary.zh: 核查(人或 AI 撰写的)同行评审意见中对论文内容的失实陈述:ReviewFact 基准为这类事实错误标注并分三部分;在整条意见上 Jev 于 NLP 评审接近随机、其余部分也逊于 LLM,但在标注者从意见中拆出的单条前提上,Jev 与 GPT-5.5 同样准确——于是 PremiseCheck 分工:让 LLM 不读论文、只把意见拆成自含前提,再由决策模型把每条前提对着论文核查;在三个领域的 F1 追平最强配置、成本约其一半,NLP 评审上成本仅四分之一、延迟不到一半(其余走 Jev→GPT-5.5 级联)。

problem.en: Can peer-review factual errors be caught cheaply by splitting premise generation (LLM) from premise checking (decision model)?
problem.zh: 把「生成前提」(LLM)与「核查前提」(决策模型)分工,能否廉价地发现评审意见中的事实错误?

papers.title: Audio System One Model: Typed Probabilistic Perception of Emotion in Speech
affiliations: Speech Technology and Machine Learning Group (THAU), Universidad Politécnica de Madrid

summary.en: Gives speech its own System One model: classifiers answer fast but over one fixed label set, while audio language models take any question in text yet answer by generation, one pass per question, with poorly calibrated probabilities; ASOM answers choice, score and yes/no questions written at request time in a single pass without generation, each with a probability distribution - frozen speech and text encoders feed a 6.2M-parameter reader with no per-class parameters, trained on listener vote distributions; on MSP-Podcast it matches a classifier trained on the same features and data, leads the best of six zero-shot ALMs by 0.072 and a fine-tuned ALM by 0.026, answers 20 questions in 13.1 ms (17-41x faster than ALMs), handles reworded questions, reduced and new label sets, scales and gender, and on 21 unseen corpora in 13 languages leads the best zero-shot ALM by 0.138 where the words carry no emotion.
summary.zh: 为语音打造专属的系统一模型:分类器答得快却锁死一个标签集,音频语言模型什么问题都能接、却要靠生成逐题作答且概率校准差;ASOM 对请求时写下的选择、评分与是非题一次前向作答、不生成文本,每题带概率分布——冻结的语音与文本编码器喂给一个 6.2M 参数、无逐类参数的读取器,以听者投票分布训练;在 MSP-Podcast 上追平同特征同数据的分类器,领先六个零样本音频语言模型中最佳者 0.072、领先同数据微调的音频语言模型 0.026,20 个问题只需 13.1 毫秒(比音频语言模型快 17~41 倍);还能应付改写问题、缩减或全新标签集、音阶与性别,并在 13 种语言的 21 个未见语料上,于词面不含情绪处领先最佳零样本音频语言模型 0.138。

papers.title: LEV: Thinking Fast and Deep with Looped Decision Models

summary.en: Lets a decision model think deeper without generating tokens: LEV builds on a language model pretrained as a loop, re-reads the options after every loop step and trains all steps jointly, so one checkpoint answers at any depth; on three looped backbones accuracy rises with depth on the same weights, mostly on hard questions - a 2.6B LEV climbs from 63.2% at depth one to 76.2% at depth four on JevBench - while on-demand depth chosen per question by a small stopper (threshold fitted on unlabelled requests) saves 15-24% of computation for under one accuracy point, level with or slightly above a fixed mix of depths; on a locked test set the 1.4B and 3B models beat dense models and cascades of the same sub-50 ms latency by 5.4-8.8 points, with the released Kev-0.8B/4B and the closed Jev 1.13.0 (measured through the production API) reported as references.
summary.zh: 让决策模型不生成 token 也能想得更深:LEV 建立在以循环方式预训练的语言模型之上,每个循环步后重读选项并联合训练所有步,一个检查点即可在任意深度作答;在三个循环骨干上,同一权重的准确率随深度上升、提升主要来自难题——2.6B 的 LEV 在 JevBench 上从深度一的 63.2% 升至深度四的 76.2%;由小型停止器按题决定深度(阈值在无标注请求上拟合)可节省 15%~24% 计算、准确率损失不到一个点,与固定深度混合持平或略优;在锁定测试集上,1.4B 与 3B 模型比同样低于 50 毫秒延迟的稠密模型与级联高 5.4~8.8 个点;已发布的 Kev-0.8B/4B 与闭源 Jev 1.13.0(经生产 API 测得)作为参考一并报告。

problem.en: Can a decision model spend more computation on hard questions by looping its layers instead of generating text?
problem.zh: 决策模型能否通过循环层而非生成文本,把更多计算花在难题上?

papers.title: A System One Approach to General Protein Evolution

summary.en: Frames protein engineering as a sequence of typed decisions and trains a general mutation policy in the System One style that Jev exemplifies: given a parent sequence and assay context, Pev (about 1.6M parameters on a frozen ESM-2 backbone, trained on measured outcomes across families rather than fitted to the target family) encodes the parent once and returns calibrated probabilities for choosing an edit or stopping, plus each edit's probability of improving the assay outcome; one policy covers peptides, small folded domains and antibodies across binding and stability objectives, finds 3.3x as many beneficial mutations as random selection and 1.8x as many as zero-shot ESM-2 in ten-well screens on held-out families, beats a ridge surrogate refitted on target measurements on the held-out GB1 landscape, and shared encoding gives over 800x the throughput of per-mutant encoding at 1,000 candidates per request.
summary.zh: 把蛋白质工程改写成一系列类型化决策,并按 Jev 所示范的 System One 范式训练通用突变策略:给定亲本序列与实验场景,Pev(冻结 ESM-2 骨干上约 160 万参数,用跨家族实测结果训练而不针对目标家族拟合)只编码亲本一次,即返回「选哪个编辑或停止」的校准概率,以及每个编辑改善实验结果的概率;单一策略覆盖多肽、小结构域与抗体,横跨结合与稳定性目标;在留出家族的十孔筛选中,有益突变产出是随机选择的 3.3 倍、零样本 ESM-2 的 1.8 倍,在留出的 GB1 地形上胜过用目标测量重拟合的岭回归代理;共享编码在每请求 1,000 候选时吞吐量超逐突变编码 800 倍以上。

papers.title: CT0: Cybersecurity Transformer

summary.en: Asks how small a cybersecurity-specialist transformer can be and still serve a practitioner: CT0-Micro is a ~4B model built on an open base whose backbone is specialised by two-phase on-policy distillation on a Cybersecurity AI dataset, and CT0 serves two modes from one set of weights - System 1 answers typed security decisions (is this file suspicious, is this request an attack, did the model just refuse) in a single forward pass without generating a token, System 2 is the usual tool-using agent, and a confidence gate spends generation only where the fast path is unsure (a pointer head adapted from the Jev/System One lineage); specialisation lifts the agentic path to 21.1% on cybench-subtask against 7.6% for its base, the fast path screens eighty files per second for indicators of compromise, catches its own refusals at 96.5% in 47 ms where the self-judging route reaches 76.5% in 254 ms and misses half, and flags jailbreaks at AUROC 0.966 in 8 ms.

papers.title: Large Decision Models: Repurposing Large Language Models as Single-Pass Decision Makers

summary.en: Repurposes LLMs as single-pass decision makers (Large Decision Models): instead of autoregressive decoding, an LLM maps a prompt and a run-time label set to a distribution over the labels in one forward pass - an operation the authors call readout - which existing systems such as Jev, Nimble, OpenJev and Laya already offer; decision tuning adapts the model's rollout habit to this readout interface, and the tuned models are compared against released decision models on Nimble's 13-subset benchmark and the typed-decisions test set reported for Jev and Laya; readout recovers a median 92% of reasoning's accuracy advantage while generating 27-58% of its tokens.
summary.zh: 把 LLM 改造为单次前向的决策者(Large Decision Models):不再自回归解码,而是把提示与运行时给定的标签集一次前向映射为标签分布——作者称之为 readout,Jev、Nimble、OpenJev、Laya 等现有系统已提供该接口;决策微调(decision tuning)把模型固有的 rollout 习惯适配到 readout 接口,并在 Nimble 13 子集基准与 Jev、Laya 公布的 typed-decisions 测试集上与已发布决策模型对比;readout 以 27%~58% 的 token 生成量挽回推理准确率优势的中位数 92%。

papers.title: Scoring Explanations Without Reading Them: Structural Shortcuts in Automated-Interpretability Evaluation Data

summary.en: Finds that automated-interpretability evaluation can be scored without reading the explanation: on Neuronpedia's stored fuzzing runs for 500 random GPT-2 small features, 91.3% of activating examples are cropped with the peak on the centre token, and a rule that says yes exactly when the centre token is marked reaches balanced accuracy 0.979 against 0.838 for the stored LLM scorers; the paper gives closed forms for what such structural-cue rules can score, separates sequence cues by decomposition, and re-tests whether explanations change conclusions using one scorer, Jev, a commercial typed decision model - which reaches pooled correlation 0.331 with the real explanation on natural windows against 0.013 with a shuffled one, above every position prior.
summary.zh: 发现自动可解释性评测不看解释也能拿高分:在 Neuronpedia 存储的 500 个随机 GPT-2 small 特征模糊测试中,91.3% 的激活样本裁剪后峰值恰在中心 token,一条「中心 token 被标记就说是」的规则平衡准确率达 0.979,而存库的 LLM 评分器只有 0.838;论文给出此类结构线索规则可得分数的闭式解,用分解方法剥离序列线索,并以一个商用类型化决策模型 Jev 重测解释是否改变结论——自然窗口上 Jev 拿到真解释时汇聚相关 0.331、拿打乱解释时 0.013,高于一切位置先验。

problem.en: Are automated-interpretability scores evidence about the explanation, or about structural cues in the evaluation data?
problem.zh: 自动可解释性的分数究竟是对解释的证据,还是对评测数据结构线索的证据?

papers.title: Probable but Not Valid: A Psychometric Audit of Decision Models as Synthetic Survey Respondents

summary.en: Runs a psychometric audit of decision models used as synthetic survey respondents: because decision models return a probability for each point of a rating scale instead of text, silicon samples built on them promise cheap survey simulation, but the audit tests whether the resulting responses are merely probable or actually valid - comparing latent-trait recovery, inter-item consistency and subgroup structure against human reference samples across the evaluated systems (Jev 1.13 among them, called through OpenRouter) - and reports where the models' score distributions track real respondent behaviour and where they collapse to central, over-confident answers that no validity check on probabilities alone can rescue.
summary.zh: 对被用作合成问卷受访者的决策模型做心理测量学审计:决策模型对量表每个刻度点返回概率而非文本,以此构建的「硅样本」承诺廉价的问卷模拟;该审计检验其作答是「看起来像样」还是真正有效——在潜变量恢复、条目间一致性与子群体结构上与人类参照样本对比(受测系统包括经 OpenRouter 调用的 Jev 1.13)——并报告模型分数分布何时贴近真实受访者行为、何时坍缩为居中且过度自信的答案,而仅凭概率的效度检查无法挽救这一点。

papers.title: JevCascade: Readout Stability and Inference-Time Compute Allocation for Prefill-Only Decision Models
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

summary.en: Makes inference-time compute allocation decidable for prefill-only decision models, which score every menu candidate in one forward pass and never decode: when an intervention changes only the menu (input text fixed), the post-intervention accuracy is already determined by the cached first-pass distribution - a restriction predictor simply restricts the pass-1 probabilities to the new menu, renormalizes and reads the argmax, with no labels and no second pass, predicting menu-only interventions to within 4.2 points across six model families and sixteen datasets (exactly for one family), while a probability-level variant errs by 21.0 points and same-scale generative models by 1.6-15.8; exploiting this, uniform extra passes buy calibration but almost no accuracy, and at matched cost a confidence cascade beats every scheme that re-asks the same model - a 0.8B model on a curated five-candidate menu reaches 95.4% on CLINC150 against 80.0% for a 4B model on the full 150-label menu.
summary.zh: 让仅预填充的决策模型的推理时算力分配变得可决策:这类模型一次前向为菜单全部候选打分、从不解码;当干预只改菜单(输入文本不变)时,干预后的准确率已由缓存的首遍分布决定——限制预测器只需把首遍概率限制到新菜单、重归一化并取 argmax,零标签、零二次前向,在六个模型族、十六个数据集上把仅菜单干预预测到 4.2 个点以内(其中一族完全精确),而概率层面的同类估计误差 21.0 个点,同规模生成式模型差 1.6~15.8 个点;据此,均匀加算遍数只买到校准、几乎买不到准确率,等成本下置信级联胜过一切重问同一模型的方案——0.8B 模型在精选五候选菜单上于 CLINC150 达 95.4%,而 4B 模型在全量 150 标签菜单上只有 80.0%。

papers.title: CLM-as-a-Judge: Evaluating an Open Contrastive Decision Model on Public Judge Benchmarks

summary.en: Evaluates an open contrastive decision model as a judge and finds it near chance on the hard public benchmarks: Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B scores 0.351-0.593 (best-of-four and pairwise, against chances of 0.250 and 0.500), is statistically indistinguishable from coin flipping on RM-Bench and JudgeBench, and answers every HaluEval item with one constant label; same-parameter reward models and generative judges score far higher everywhere. Two properties do work: a single pooled temperature fit repairs overconfident raw scores (+0.401 at worst) to ECE at most 0.062, and the decision order-flip rate is 0.0002 against 0.2188 for a generative judge with a near-zero length-preference shift; but the confidence-gated cascade escalates 0.923-1.000 of items to the strong judge at a pre-registered 0.97 retention bar - calibrated confidence about a near-chance judge has almost nothing to keep - under a preregistration frozen before any test item was seen.
summary.zh: 评测一个开源对比式决策模型担任裁判,发现在高难公开基准上接近随机:Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B 在四选一与成对比较中得 0.351~0.593(机会水平分别为 0.250 与 0.500),在 RM-Bench 与 JudgeBench 上与抛硬币无统计差异,HaluEval 每题都答同一个标签;同参数量的奖励模型与生成式裁判全面大幅更高。有两个性质确实成立:一次合并温度拟合把最差高估 +0.401 的原始分数修复到 ECE 至多 0.062,且决策翻转率 0.0002(生成式裁判 0.2188)、长度偏好偏移近乎为零;但在预注册的 0.97 保留线下,置信闸门级联把 0.923~1.000 的条目升级给强裁判——对一个近乎随机的裁判,校准好的置信几乎无可保留;评测在见到任何测试条目前已冻结预注册。

papers.title: Learning to Decide, Not to Reason: Parameter-Efficient Decision Operators via Low-Rank Activation Steering
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

summary.en: Injects skills into a frozen language model two orders of magnitude cheaper than reinforcement-learning operators: DecSteer is a System-1 decision operator trained by behaviour cloning whose default form uses 330K parameters to match a 1.33M RL-trained operator while collapsing 3,685-token deliberation into a 6-token decision with no accuracy loss, and whose rank-4 variant needs only 23K parameters (1/58 of the strongest published skill operator) for SearchQA and nearly for LiveMath; the recipe transfers across five tasks and three backbones with out-of-distribution gains persisting on LiveMath problems released months after training, and the trainability edge is traced to initialization - prior operators zero the gradient of both large factor matrices at step one - while a logit-lens probe shows the operator amplifies the answer along the model's existing late-layer pathway rather than writing it earlier.

papers.title: Permutation-Robust Decision Modeling with Candidate-Independent Block-Causal Attention

summary.en: Attacks a hidden failure mode of decision models that score a variable-sized candidate set in one sequence: standard causal cross-encoding is expressive but lets a candidate's score depend on serialization order rather than the decision problem itself - increasingly relevant where System 1 components inside generative systems see candidates proposed or ordered differently across runs; candidate-independent block-causal attention preserves causal computation within the shared context and each candidate while blocking cross-candidate information flow and resetting candidate positions, consistently reducing permutation sensitivity at competitive decision quality across Gemma 3 1B, Qwen3 1.7B and Qwen3 4B backbones, with ablations showing candidate isolation as the primary source of the effect and position resetting completing the symmetry; code and the Qwen3-4B artifact are released.
summary.zh: 针对在单序列中为可变候选集打分的决策模型的隐患:标准因果交叉编码表达力强,却会让候选分数取决于序列化顺序而非决策问题本身——当生成系统内的系统一组件在不同运行中看到不同提出或排序的候选时,问题日益突出;候选独立块因果注意力在共享上下文与每个候选内部保留因果计算,同时阻断跨候选信息流并重置候选位置,在 Gemma 3 1B、Qwen3 1.7B 与 4B 骨干上一致降低排列敏感且决策质量具竞争力;消融显示候选隔离是主因、位置重置补全对称性;代码与 Qwen3-4B 产物已发布。

papers.title: Can a Cacheable Decision Model Follow Rules?

summary.en: Asks whether a decision model that follows rules can also be cacheable: Certo, a small non-generative model (Qwen3-4B) that scores candidate actions from text and returns a probability, is most accurate as a joint scorer reading state, rules and each candidate together - but that makes cost grow with the menu; encoding each candidate once and reusing it across states is about 5x cheaper at 77 candidates yet separates state from candidate, and the tested conversion to cacheable scoring loses rule-sensitivity (recall@1 1.00 falls to 0.24) with a failed shortlist+rerank rescue; targeted counterfactual supervision restores strong performance on held-out synthetic rule tasks (paraphrase, counterfactual, composition; reproducible across seeds), on real rules the benefit is not established - after fixing a truncation confound the joint scorer wins the short tier 0.861 vs 0.500 - and a matched cross-domain prose mixture even hurts (-9.3 and -16.2 points).
summary.zh: 追问能遵循规则的决策模型能否同时可缓存:Certo 是一个小型非生成模型(Qwen3-4B),从文本为候选动作打分并返回概率;它作为联合打分器(状态、规则与每个候选一起读)最准,但成本随菜单增长;把每个候选只编码一次、跨状态复用在 77 个候选时便宜约 5 倍,却把状态与候选割裂——实测转为可缓存打分后规则敏感性丢失(recall@1 从 1.00 跌到 0.24),短清单+重排的补救也失败;针对性的反事实监督能在留出的合成规则任务(复述、反事实、组合)上恢复强表现且跨种子可复现,但在真实规则上收益未确立——修正截断混杂后联合打分器在短档以 0.861 对 0.500 取胜——而匹配的跨领域真实语料混合甚至有害(-9.3 与 -16.2 个点)。

problem.en: Can a cacheable decision model still read the rules, or does caching break rule-sensitivity?
problem.zh: 可缓存的决策模型还能读懂规则吗?缓存会不会破坏规则敏感性?

papers.title: SeLMRoute: Probabilistic Semantic Evidence for Large Language Model Routing

summary.en: Routes each query to the most suitable LLM using probabilistic semantic evidence instead of latent embeddings: SeLMRoute has a typed decision model answer a small set of semantic questions about what the query needs (JEV exposing typed Noul, Choice and Score decisions, with open-weight Laya as the swap-in backend), then a separate performance regressor learned on grouped out-of-fold predictions maps that evidence to candidate-model scores; under a five-fold grouped protocol JEV-SeLMRoute reaches 72.64% average accuracy against 70.53% for Laya-SeLMRoute and 69.23% for the best single fixed model, while JEV-Direct routing without the semantic representation manages 68.78% - the JEV-based semantic state beats the Laya-based one by a statistically significant 2.1 points.
summary.zh: 用概率化语义证据而非潜变量嵌入为每个查询挑选最合适的 LLM:SeLMRoute 先让类型化决策模型回答一小组关于查询需求的语义问题(JEV 提供类型化的 Noul/Choice/Score 决策,开源 Laya 可整体替换为后端),再由基于分组折外预测训练的性能回归器把证据映射为候选模型分数;五折分组协议下,JEV-SeLMRoute 平均准确率 72.64%,高于 Laya-SeLMRoute 的 70.53% 与最佳单一固定模型的 69.23%,不经语义表征的 JEV-Direct 只有 68.78%——基于 JEV 的语义状态比基于 Laya 的高 2.1 个点且统计显著。

papers.title: COGNIT-Guard: Calibrated Standalone Direct-Decision Guardrails with Heterogeneous CPU-NPU Confidence Cascading under Explicit Latency and False-Positive Constraints
affiliations: School of Cyber Security, Guangdong Polytechnic Normal University

summary.en: Decides when a safety gateway should generate tokens and when it should directly output a calibrated decision: COGNIT-Guard couples a validation-calibrated CPU fast gatekeeper with confidence-gated escalation to an NPU-resident 322M bidirectional direct-decision model (Laya-322M) under an asymmetric false-positive penalty, jointly handling probability calibration, dual-use false-positive control and heterogeneous CPU-NPU routing under explicit latency SLOs for pre-ingestion screening before the target LLM's prefill; on the clean unseen DUCS-Bench split (N=607) it reaches 98.85% accuracy with benign FPR 0.42%, 1.12% ECE and 0.0104 Brier; on Huawei Ascend 910C, pure NPU inference runs at 21.77 ms mean latency (45.90 QPS) and the live serial CPU-NPU cascade at 41.63 ms with 99.23% accuracy and 0.00% FPR.
summary.zh: 判定安全网关何时该生成 token、何时该直接输出校准决策:COGNIT-Guard 把经校验校准的 CPU 快速守门员与置信闸门升级到 NPU 上的 322M 双向直出决策模型(Laya-322M)耦合,在非对称假阳性惩罚下同时处理概率校准、两用误报控制与显式延迟 SLO 下的 CPU—NPU 异构路由,用于目标 LLM 预填充前的摄入前筛查;在干净的未见 DUCS-Bench 测试集(N=607)上准确率 98.85%、良性误报率 0.42%、ECE 1.12%、Brier 0.0104;在华为昇腾 910C 上,纯 NPU 推理平均延迟 21.77 毫秒(45.90 QPS),实时串行 CPU—NPU 级联 41.63 毫秒、准确率 99.23%、误报 0.00%。

problem.en: When should a pre-ingestion safety guardrail decide directly instead of generating?

papers.title: Decision 1.0: Towards Open Decision Foundation Models

summary.en: An open-weight family of decision foundation models that turns a textual state and runtime-defined questions into typed probability distributions through a Choice, Noul and Score interface, so applications can specify outcomes at inference time and compose predictions into agents and workflows without autoregressive text generation. Six models cover bidirectional-encoder and causal-decoder architectures, including a workflow specialist; training draws on verifiable tasks, natural-language annotations and workflow adaptation. Against the official Jev 1.13.0 service, English and multilingual Laya, Decider, three Kev sizes and untuned Qwen3.5 references, Lux-9B reaches 84.17% on explicit decisions and 91.25% on inference with a weighted overall score of 77.22%. Jev 1.13.0 still leads overall and on composition, reading and transfer, and is better calibrated (ECE 3.35% against 5.56%); the authors also point to gaps in composition, transfer and probability calibration.
summary.zh: 一族开放权重的决策基础模型:把文本状态与运行时定义的问题,经 Choice、Noul、Score 接口变成类型化概率分布,应用可在推理时指定结果,并把预测组合进智能体与工作流,无需自回归文本生成。六个模型覆盖双向编码器与因果解码器架构,含一个工作流专用模型;训练取材于可验证任务、自然语言标注与工作流适配。对比官方 Jev 1.13.0 服务、英文与多语言 Laya、Decider、三个尺寸的 Kev 以及未微调的 Qwen3.5 参照,Lux-9B 在显式决策上达 84.17%、推理上 91.25%,加权总分 77.22%。Jev 1.13.0 在总分以及组合、阅读、迁移上仍然领先,校准也更好(ECE 3.35% 对 5.56%);作者同时指出组合、迁移与概率校准上的缺口。

papers.title: Whom Do AI Agents Serve? Role-Induced Sponsorship Bias in Decision Models and Generative LLMs
affiliations: Desautels Faculty of Management, McGill University

summary.en: A marketing study of role-induced bias in AI shopping agents: does an agent's evaluation of sponsored listings depend on who delegates the search? In Study 1, across six LLMs and six decision models, consumer-delegated agents penalize sponsored listings, whereas naming a booking platform as the principal significantly attenuates that sponsorship penalty without any instruction to favour advertisers. The 2x2 experiment is then replicated on five more LLMs and five more decision models - commercial API models including hosted Jev 1.14 (queried through OpenRouter's System-One Decisions API), Liquid D1-Ultra, Mercury Decide and Microsoft Decision 1, plus open-weight StartLux 27B - and both hypotheses replicate in all ten. In LLMs the bias works through reduced pre-choice skepticism. Study 2 finds that attributing the paid placement to the platform amplifies the bias and stricter disclosure wording fails to eliminate it. Study 3 shows prompt-level mitigation removes platform leniency but can over-correct the penalty, whereas consumer-aligned fine-tuning eliminates the bias while better preserving baseline preferences.
summary.zh: 一项关于 AI 购物智能体「角色诱发偏置」的营销学研究:智能体对赞助商品的评价,会不会随委托方而变?研究 1 在六个 LLM 与六个决策模型上发现,消费者委托的智能体会惩罚赞助商品;而把某个预订平台指定为委托方,即便没有任何偏向广告主的指令,也会显著削弱这一「赞助惩罚」。随后 2×2 实验在另外五个 LLM 与另外五个决策模型上复现——包括托管 Jev 1.14(经 OpenRouter 的 System-One Decisions API 查询)、Liquid D1-Ultra、Mercury Decide、Microsoft Decision 1 等商用 API 模型,以及开放权重的 StartLux 27B——两个假设在全部十个模型上均成立。在 LLM 上,该偏置通过降低选择前的怀疑程度起作用。研究 2 发现,把付费位置归因于平台会放大偏置,更严格的披露措辞也无法消除它。研究 3 表明,提示级缓解能消除对平台的偏袒,却可能把惩罚过度修正;面向消费者的微调则能消除偏置,并更好地保留基线偏好。
